He's a great professor. The exams are based on the lecture slides.  Lectures are not mandatory but there are iclicker questions.  Discussions are worth 39% of your course grade.  The class is very easy.  There are weekly pre-discussion videos and questions to answer.  There is only  one research project in this course.  Extra credit is offered.

Ben is a great professor. His class isn't hard and the topic is somewhat interesting. The tests are pretty easy if you just review the lecture slides that he posts online.  This class is easy so don't take if you like a huge challenge.
Awesome professor! RECOMMEND

Awesome professor! Prodigiously talented in both intelligence and passion. Kind and accommodating - I had a small conflict with an exam and he allowed me to take it in his office at a later date, no problem. You will learn so much and be captivated no matter your major. He cares for your input and made me consider switching to IB! TAKE THIS CLASS

Be warned, No dinosaurs until after 8 weeks. The first half of the class is insufferable, but the second half is really cool. Ben Clegg can be a bit confusing and can go off on tangents, but he's a sweetheart and SO knowledgable. If you can stick it through the evolution of time, then I would recommend this course. Also, study: I went from C+ to A-

Extremely helpful and nice. I really enjoyed the class. It is a lot of work, so if you have no interest in the subject I wouldn't recommend it. If you enjoy the subject of biology then this class would be perfect for you.

Really easy class! you have to go to class for iClickers, but as long as you go to 70% of classes you get a 100% in attendance. Easy tests as long as you review the material. Usually curved. no textbook, the final is not cumulative.
Amazing teacher! He is so passionate in what he is teaching and you learn a lot from him. Easy tests, and easy class over all! RECOMMEND!

Professor Clegg is really excited about his subject but his teaching style is not very engaging. The class was also a little disorganized and he took over a month to get exam grades back. The discussions were completely pointless and the material was a little difficult for a 100-level class. Would not recommend.
Awesome TA, discussion helped me get through IB 150
Tries hard but is really hard to understand.
No Comments
No Comments

Genuinely a super nice professor and very kind. The exams were often easier or an exact copy of the practice exams on canvas. There is also extra credit on the homework if you do it more than a day early. If you put in a decent amount of effort you will do great :)

I would have liked more initial clarification on what the exam would be looking for. I went in not knowing how big of an emphasis there was on justifying your answers, and because of that I immediately lost 50% on the second exam. When asking about it on regrades I was also met with very passive aggressive ta's. That part isnt MBE's fault though.

If you do the homework and the practice tests before the exams, her class is an easy A. She's a kind, helpful professor who wants all her students to succeed. She stays after lectures to answer questions and is very approachable. The one downside is the canvas course is very poorly structured.

She's my GOAT. So kind and cares about her students so much. She'll give extensions on hw without even anyone asking for it. Extra Credit 5% on hw and at-home-quizzes. Easy exams and they finish a month before the semester ends. Detailed notes. Explains concepts very well and dont worry about her accent, its not bad at all.

She's my GOAT. So kind and cares about her students so much. Easy exams and they finish a month before semster ends. Extra credit offered on hw and at-home-quizzes. Detailed notes. Explains stuff very well; don't worry about her accent its not bad at all. She'll give you so many extensions and help if you need it.

One the best Professors I've had. Incredibly thoughtful about students and amazing to learn from. Feels like she really wants her students to succeed in her class, and gives tons of opportunities for them to do so, extra credit on homeworks and quizzes, tons of practices, and tells you exactly what will be on your exams.
So nice!. Helps during lectures gives you hints for the exams and online notes thank you so much!

I have never written a review about a professor before, she is the kindest professor ever. She is so caring and you can tell that she really loves her students and wants us to succeed. She also outline what types of problems would be on tests by giving helpful practice tests, and gave hints about tests to reward those who went to lecture.
The GOAT professor
Bahreini is very helpful and the lectures are easy to understand. Tests are also very straightforward with literal templates for the format/question types and she makes it incredibly easy to do well.
Amazing professor I love her. Had her for Calc 2 tests were pretty easy if you actually studied. Lots of extra credit opportunities. Overall would definitely recommend for calc 2
she's an angel and shall never be harmed, she deserves all that is good in this world im crying oml
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lectures were easy to follow, and concepts were very well explained. Discussion worksheet content matched with what was taught in lecture, and I can learn a lot doing the discussion worksheets. She also posts all notes, and Canvas is always very updated and organized. Amazing class!

make this one good she is the best professor every. I love her class. I haven't seen any kind professor like her in my life. She is very nice. and her Exams are really easy, she is very caring professor.

I enjoyed her lectures and thought they were mostly helpful, but some subjects she didn't explain very well or went very fast. You knew exactly what would be on the tests, she was very clear. Overall, can't complain too much, I'd take her class again.

I don't normally write reviews for professors, but Professor. Bahreini was just amazing. She posted highly detailed & easy to follow notes that made understanding the material much easier. I got a C in math 220 but ended with an A in this course and I think it is due to her effective teaching.
Best professor ever!

Excellent professor, explained all material with examples in enough detail to understand without being overwhelming. Exam grading was very clear and reasonable, with ample resources to help prepare. Outside of lecture, very helpful during office hours and explains concepts one-on-one until the student understands the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Bahreini was pretty awesome last sem(Fall 2025), we got extra credit for submitting homework early, tons of practice problems, going to lecture is useful to a certain extent ( she doesn't do a lot of examples as she goes slow, but going slow helps everyone understand) her notes are awesome. Her course is designed really well.

She has decent lectures and uploads all notes and questions solved in classes. Main pro is the testing, stencils and given for all exams so you know exactly what to expect and many questions are recycled from homework on lecture problems. Ample time is given in exams as well, however she is not very good at explaining topics

Compared to other calculus courses,  Bahreini's calc 2 is straight forward and not difficult. She gives blank exam templates, hints, example problems, and practice questions that often end up on the tests. Tests can have one or two questions that are tricky, but there will be a question like that in the notes or practice problems. Overall the goat!
Very hard to understand at times

I retook this class for grade replacement and here's my advice. She isn't the greatest lecturer, but I don't recommend skipping lecture either; utilize other resources alongside lecture, like YouTube and CARE tutoring. 50 minutes just isn't enough time to learn Calc II content, so you need to do additional work to do well. Exam reviews are helpful
Very caring and engaging professor. Lots of HW and additional study material provided. Tests are fair and aren't weighted too heavy.

Bahreini's lectures leave much to be desired, but where her lectures lack, she makes up for in exam hints and extra credit. All homework is available for extra credit, she gives blank exams detailing the kind of problems, practice exams, and is overall kind. If you are willing to put in your own time to teach yourself concepts, I recommend!
kindest professor ever
Solid lecturer. Kind and wants her students to succeed.

She explains the topics during lecture well, but she often ran out of time during the lecture, and only completed a few practice problems.
I would highly recommend skipping the lectures(except exam review—she basically gives answers), and instead reading her lecture notes, and watch youtube videos on concepts that might be difficult to understand.

Prof Manijeh made 231 manageable but you really have to make sure you put in the time to succeed in the class. some people say this class is easy, while others are having complete difficulty. depends a lot on prior background (many here are STEM majors or minors and/or took some calculus in high school).
Literally awesome professor, you didnt go to UIUC if you didnt take calc with Bahraini

She's incredibly kind and supportive!!! Her class was the highlight of my semester. I honestly wish I could take Math 231 again just to be in her lectures. She explains everything so clearly and makes math feel less intimidating. Truly one of the best professors I've ever had!

I took this course last semester and absolutely loved it!!! She's my favorite math professor. Her lectures are super clear, engaging, and well-structured. She explains concepts in a way that actually makes sense, and she genuinely cares about her students' understanding.

She is not a very good teacher. Likely will be better off skipping lecture and read the textbook or watch youtube videos. She gives an exact study guide of the **format** for each midterm and final. There is EC for each homework if done before 24h of the due date. One thing that was annoying was that the hw was often a week behind lectures.

She's a very sweet professor, but her teaching style and lectures were not too helpful towards learning the material. I would suggesting watching Professor Leonard on YouTube instead and, then, work through her practice problems. Her exams were relatively similar to the homeworks/quizzes, so I would definitely focus on studying those.

Lots of opportunities for extra credit. Super kind professor, but her lectures are super slow and not effective - she goes through maybe two practice problems a class, you're better off teaching yourself. Tests are pretty straightforward and based on quizzes, and the class is structured well.

Bahreini is very kind and patient. Course content is difficult but her grading system is forgiving, e.g. there's extra credit points that can be earned on every homework. There's also a good distribution of grades and number of assignments, so no section carries a disproportional weight on your grade.
Don't recommend her for students with disabilities even though she's supposedly the better Calc 2 professor. She will ignore all accommodations and your emails regarding them.

Very kind teacher. The lectures are pretty standard and straightforward, nothing too crazy there, but she goes through many practice problems during class and answers many questions after class as well. She is a very nice person and also gives review sheets that are basically the test, just with different numbers. Also very generous extra credit

Not a good lecturer, straight up. Almost never went to lecture, was a waste of my time. But, she is very nice and a lovely lady. HW and Quizzes are easy, and you can get extra credit if you do it 2 days early. Also extra credit was provided for every test + final. If you don't mind teaching yourself w youtube, her exams are very easy

She was such an amazing professor. She taught the class very well and made calc 2 a breeze. She would take her time when explaining how to solve problems and didn't really read off the slides but would work through them. Wish she taught more classes genuinely the sweetest teacher I have ever had.

She just reads off the slides and recites formulas. It was more useful to look up lecture notes and watch youtube videos than attend lecture, which is what a lot of people did. Strongly do not recommend.

One of the nicest and most understanding professors I've ever had. The tests weren't bad if you kept up with the homework and did past tests. She also provides exactly what is on the test, so there aren't many surprises. The discussion worksheets can be difficult to understand, but the tests are primarily focused on the homework.

Came in expecting calc 2 to be a challenge, but Bahreini makes the class very manageable. Tests are extremely similar to homework/practice exams, what you're expected to know is made clear in lectures. A great professor and person in general, would definitely recommend.
I got a 100% on this course, it was thanks to this professors great teaching skills :) She is the best and is accommodating
this is class is awesomely good with Prof Bahreini she is kind

An incredibly kind and sweet professor but not the best lecturer. She rarely does practice problems, and her notes are a bit messy. A lot of homework/quizzes but drops 2-4 lowest ones. Extra credit opportunities. Practice exams are exactly like the midterms/final. Take Bahreini if you don't mind teaching yourself calc 2 and learning in lectures.

Professor Esfahani is one of the kindest, most amazing and accommodating professors I have ever had. As someone with ADHD she has done an AMAZING job going through specifics throughout each lecture. She highlights the most important aspects to every lecture. She offers a ton of materials similar to the exams and she is super sweet.

Lectures were bad, but she got better along the way. Midterms weren't too bad bc they were almost just like the practice. She has a heavy accent but talked slow. She doesn't have the best lecture structure and it would be irritating. Be sure to go to office hours and grasp concepts you didn't get well bc they will be used throughout the  semester.

She mostly reads off the lecture notes, and doesn't really work through the homeworks. Most of the people taking this class would have some knowledge of Calc 2 beforehand, but I did not, and I found it to be incredibly difficult. However, the exams are based off of the homework and quiz questions, so they were OK if you understood the homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment:
She's very nice, but her lectures are ok. They're not recorded so it's difficult to catch up if you miss. But i've recently found Dobbs lectures online so have been watching those instead.

Class overall is very well designed though, with drops for hw, quizzes, and discussion. There's also a lot of practice content that resembles the actual exams.

I found it a little difficult to understand her through her accent but you catch on quickly. She just reads off her lecture notes and does not really work through examples. I say that you need to have a small understanding of Calc 2 to succeed in this class. She did have all of her lecture notes posted beforehand.

The test borrowed lots of questions from the quizzes and homework, so focus on these. The exams also had nice partial credit. Some of the problems can feel tedious, but Bahreini makes this class feel manageable.

Professor Bahreini is a very kind professor. She has a heavy accent and talked slow, so the lectures were a bit difficult to get through. She made it very clear what would be on the exams, which had problems taken straight from the homework. She also dropped our four lowest quizzes, worksheets, and homeworks at the end of the semester.

She is a VERY kind person, her lectures are ok. Go to lecture because she will tell you exactly what will be on the exam. Frustrating how many mistakes she had on things, like practice problems for the exam with incorrect answers.There was some sort of curve after the final bumping me up a few percentage points, so dont worry if you fail an exam :)
This professor is great. I usually take her course in the front rows, and she would always responds to the answers or the uncertainty from the students.

She's not the best lecturer, so I was at TA office hours every week because I had no idea what I was doing. Exams aren't terrible, and she tries to make them easier by using problems from the hw and quizzes, so study those. She's genuinely nice, but calc II is just super tough. Cried a ton this semester, but got through it, so don't worry too much.

Awful lecturer be prepared to learn from TA or youtube especially with midterm 3 and final. Upside is grading is fair if you make it look like you know what youre doing. Not sure if she plans on chaing cutoffs or a curve. I heard she hasn't in the past so well see. Also exam prep is generally never entirely correct and curveballs are thrown often.

I take my first review back because of how accommodating she is with just about everything. She pushed back homework deadlines to let you study for the 3rd midterm and she omitted a question on the last one that significantly helped my grade. Take her if you have to take calc 2 TAKE HER FOR YOUR OWN SAKE.

Very bad at teaching but is fair with exams. She took time with the first exam material but then got lazy with challenging series units and skip examples as they are "very easy" but we would go over many examples of real easy stuff at the beginning of the school year. Id find a friend who took her last year to get the past exams.

Skips over many of the example problems within the lecture because they're "really easy" and the students will know how to do them, despite that not being the case whatsoever.

Professor Bahreini is not only a nice and caring person, but she is a very devoted instructor. She makes sure everyone understands the material. At no point did she ever make it seem like the student not understanding the material was a burden to her. In terms of examination, she was very fair and did not throw any "curve balls" on the exams.

Calc II is a weed-out class and usually challenging but Bahreini made it much easier. She bases the exams off of the homework on WebAssign and there is nothing on the exams that we didn't learn in class. Overall G professor.

Calc here is pretty awful but Professor Bahreini was actually a great professor. She's clearly very knowledgeable and genuinely cares about helping students understand material. Tests weighted heavily but were on paper w/partial credit and expectations were very clear. All notes/worksheets put on Moodle for review. Fantastic professor overall.

Bahreini may single-handedly save the reputation of UIUC math professors. The work in the class can be unbelievably hard, but professor Bahreini is the first instructor in the math department I've met who genuinely wants her students to succeed and earn good grades.
90% of exam Qs are very similar to WebAssign quizzes. Focus on studying those.

Good teacher, as long as you put the hours in you will do great in the class. I wish I studied more, because I know I'm more capable than the grade I got. Very caring, and she attempts to make the class as fair as possible, and has great study guides. For Calculus II (and any other math courses she teaches), I recommend choosing her.

Dr. Bahreini is, by far, the most caring lecturer in the Math Department. She really encourages students to succeed, and greets them as the enter the lecture hall! She posts everything to Moodle, and will spend time with students during office hours and explain every little detail. She might as well take over for all of Calculus II. Very satisfied.

Prof. Bahreini is the first one I've had for math in years that I haven't felt strong hate for. After nearly having to retake calc 1 (see Placzek's reviews for reference), I had super low expectations going into this class. She did a great job teaching us this semester even though she often had to go through complex material fast. She also cares!!!

Bahreini is probably the best professor for calc 2 which can easily become an impossible class with other professors but is manageable with her. Don't get me wrong, the class is by no means easy but in comparison to other sections of calc 2, professor Bahreinis class is very manageable.

reviews.comment: Professor Bahreini ensures you understand the things she talks about. She provides lots of examples to illustrate key concepts. Tests problems are from the examples. This is how a math course should be.

Probably the best Calc II prof at UIUC. Class is definitely a mess but at least it is clear she is genuinely trying to do the best job she can given the administrative restraints that are put on the course by the math department.
She is a type of person who cares. I really liked her in general and even hoping I can meet her again. Definitely recommending her for 220
Decent professor, good at explaining complex concepts.

reviews.comment: Definitely one of the better lecturers' in ECE. Yuting approaches students' questions from different perspectives allowing for a better understanding of material. She knows how to teach

Professor Chen is single-handedly the best lecturer I've had in this department. She is passionate, professional, and always prepared for lecture. Lectures are always engaging (she makes the hour and a half fly by) and comprehensible, and she truly cares for her students.

Chen is a great professor. She teaches the material in a very easy to understand manner and is by far the best of the 220 professors. She also cares for her students and remembers them by name after only a few interactions. The class and exams are difficult but having Chen makes it much easier.

Honestly one of the best professors I've ever had here. She was always free to answer questions, help students on MPs, and so much more. Chen is the best!!!
A great lecturer. She teaches everything carefully and explains so well. If only all professors were like her and her husband Xu Chen, I would've learnt so much more during my college degree.
Professor Chen is a great lecturer and she really cares about the class. There is a lot of extra credit given from the labs so getting an A is very achievable.
very good professor, detailed explanations, cares about students' success

Honestly have never felt more awake in a class. Her lecture voice is so loud and clear it manages to cancel out my post-lunch food coma on class days. Actually though, very solid lecturer, and this classes isn't too bad
Decent lecturer, gives many examples in lectures. Can't go wrong with her.
Its a hard class because you learn how to code. However I believe that Dr. Chen is an amazing professor who tries her best to teach those who don't know how to code in order to code.
By far the cutest professor I have ever seen in my life. She is prepared, and tries to cover as much as possible.

Took her class two years ago when the pandemic didnt occur. Best in person lectures Ive ever experienced because she engages everyone with her energy. She explains things very well and i can tell shes passionate about teaching. Super approachable and is happy to answer questions

Best professor Ive ever had. She actually interacts with her students and encourages questions, creating a very engaging environment. She also explains concepts in a way that most people can understand. Honestly, I wish she could teach all of my ECE classes

I love Max. He's such a sweetie pie and a great teacher.

Not only is it only the most interesting and fun class i've ever taken but also its super easy to do well, very few hws and tests, all graded easy. TAs are great too

Dude was awesome, by far the best and most interesting gen ed I've taken so far. Class especially the tests were very easy. lectures arent mandatory except on test days, lectures are amazing and interesting though

Professor Chen is a nice guy!

Professor Chen in the IoT class is awesome! He's a really good teacher and super nice. He even gives us extra credit to help us get better grades! The class material is also well put together. He has done a lot in the SOC area but he doesn't have good teaching skills. Shows up late to the lectures as well.

Fun professor! He made lectures very engaging and fun. They were never boring plus good paced. Also they helped me a lot in understanding the concept.
Fun professor! he made lectures so much fun to attend and helps in understanding the concepts a lot.

Great physics 211 teacher take him if you have the chance to.
Amazing professor

Professor Farina's lectures are entertaining and very digestible. This class was not difficult, but I still felt like I learned a lot.

A great professor.

Really friendly and great professor
