frustrating class. lectures were rarely useful and many students stopped attending after the first few weeks. his tone could be harsh and he often went on tangents that hurt the pace. he gets mad at his students a lot. the final was extremely difficult, and the exam setup felt unfair for students without advanced calculators

For such a challenging course, Professor Stepanov explains the topics really well, but at a fast pace in class. Many resources are available to ensure mastery of each skill for exams and homework's. Go to office hours early on if stuck!

Stepanov is great, his lectures are never boring. He truly cares about ensuring students understand the content. The exams were very fair, just do hella practice problems and you'll be fine. Overall a wonderful professor, I'll miss his corny ahh jokes.

410 with Alex will be one of the best courses you take at UIUC. He is an incredibly funny and brilliant professor who knows how to such a theoretical subject and bring it to the masses. Homework and tests are brutal (and violate Geneva Convention), but it is worth it in the end. It is a rite of passage to take 410 with him.

Alex is a great professor to take STAT 410 with - he explains concepts in a very intuitive way that is often missing in textbooks. If you understand the homeworks, do the extra practice problems, go to class and go to office hours you'll be fine for the exams.

Amazing class. Content is clear and thoroughly organized. Lectures are fast paced but highly informative. Office hours are extremely helpful and under-utilized. Expect tough but fair exams, and lots of time spent doing practice problems. Great professor, but could ease a bit off students making minor errors at times.

A good lecturer and an understanding professor. Practicing many problems on Canvas will help you learn the material. Formula sheets were allowed, which was helpful. Very entertaining lecturer and very nice regardless of the in-class antics. If he is intimidating, talk to him outside of class. I am sad I will not take any other courses from him.
mostly : ( , but it's a great course

While many idolize him, it is hard for me to distract how toxic of an environment he creates in class. He would be an interesting client for a psychologist. Seems like he copes with his problems through the classes he teaches. However. I do enjoy how quickly grading occurs in his courses. Obviously he cares, just needs more work on executing that.

His lectures were interesting and engaging (much better than watching pre-recorded videos imo). Also, his sarcasm/remarks in class used to be something to look forward to. His office hours were very helpful for the homework and he's a lot more nicer in person than how he might appear in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: First of all, as others have previously stated, don't be afraid of the “no curve ever” he puts in the syllabus, he curved the class quite generously at the end lol. Second, DO YOUR HOMEWORK YOUR CURVE DEPENDS ON IT. Exams are hardcore dude, study the homework but be prepared to be confused anyway, don't panic and trust the process, do your best.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Back to week 1 when we are still friends, then he collectively wants to scare warming fuzzy feeling students with toxic actions. Clearly he is a man who knows nothing about respect and love, and he wants students to have pain and suffering in STAT 410. But, do not tell LAS administration about this or call president Trump, yet.
nice professor

STAT410 is prone to small mistakes.
Taking an exam in a crowded hall without desks or scratch paper is no easy task. Minor errors can lead to significant point deductions. Fortunately, Alex granted us 20 points of extra credit, providing a margin for error.
Frankly speaking, if this policy continues, students shouldn't complain about this course.

Very toxic professor. I can never tell when he's joking about something or genuinely about to crash out, so it's kind of scary. He is a solid professor when it comes to teaching though, but don't bother asking him anything if you don't want to be ridiculed.

Please don't say mean stuff about Prof. Stepanov, he is NOT a terrible person but a professor with tender and kind feelings! He is indeed trying to create a wonderful learning atmosphere. I still remember the day when he was holding a pile of exams but still trying to hold a door for me.
Please don't say hurtful words : ）

I am convinced that he is paying students to write good reviews about him. In all my years of receiving an education (from Kindergarten up until this point), I have never dealt with an instructor as terrible as this man. He has no issue intimidating students and creating a toxic learning environment where you fear to ask a single question in class.

I wish his canvas would be more organized because although his recorded videos are very useful, there are a lot of them. It would be better if the examples and videos were consolidated to one set of solid examples and then everything else be a deeper dive. Overall, grading is fair, there is EC, and you can learn a lot. I recommend reading the book.

He is a chill professor, but he goes through concepts fast. It is hard to keep up with him in lectures. Watching his videos at your own pace is much easier, and I learned way more that way. The HWs are doable, and you should use all your resources in Canvas to help you. The tests are easier than he makes them out to be. But it is a reasonable class

Gave insightful commentary on why we should care about what we learn in his class. He opened a new dimension of statistics that other instructors may have failed to achieve. He is scary (discord!) and really fast, but his class is extremely fair and it's obvious he wants students to succeed (despite what he says in class). Is also on Piazza a lot.

Prof. Stepanov's STAT410 class is a wild ride, but you'll learn a ton if you engage with his unique teaching style. The lectures are entertaining, and the coursework is fair if you put in the effort. The Unstuckstudy platform was a game-changer for my study prep - highly recommend!

I mean, it's a great class, really. Just look at the numerous positive reviews if you don't believe me. Many have criticized the class for not having enough proofs on the exams and that the political jokes are getting too real, which I agree with.

Although he claims himself as "a terrible human being knowing nothing about respect and love" and is annoyed when others ask him questions such as syllabus, Canvas, or TI nSpire, he still creates a fantastic learning atmosphere. I still love taking his class. Just don't mind his temper too much.
He speaks not so loudly and he doesn't use a speaker so sit towards the front of the classroom just to hear him clearly.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment:
Lectures are a wild but fun ride...learn a ton! Some students (who occasionally post bad reviews) can't focus on the stats b/c they too busy fearing for no reason.

Grading? Fair.
Lectures? Only help if you show up. 
HW? Only helps if you actually do it.

If you care about learning (with some entertainment)...take his class! otw this is america
He is an artist in teaching! Very well-organized course, and he is so funny! The best class that I ever have had.

I have never met an educator with so much contempt for their students. Dude literally hates his students and does not seem to enjoy teaching at all. I do not know why the stats department has him teaching a core course when I think everybody involved would prefer him to be grumbling about his work somewhere else.

you are all being so mean to literally my favorite 54 year old russian man in the world for no reason. have some couth. you probably won't find a class more organized on campus than this one. go to lecture! it's fun, i promise!

Alex is a great lecturer and never fails to keep me engaged. He's fantastic at explaining the underlying theories behind the material. My main concern is that he's very emotional and will punish the whole class for the actions of a few students. Prof. Stepanov needs to let some of the dumb questions and interruptions go and keep class on topic.

I don't even take this class but I come in for entertainment. Absolutely hilarious especially cuz I have no idea whats goingon. Truly a terrible person who knows nothing about respect and love. "there are only 3 other people on the globe more terrible" than him. He spits nothing but facts that are "politically correct"; "Your university hates you"
It's over
I think he is posting fake 5 star reviews on this site to boost his rating lmao. pretty funny. also waging a one man holy war against chegg and course hero. dude is a weirdo.

Great professor and great instructor. I haven't seen any professor who is as prepared for a lecture as Alex is.

I'm glad to have taken this course with him.

Be prepared to invest time for practice, and I can guarantee you'll be on top.
Great professor, you just need to invest in the material a bit, provides vast amount of preparatory material, and if you're willing to put effort, you'll come out on top.
whoever are the 2 students making weird comments at the 2pm session i beg u pls stop. yk who u are. overall, great professor.

He personally did not do anything to me, but overall he is a mean, unstable, emotional lecturer. 
He did not make the classroom or office hours welcoming, but rather hostile. He would occasionally make some unfunny jokes. 
Also, I felt that he did not prepare students enough for the exams.

The problem I have with Alex is that because ~10 people use Chegg for the homework the whole class must be and our tests will be the entire course. I do like him, you just need to understand his level of humor and have thick skin. He knows a great deal and has a lot to give if you invest. I looked forward to going to his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
Alex is an amazing human being that knows a lot about respect and love. 

Actually though; Alex has a sense of humor that isn't for everyone, but the way he teaches content makes it very easy to understand and it's clear he wants his students to succeed (no matter what he might say)

PRO: good structure of the course, homework use same examples throughout the semester.Interesting examples and memes to help understand concepts. IMPROVEMENTS: speaks too fast, lectures hard to follow, too emotional. Would be better if tell less jokes for time on materials. WORKLOAD:1-3hours/week for hw besides lecture. TIP: discussions are useful
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
A very polarizing professor. Find it a bit ironic that people say "he's a nice guy, just don't ask him stupid questions", basically if you have natural intuition for statistics you're good, otherwise, don't even bother asking him about clarifications. 

Never seen someone have so much PTSD from kids posting to Chegg -- yes it's very bad, we get it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Alex devotes much time to the class (very detailed class materials on canvas, 3 OH time slots throughout the week). He's NOT a terrible human being who knows nothing about respect and love. The course is also very well designed. The materials taught in class are tough, but the exams only test you on the basics.
I have never met somebody with so much contempt for their students

Top G professor, very tough, lectures are fine but people can't hear him clearly in the back. Also, he make a lot of irrelevant and boring jokes that no one laughs. Study by yourself and you are fine. He don't like to talk to boys and seems unwilling to answer the questions, but for girls you are fine, he will teach you.

Incredibly knowledgeable professor that creates a very uninviting classroom atmosphere. Allows his anger towards students - whether appropriately placed or not - to interfer with the quality of his lectures. Does a great job at making the material engaging, but occasionally opts to intentionally dull material because of his combative personality.

Seriously don't get why people feel the need to cheat on the homework. Alex goes out of his way to make the lecture exciting and engaging, and in return he asks you to just not cheat on the homework. An amazing human being who knows about respect and love.

I am currently in his STAT 410 class. Some of these people on here need to grow up. And you seriously have to be mentally 'delayed' to be posting his homework question on chegg. I swear if I catch whoever did that I will beat you to a pulp. He's such a good lecturer with a unique teaching style. Go to OH's if you need more help its not hard.
This is a hard class. Can't blame my professor for me not getting an A. He's lecture is fun, just sometimes can't understand if he's joking or being serious...

I am not good at math, so originally I did not expect a good grade. But Alex did a fantastic job helping me understand the material well. His lecture is so engaging and hilarious that I did not miss any of his lectures in the past semester. Admittedly we had hurtful times during office hours, but I still think he is a good professor.

Alex is a fantastic teacher. The content in STAT 410 is so boring, but he somehow manages to teach it really well. I didn't get the best grade in his class, but that was because I messed up on exams and he weighs exams quite heavily.

Just don't ask stupid questions and interact with him in class - you'll see that he's actually a great professor.

Great instructor for the most part. Lectures are generally engaging and helpful, and material and exams are straightforward. While Alex obviously cares about students and wants them to learn, he doesn't suffer fools very easily and the classroom environment becomes incredibly uncomfortable when students do or ask (admittedly) dumb things.
He looks tough at first, but once you overcome the first few weeks, you will find the class enjoyable. Exam time is tight, but it is very similar to homework (and easier).

I'm not sure why people are commenting about the final exam being difficult. Alex made it absurdly doable and easy if you put in the work to study.  He may not be the most friendly professor in the stats department, but he's certainly reasonable.

Pros:
Makes the classroom engaging during lectures, and lecture notes provided a plethora of examples to become successful in the class. 

Cons:
Can't ask many "dumb" questions.

Since I'm not a STAT major, I'm hesitant to take STAT 410 because I've heard the course is challenging. Nevertheless, Alex illustrated those concepts and theorems clearly, and his lectures are well-prepared and well-organized. There is no doubt that he is a cornerstone and he cares about his students. Love U, Alex!!
Alex is a fantastic teacher. Although his personality is difficult for most people to accept, his academic rigor is undeniable. I got a 320/320 and will continue to study with Alex for STAT 410!
It's true that Stepanov is an excellent lecturer, but so what? He remains a toxic detriment to students' growth. A terrible human being who knows nothing about respect and love

Feel I didn't do well in the final, but overall the homework questions are not difficult. Every time I asked questions after class, he answered very clearly and politely. Maybe not everyone likes his sense of humor, but honestly going to his class for jokes and puns especially about politics is one of the few things that made me happy this summer
Alex, thank you for ruining our lives with the final exam. An enjoyable semester that ended happily. Must be so relieved! :-)
Stepanov is an excellent person who just so happens to be an intelligent professor. Could not recommend enough - TAKE A CLASS WITH STEPANOV!!

Materials are presented clearly. More than sufficient materials are provided. No exam problem was trickier than what was presented in lectures or homework. Fair grading. 
Tip: refine your questions and show some effort spent when you ask for help. 
Learning without hand-holding, but with gritty humor. Just how college education should be.

There are many good teachers in the stats department, and Stepanov is certainly one of them. He is very knowledgeable in his teaching and his method of teaching is great. He cares and he has a personality, honestly, what can you ask more from a prof?
Great. Savage, but great.

Very Good Professor. His lectures really explain the concepts and he literally lists out what is going to be on exams. People need to stop giving hate and just realize he's got a personality just like the rest of us. You go Alex!!!

The exams are easy and are based on homework topics. You can get an A if you put in the time to do his practice questions. He is a very mean and sarcastic lecturer, and you may become depressed by being near him. In this class, learning is not the hard part, putting up with the lecturer is the hard part.

He is the most difficult person to work with. If you are caught asking a harmless clarifying question, he will toy with you into believing you are extremely stupid for not understanding it the first time. He never gives straight answers either. His piazza answers reek of sadism.
a great professor

One of the best professors I've had at this university. Definitely take him for STAT 410 if you can. He breaks down the material and makes the material and class very doable. You can get a good grade, but you'll have to work for it. Also don't be afraid to go to office hours - if you have good questions he'll give you great explanations.

Worst professor I've ever had. I never write rate my professors, but this professor was SO RUDE, that I had to write something. He is extremely rude when you ask him questions, such as clarifying questions during office hours. Like come on man, it might be a "silly question" to you, but like we're out here tryna learn, especially cuz it's online
The best professor I had in stats department. Very helpful during office hours. He will be nice and patient to you if you are a girl.

He's a really nice prof although he always says he's a terrible person. His homework has hints, his exams are always homework-based and he speaks so quickly that my English listening has greatly improved at the same time. btw, I miss the girls in his class!
Best stat professor I ever have! He is awesome!

Once you get through the storm of asking a question... if you can... hes probably the best professor and is really fun to get to know. Take him don't listen to what scary things other people say... they probably asked a stupid question and you don't do that in his class. You just don't. Not if you want to live. Like asking how to draw a square.
No. Dont take it. Seriously

He is undoubtedly one of the best Stats teachers I have ever met. He teaches everything with such ease which makes difficult topics much easier than they are. He is really funny and he makes sure that everyone gets what he is trying to explain.

Amazing class in Fall 2019. As a person who doesn't like Mathematics and was forced to take a STATS course for a degree requirement, I could not have chosen a better course. Amazing professor and decent course.
The best stat professor I have ever encountered. Lots of inspiration from his lectures. Miss his lectures just as I miss campus life

Professor Stepanov was so far the best stats professors I have had at this university. He genuinely cares about students learning the material. He makes lectures fun and interesting! The class itself is pretty easy granted you put in a few hours per week. Would definitely recommend him over any other 410 prof!
Really good lecturer makes statistics fun even though it is really a dry subject. Exams were kinda difficult but we get to use cheat sheets which was great

He is one of the 2 best teachers I've met at the UIUC. He's passionate to teach and knows how to teach. I feel lucky that I took STAT 400 with him. His STAT 400 is a treasure to my whole career in statistics. And his STAT 430 makes me fall in love with statistics. Lecture covers homework, homework covers exams. Best of best.

He is a very nice professor, tries to act very very mean. But has a very good heart. Would give you a death stare all the time, but he is a good teacher. Only, drawback it hates when you ask him silly questions or small doubts!!! Dude, we are students we don't know everything, and no idea how we got here, your job is to teach us and guide us.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Alex is a great teacher! He cares about the class and I enjoy the class very much.
I thought Stepanov was equal parts wonderful and terrifying. He seems passionate about teaching to an unsettling degree. Learned an immense amount, hands down would take a class with him again.

I'm pretty sure the only reason people like him is because of everyone has an abusive relationship with him. If this is America then you really have to work to succeed. Alex somehow turns a boring stats lecture into an entertaining, terrifying 50 minutes. He is the most prepared professor I've had. Just don't ask stupid questions and always think.

I personally like his lectures for STAT 400/410 but not that much for STAT 420. I liked the class, he is still a great lecturer, it's just a matter of efficiency. I just feel like homework that uses a lot of R should be submitted online. It's much more easy to read then printing them out.

Most of the time during the course is in poor efficiency. The most stupid activity he likes is tossing a coin rather than instruct us knowledge. Even though you look like a Russia, you should not be that ludicrously enthusiastic. The course is too easy as 400 level. The content could be more difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I just finished taking STAT 400 over the summer. You will absolutely love his enthusiasm, entertaining jokes, and clear presentation of the material. He is easily the best professor I've ever had.
His lecture is pretty clear and organized. He loves telling jokes in class which makes the lecture enjoyable. The grading is not harsh. Good professor!

Infuriating, erase it before anyone can copy this down, this is America! Love Alex when he makes funny jokes! Greatest professor of STATs. And I'm sorry for making a lot emojis of Alex. Hope to take other stats classes with you again.

He is amazing. The best math professor I have ever had and I have taken a lot of them. STAT 410 is difficult but he is super clear in his lecture and he is hilarious; you will never get bored in his class ! Take his class if you can.
One of the best professors I have ever had in UIUC, he's so passionate in teaching. So sad that today's the last day of class. See you around!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: He is awesome.
Alex comes extremely prepared to class and can inspire you to do more math. Only missing a dog named Hachi. 10/10 would watch again

Although Alex keeps saying what a horrible person he is, he is a REALLY GREAT professor. I feel he was born funny and his lectures are never boring, full of jokes and memes. He posts worksheets before classes and if he covers anything that is not on the worksheet, he will type it up later and upload it to compass. My favorite stat professor ever.

Highly recommended. His notes are textbook. You don't need to spend money on books. I liked his lectures in general, but he doesn't have microphones and I just couldn't hear him well (maybe it was just the problem with the room). I've taken both 400 and 410 with him and Idk why but his personality seemed different in stat 400 and 410.
pls give worksheets. Its infuriating not to have them >:(

Alex's class is not hard when he provides the lecture notes/examples regularly. His lectures went awfully fast and I did not enjoy them at all. It was suffering. I am more than happy to have the notes downloaded ahead of each lecture so that I can have time to preview them.
continue giving worksheets plz. :)

Hate his lecture style. Has 5+ worksheets for every week and in lecture he just randomly picks one and goes over the problems. Class had no direction just solving random problems. Plus most worksheets don't even have the solutions to them. Infuriating >:-(

Alex was a good guy. His lecture was funny and he would explain the point several times. I took his STAT 410 and 420 in my last yr in UIUC, to be honest, he was one of my favorite professors. Although I was graduate, I still miss him

Taking a class with him is like going on a roller coaster ride. You don't know what to expect in the next classes and how he's going to react to his student. He might be mean to a class that never participates, so TRY to be active. He probably memorized all his lectures by now and he shows this off at every class. Hope your reading this Alex.

Don't let Alex scare you into dropping the class, he'll push that hard for the first 2 weeks. You'll get used to his personality and it will keep you from being bored out of your mind during class. Hwk and final are very reasonable . Midterms were hard and had problems with obscure tricks. Don't ask obvious questions, he will mock you if you do.
Alex, I know you read it. Could you add your derivations of formula during class to the work sheets? That'll be great.

He is really good at teaching statistics. I am going to take stat 410 next semester and I am excited cuz he's teaching it. Sometimes he is little snarky, but most of the time he's just fun. He uploads all the notes so I just go to class cuz he's hilarious.
reviews.rating_tags: Tests? Not many--Amazing lectures--Would take again

reviews.comment: Great professor! Alex is nice, caring, and the lecture is enjoyable and inspirational. I love Alex!
He's a good professor but his moods are very unstable, and he cycles through being funny, angry, and sad every class. He should take lithium or something to balance out those mood swings...
I know you read these so I only made a post to give you a hot pepper. You're welcome.
I love Stepanov. He's a nice guy. Favorite math teacher by far.

Lectures are very clear and well prepared. However, I was not fan of his personality. He was funny at times, but got mad randomly. If you are going to copy hw, don't do it at Illini Hall. I saw way to many people get caught. He stays at illini Hall past midnight. I have seen them there multiple times when I studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Lectures are presented clearly and concisely. Exams are straightforward as long as you've completed and understood all assigned homeworks.  Though the first exam is considerably easier than the remaining two. Make sure to brush up on your calculus, particularly double integrals, or you might find yourself lost midway through the course.

His lectures are not boring, so I recommend going to them. However, if you ask any questions regarding the hw, he seems to get frustrated easily and starts rambling  about things that are not related to  your question. If you are a girl, he will love you. I hope he reads this comment in class. There are many cons, but I would take him again.

How do you differentiate a elementary school teacher from a professor? After finish talking about a problem and asking the students: "With me?" A professor waits for two seconds and procede to the next problem while an elementary school teacher waits for feed backs from the students. Guess what prof. Stepanov would do?
He's very good at simplifying complex things. He's kind of a strange dude though; he posts good notes
Definitely the best statistic professor that I have ever seen. But be careful that there is no extra credits and curve for his course what so ever though.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He's so great. He just wants the students to think by themselves.
He is not a jerk, you just can't get his humor easily. The essence of his course is his note, best textbook ever.

He is an awesome professor.. He wants the students to work for their grades. He gets a little aggravated if you ask him silly questions, answers to which you should have already known but he would still help you. He has mean and strict attitude but he really cares about you. He is like a coconut hard from outside and soft from inside.

Best teacher I've ever had. As long as you do not cheat or take advantage of him like MATH 408 did then you should have no problems with him. Very helpful especially during office hours and is very good at teaching the material. Does a great job of not making the class boring with all his stories and jokes, although not always funny, appreciated.
Great teacher!!!

Alex, I know you are conscious of these comments enough to read them off during classes. Please stop wasting student's time during classes. I took more than 85 credits so far, and you were the worst teacher I've ever met, congrat. Most inaccessible, rude, and unhelpful. I got above 97% on your class, so don't assume I am mad at you for grades.

Stochastic Processes class is not for faint-hearted.  Homeworks test your ability to write proofs, so if you lack  preparation, good luck. Exams test your ability to memorize rare non-proof examples from homeworks and speed. The amount of material covered is huge, but examples are few and speed at which Alex goes is beyond average undergrad Xiao.

Personally my favorite professor in UIUC. His lectures and notes are extremely structured and detailed, from intuition to "silly" examples to more complicated ones. His jokes and self-deprecating humor make lectures engaging and fun. I find him patient, knowledgeable and personable. Respect is reciprocal; pay attention in class and don't cheat (:

He is NOT a jerk! Literally one of the best professors I've ever had with respect to lecturing style. Everything he says makes sense, as opposed to my CS professors that go on and on about some they probably don't even understand. He presents the material with examples and theoretical underpinnings, but he explains them in a great way. NOT a jerk!!

I can't believe people actually like this guy. In one word, he's a jerk.  I once needed help on a HW problem and asked him in office hours for help clarifying the question. The next day in lecture, he actually announced to the class not to come to him with bad questions. In major advising, he has been pretentious and curt. Very disrespectful

Stepanov is great. All around. Best Act-Sci teacher her considered Gorvett and PJ are gone. He's the only hope this program has. Take him, actually DO the homework. You'll find answers online, and you will do poorly on tests. Just suck it up, get a group together, order pizza, and do the hw... it'll make the tests super simple. GREAT GUY.

He is easily the best teacher I ever had in UIUC. I have my classes: Math 408 and 409 taught by him and learn a lot from him. Homeworks are VERY TOUGH but the exam is pretty straightforward. He declare himself as mean but he is actually very nice and really willing to help the students to learn and understand the material.

Alex is easily the best professor I've had in college. He is funny and very helpful and teaches the material very well. The class has very tough homework but it prepares you extremely well for the exams and quizzes. Very helpful in class but he will get mad if the class doesn't participate or show up.

Alex is my favorite professor so far! It was great to take STAT 400 with him during the summer, and I will definitely take his class again if I can get in. He has a sense of humor, and is very helpful and friendly to students. He can get very scary if you cheated on homework/exams (eg. if you copy other student's homework...) so don't do that!

If you're thinking about taking any Stat class at UIUC, then definitely take it with Alex! First of all, he is mean! He is always well prepared for the lectures. Don't bother buying the book, 'cause Prof Stepanov is the living book! He knows everything! Go Alex!
Tests aren't bad but try not to get on his bad side as he has accused students of cheating for using example problems (that he has given in class) to do the homework and tests
Glad to have him as the professor. Took Exam P and passed right after the final. This class is perfect for actuarial science students. HWs are tough, but prepare you well for everything.

Probably the funniest professor I've ever had - he made showing up to 3:00 lectures 100% worth it.  Never moved on to a new concept unless all questions were answered.  HWs are difficult BUT prepare you well for the tests which are much easier and very fair.  Overall, you can tell he loved teaching and is very good at it - highly recommend him!!
He is amazing!!!!!!!!! Very nice person and he explains everything clearly.
Alex is mean.
If you have a sense of humor you'll enjoy his lectures.   Take the homework and practice problems seriously and you'll do fine in the class and on tests and quizzes
You have to take this class with Stepanov. He's amazing!

Excellent lecturer! By attending STATS 400 you feel more like in the comedy club. He likes picking on students, so do not leave in the middle of the lecture. Likes participation. No curve, homework is once every 2 weeks and is hard. Quizes are a joke. Exams are easier than HW. Highly recommended!

I love having Stepanov as my professor. He's really clear and provide examples in classes. Homework load for MATH408 is quite a lot, but it is very helpful for exams. He's funny as well. He said that he's a mean person, but that's not true. He's one of the nicest professor I've known!
A friendly but grumpy guy. Tests are fair game.

He is the BEST professor I have ever met in this university. He is sooo funny and always joke. I love taking his class and really miss it especially when I take another statistics class this semester with another professor.

He is the best professor I have ever met. His jokes in class keeps it interesting and fun. He tries very hard to encourage participation which was a big challenge. Overall if you are taking any stats class make sure you take his class!
He is one of the best professors in Department of Statistics. His lecture is very helpful for Actuarial exam P and C. If you have an opportunity to take his class, take it, you will learn a lot!!
Best professor! He claims that he's a horrible person (H0: Alex = horrible person) but I'm sure that claim will fall into rejection region. You'll understand what I'm saying once you take the class.

He was fantastic! I went to his class everyday and actually participated. B/c of that he was always willing to help me, so actually interact with him. He is funny and knows his stuff. The HW can be hard, but work with other people. I was glad to have him as a professor.

Homework is very difficult but once you get over it, exam is just a piece of cake.You'll be very grateful for having Alex as your instructor especially when you are sitting for exam P. Alex is a very good dry joke teller and definitely has some flexible bones. However, please be careful, sometimes he can be quite dangerous.

Fantastic professor. Exams are taken right from in-class examples, and are easy as long as you make good use of your note sheets (put example problems on them and you're golden). Stepanov made STAT 400 easier than STAT 200. Take his class whenever possible.
He is a great instructor and nice person. In addition, his class is easy A.

Greatest professor ever, his lecture slides are all available on the compass with solutions. Homework are nearly the same as the questions on the slides, so do the exams. Go to lectures and go over the slides. A in hand.
Take his class if there is one. Class contents and homework are difficult, but exams are very easy as long as you have  comprehensive formula sheets~

Very clear, very passionate, and very funny (well if you're into dry, cheesy humor). Favorite stats prof here. Notes help out a ton with HW and exams. Exams are very similar to HW. No surprises. Encourages participation, which is good. Fair and Reasonable as a whole. Wish he taught more classes.

His personality makes the class interesting. He's kind of mean, but you get over it after a few weeks. Otherwise, his lectures are example filled, which I liked very much. Homework is very difficult but very similar to exams. With that being said exams have no surprises so they are pretty easy. Fair grader, would definitely recommend.

I must say he has a great passion for teaching and he does enjoy it. However, I strongly dislike his teaching methodology. He does not care whether students are able to understand and follow what he teaches. And the worst part he spends 80% of class time in solving examples (sheer mathematical calculation) and focuses least on explaining concepts.
One of the best math professors I've had. Class is interesting because of his jokes. :)
He is the best lecturer I've ever had!

Very well organized course. He is very up to date with posting content on compass despite what he says. He is a good guy and he truly wants his students to succeed. Would recommend. He also looked at this site one day while in class and showed the students his reviews. "Let me erase all of this before you copy it down..."

Stepanov is the man. Everything is posted online to review. The homework is tough but prepares you for the milder exams. This was one of the best classes I've taken at U of I, incredibly organized for a 400 math class where teachers can tend to be all over the place. He keeps lecture interesting, very funny guy.
Awesome Prof... Take Stat 400 with him and you will not regret it
All midterms are fair but final exam is getting a little harder. Maybe only my fault cause so many As around me.
Keeps on blabering in class. His  notes are undoubtedly good and well organized, but his style of teaching sucks

This man is hilarious, and an excellent teacher.  He is able to maintain concentration of class in what is not a very interesting subject.  He was really mad one day, but the rest of the time was very pleasant and helpful.

He is too good. Just too good! He can explain anything about statistics and mathematics. Extremely clear! Very smart professor! But his behavior is a little bit hard to understand, occasionally. His temper is somewhat unstable.
Excellent professor! He knows everything about Statistics!

The conciseness of his notes, in-depth knowledge of his field, and kindness normally reserved to being emitted by a carebear make him a professor that makes UIUC known. Make no mistake, he is a very fair and helpful professor. You will learn a lot from him. Also, his lectures are fascinating and humorous. Lastly, he goes above the call to answer Qs

The best professor I?ve ever had! You learn a LOT in his class. The lectures are well organized & he explains really well. Stepanov has a great sense of humor. It?s amazing how he makes learning such a dry subject so much fun.  It?s obvious that he is passionate about teaching. I really enjoyed his class.
Alex is great. He's really entertaining and it keeps the class interesting. He provides example sheets for every class, which are incredibly helpful when doing homework and preparing for exams.

In terms of teaching, he is the best instructor I have ever seen for about 10 years of my campus life in undergraduate and graduate schools. He knows really well what are important for his students and is very good at explaining hard materials very easily. I was into his jokes!!! I never got bored in his class. I already miss him a lot.

In terms of teaching, he is the best instructor I have ever seen for about 10 years of my campus life in undergraduate and graduate schools. He knows really well what are important for his students and is very good at explaining hard materials very easily. I was into his jokes!!! I never got bored in his class. I already miss him a lot.
Great professor! Second class I've taken with him.  Always willing to help students. LOVES whens students ask questions.  Easy to get on his good side.
The worst teacher I ever meet!!!!!!!! The course is really easy. But I doubt his moral quality. So bad.

Alex worked hard on his lectures and was always prepared. He's also a really smart guy despite how he says he's dumb... He can be really moody, but he can also be pretty funny. Very quirky professor. He is sarcastic at times, but generally it's funny. He is also really fair  from my experience. HW is hard, but worth it. Take class with Alex.
Had him for Math 408,409 and Stat 420. He rocks! Very engaging (sometimes goes lunatic) but a caring, helpful and unforgettable lecturer nonetheless. Will miss him!
He is the man!!
Awesome prof.  The homework is difficult but if you do it all you can get A's on every exam.  Very fair and helpful.
He is super nice and really cares about his student :D

This is the second time I took his class. He is by far one of the best teachers on campus I've met. The test is easy. He gave out extra credits for this summer class. The homeworks are relatively hard, so as long as you understand what you are doing in the homeworks, you'll do great on the exams.

I loved having class with Alex. I did well in this class only because I went to office hours- he was extremely helpful and made sure you understood the material. Discussion is useless, except for taking quizzes, which are easy. Homework is difficult and takes forever, but helps for the tests. Tests are fair. I only used the textbook for homework

Alex is awesome! If you actually take time to ask him any kind of questions, he will *make sure* you understand the material. He did seemed to go off topic during the lecture, but that's probably some part of his awesomeness... and his squirrels and polar bears :-D

Textbook is useless but only because Alex is the best professor I've had on campus. He really cares about the students and has an amazing sense of humor. He gets mad if the class doesn't participate, but if you do, he'll love you.  Also, homework is hard, but it's only to prepare you and his tests aren't horrible. No curve at all, but class is fair

He's such a great instructor.Love to make jokes in class. His homework aint that hard if you start doing it a bit earlier.Or else, will end up finishing in 6 hours.I would highly recommend him for math409 and math469.Actuarial sc, u gotta love him!:P

He really cares about the students, which is a nice change from other classes of this size. He expects a lot but not excessive amounts. You will have several hours of homework but since it is preparing you for an actuarial exam it's not excessive either. Ask questions he'll answer them well. In the end you get out what you put in..I'd recommend him

He is not horrible teacher and his exams are fair.  BUT he rants and complains instead of teaching for about 40% of class time.  He assigns over 6 hours of homework every week, even on exam weeks. I wouldn't recommend him but Acutarial students are pretty much stuck with him!

This professor does not show how to do problems. He will just make jokes for most of the class instead of teach. He does a poor job of writing notes and will either erase what he's written or explain things while you're still copying so that you can't get everything down. His tests are fair, though. Overall, he's a bad teacher but nice guy.

He is not a very hard teacher yet he gives a ton of homework which a lot of the time is just useless and way to long. Espeically he gives homework during weeks of exams which sucks. He gets off topic a little too much but does teach the material well. If you don't like doing 6-10 hours of homework a week, try to take someone else.
Good, not great. He was funny, direct, and had reasonable exams. But he imposes poor effort of the few onto the masses as if everyone is as smart as he is.
Easy class; He is incredibly invested in his students and willing to go the extra mile outside of class. If you have a choice, take him. If he's your only choice, be happy :)

I had him for 409 and was thrilled to come back for 420. Best professor I've had! Very helpful in and outside of class. Be sure to ask him about his cool tricks that he likes to show off for the class. Tests are fair and straightforward. Homework is challenging but fair.

Amazing professor!!! Basically a kid at heart and loves to joke around. Is very willing to help outside of class and (if you attend class and he gets to know you) is one of the most down-to-earth professors on campus.
He is just great.
Fun, knowledgable, extremely willing to help and see his students succeed.

Professor Stepanov is an awesome professor. Though he's not always 100% clear in his lectures, he'll stay with you at his office hours till you understand the material. The exams aren't too bad, just study the examples and old homework problems. The book's pretty useless though.
Doesn't talk very loud, so sit in the front of the room if you want to hear what he is saying.
He's a very good lecturer. Willing to help outside class. Discussion needn't attend. Many TAs office hrs. Exams are not that hard if study the study materials he posted. Definitely a taker!

Alex is the man!!! I came into this class not understanding statistics at all, and now I totally get it.  Plus he's a raving lunatic from Siberia.  About the only problem is that occasionally he gets too caught-up in imaginary emotional drama with the class and forgets to teach for a few minutes.  Exams are not hard at all provided you did the hw.
kick ass

Gets mad at students for not coming to class and for not putting in enough effort.  Its kinda like high school.  Pretty easy class, more work than I wanted STAT 100 to be, but its very possible to do well.  Very doable, but a bit unpleasant.  Take Fireman if you can.

Great professor, very helpful, funny, and nice! Material is easy and he explains very well. Tests and homeworks are pretty easy. If you show up to lecture, you'll be fine in the class. Looking forward to him in 469!

Alex is a good teacher just likes to jump around a lot. He gives out tons of extra credit and if you try a little you probably will get a good grade.  He likes to go on tangents about nothing and that can get confusing.  He also like to get mad at the students about not coming to class, not getting good grades etc.  But overall not a bad class

He is a very funny and friendly teacher, but has times where he gets mad at the students either for not participating or making stupid mistakes on exams. He makes corny jokes that keep the class interesting, and provides worksheets which contain example that are exactly like test questions. He also gives extra credit and is a very lenient grader.

Awesome professor. Makes class fun. He is strictly against curves, but offers extra credit opportunities to make up for it. Appreciates class participation and is always willing to help in and out of class.

Class is extremely easy if you are reasonably intelligent. Worksheets filled in during class are amazingly helpful. Overall very funny, hyper guy. Loves what he does which makes class enjoyable. Best professor I've had this year
awesome prof
Best professor at U of I.  Great teaching skills.  Kept the material interesting and exciting.
Overall a good professor and very knowledgable, but he speaks rather quietly and without a microphone, so get a seat up front. Has a tendency to flip out from time to time.

Some of the concepts in the class might be difficult, but Alex DEFINITELY deserves a 5 for helpfullness and clarity.  He goes above and beyond what is required and portrayed by the average professor.  He is MORE than willing to help with not only his classes but others in which he has knowledge as well.  The best professor I've had in my 4 yrs here
No Comments
Great teacher you'll be Missed Mr. S
Great professor!
I got a D in his class but not even mad at all I deserved it. He's a rough and tough grader be prepared to work hard in his class to even get a D.

Prof Suljic is a great professor with a lot of knowledge. He puts his best foot forward and puts all his knowledge into his students. He's very patience, soft, and gentle with how he delivers his content. He also knows when to be tough, stern, and strict with students. Overall, very confident and will call out and put students in their place.
yes just yes
Mr. Suljic is a dog real g
Great guy! Helped me a lot one on one -Judy Hernandez
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He thinks he's funny but he's not
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: He's alright talks too much
Best professor at Lake Forest

Super sweet professor with interactive lessons. It felt as if I was in high school with fun lessons and games to learn instead of just boring lectures. His style isn't just standing there lecturing he actually takes pride in his lessons and makes them fun and that's why we all learned so much from Professor Suljic. Textbook heavy and tough grader.
Tough grader, strict, but fair. Very helpful professor.
Great professor but tough grader.

One of my favorite professors at UIUC is especially helpful for ANSC majors. Although her exams are tough, if you study and pay attention in class, you will be fine. Truly cares about animals and her students, and if you need accommodations, don't be afraid to ask.

idk who said she was ableist bc that was a straight up lie. i have taken almost all of her courses with accommodations and she has always been so understanding, helpful, and kind about them. anyway, classes are interesting but the exams are kinda hard.

I like the course content, but the TA grading is awful. Hardly any feedback, and if you make any mistake they dock off a few points out of 10. This scale makes it way more difficult than it needs to be to get an A in a supposedly easy gen-ed class. All the lectures are youtube videos, you need to know what was said to pass the quizzes.

The course load of this class is fairly easy and interesting if you pay attention to modules. It felt simple, yet TA's take points off on projects without any fair feedback or explanation as to why. Participation on PackBack is required.

This professor is ableist and insensitive. If you are a student who is intellectually or developmentally disabled and/or needs any type of accommodation, I would not take any of her classes. The course work is ok, but as a professor... it's a never again from me.

Dr. Fischer is a kind person and teacher. When I had a panic attack from test anxiety, she let me finish the test later when I wasnt so anxious. She brings her dog to class often which is great for moral. Ive always found her lectures interesting and the tests straightforward without any trick questions. Would highly recommend her.
Great professor and fair grader. Attendance isn't mandatory but there's info given in class that isn't on the slides and is on the exam. She'll sometimes bring her dog to class.
Very nice. Her instruction is very clear.
She is extremely difficult as a professor to talk to and as a grader. She is very subjective and despite you knowing the information will not give you a fair grade on exams and projects.

She's a great professor. I really enjoyed this class. There's a short online portion every week (2-3 short articles) with a easy 10pt quiz that you can take 3 times. There's 2 lecture sessions a week and they almost always let out 20 minutes early. It's really easy but you have to go because she gives pop quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Tests? Not many--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: She's a great teacher! She knows a lot and explains material very well. She's a fun teacher and the material is easy to understand. I highly recommend this class! As long as you do everything, you should get an A!

EASY class. No final. Just go to lecture and discussion, do weekend posts, and take a few quizzes. Class is a bit one sides (animal rights) so it may make some people mad. Some weeks are very emotional too. Guests speakers are great overall. This class is great to take with ANSC101 if you want conflicting viewpoints.

Great class to take if you want an easy gen ed. All you have to do is go to class.There are no exams and only 4 online quizzes. The reading is easy and you don't even really have to do it.There are some interesting guest speakers too. If you like animals, its a great class for you. Easy A. =] Just don't use your cellphone in class....

The class itself is fine, but this professor is VERY uptight. She will take student's reading materials if it does not pertain to class, call students out for 'not paying attention' in class, and is very one-sided. I recommend the class itself, but only if it is not with Professor Fischer.

I do not recommend the class. It was a very one-sided opinion based class that did not accomplish it's purpose. I don't appreciate the biased books we were asked to read. Most classwork was about animal welfare, not animals' place in society as the course description reads. I was completely unimpressed.

She focuses way too much on tiny details that are a way to prove you have read the book.  She can't write a decent exam question to save her life - everything was vague or confusing.  She is selfish, not open to other opinions, has no interest in students.  She would be better at a high school.

Class had potential but taught in a terrible manor. Very skewed format, you had to conform to her ideas in order to do well. She focuses on dates and names rather than content or the 'big picture'. Very tricky exams/quizzes. Not very helpful or friendly at that. Would NEVER take a class with this prof again. She has no interest in her students.

Totally recommend this class. Not too difficult. Exams are mostly based off the weekly online quizzes. Excellent class to take for the life science gen ed. Course is all about dogs and cats, so if you like animals, you'll love it. Very interesting subject material, enjoyed the class. It's not too hard, but there certainly is some studying involved.

This class is very interesting and informative. The professor, however, does not make time for her students. Does not care about their level of comprehension, or the quality of information she is teaching. Many of the lectures focus on teaching about her "causes" but to not actually convey up to date or accurate information.

material is extremely easy at first, then gets harder. basically just learn about dogs and cats. should go to lecture because the notes on compass arent very detailed..shes very easy to understand and knows what shes talking abuot. my lecture is at 9am and i still always go because i like the way she teaches. need to study for exams and quizzes

She is a very kind professor and you can tell she has fun with the material. I took this class for a Gen Ed requirement, but it gave me a better understanding of astronomy. Her style of teaching tends to rely a lot on slides, but the material isn't super difficult. There are many extra credit opportunities.

Took this as a POT A online class and thoroughly enjoyed it. Weekly assignments were very manageable and the exams were not difficult if you did a little bit of studying. You have to buy the eText to be able to do some of the homework assignments. Prof was very responsive and helpful!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Pretty flexible overall if you had to make up a class.

I took astronomy 100 online, so I never met her, but she was always sending weekly or even multiple reminders per week about what was due or to reach out to her if you needed help. From what I could tell, she was very caring and easily reachable.

Class is fairly easy. First unit covers Newton's laws, telescopes, next covers planets, final covers all else in the solar system. Moodle is used for discussion posts. 2 midterms, both with 2 big cheat sheets allowed. Final exam can be online or in person, is unproctored, open book. Discussion section boring at times; lets out early. Free Textbook.

It's all online so you don't really need to reach out much unless help is needed. It is a pretty tough class as the material goes by vv fast in the 8 week course. She is very nice and wants to make sure all students are finishing things. She sends out an email every week recapping everything. Make sure to finish things ON TIME or it'll be VV hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Amanda Winans was a good teacher overall, it was the exams that were the most difficult for me. The work is durable and you can go at your own pace which is nice. However, the labs and exams are quite difficult so I would definitely take notes.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: honestly this wasn't my favorite course. it's pretty easy though IF you have the time in your schedule to concentrate on learning it. i had a full course load and this course just seemed like a bother to me. some of the instructor's resources aren't the most clear, wasn't a fan of the mandatory textbook (you have to buy it to do the quizzes)

If you genuinely just do the homework and pay attention and maybe attend office hours here and there you will no doubt get an A. She does not want you to fail, she also gives pretty easy opportunities for extra credit. Great QR2 class.
spends half of the lecture yapping and half of it explaining things very vaguely

Easy but interesting. She isn't a prof that doesn't realize they are teaching a 100 level gen ed class and makes it easy to pass if you just put in a reasonable amount effort. There are 5 day late periods that I recommend trying not to use and you are allowed a page of notes for exams. Best part is getting to go to the observatory twice!

Even though Ms.Winans is a decent instructor and is quite humorous at times, I find her lectures to be sometimes poorly structured. Further, some of her assignments, announcements, and pages are sometimes vague and hidden. Even though her class is pretty much an easy pass, it gets frustrating sometimes.

I don't have much of an opinion of Winans since she's not in the lesson videos. What I can say though is that the course is just a lot of work but is quite easy. I took an Astronomy course in HS so I basically breezed through everything. You can work as far ahead as you'd like and she's generous with extra credit and due dates.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Ms. Winans is a very chill professor who makes sure to accommodate students' needs. There is a 5-day late policy which helps out a lot. Lectures are online and go at your own pace, and lecture is used for reviewing the topics learned. Overall a great course, beware of the math though since that caught me off guard!

If you keep up with the homework (max two hours a week- very manageable) the class is very easy. You can attend lectures online or in person, she's super chill and always willing to offer help. Final is fully open note, others tests you're allowed a cheat sheet. She wants her students to get good grades, so if you put in the effort you'll be good.

You can take the lectures online or offline, no questions asked. Final exam is open note/open textbook/open classmate, her own words. Pay attention in class and it's a cakewalk. Ms Winans is absolutely hilarious and is really awesome. Lots of options for extra credit, and not a lot of homework either. The worksheets really make you think. 10/10.

Class is online on Moodle, IMO an archaic site that's terrible to navigate. Lessons are helpful with a plethora of informational videos. Has a 2 day late submission policy for assignments which is a lifesaver, really helpful and respectable. Class is interesting albeit has a decent amount of homework. Exams are on Zoom with camera on but open note.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I wasn't very happy with the amount of work in this class but Winans was great. I had trouble connecting for the first online test and she let me reschedule from the 7pm slot to the 8pm slot and responded to my emails immediately. The textbook can be a little overwhelming but the test questions are closer to the homework anyway.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The ProctorU makes an exam which should take only 50 minutes like 2 hours long and it is very annoying. Since it is an online class, the Professor pretty much does nothing except for replying to personal emails, which shows to everybody in the class, and there's just tons of unnecessary homework which don't help at all.

The difficulty was reasonable for an introductory class, and thought the hybrid format of online lessons and in-person lectures was great. She takes the time to explain the material and is always interactive with students' questions. The tests are fairly easy if you keep up with the material, and can use a page of notes as well. Recommended class!!

Professor Winans is really great. The subject itself is hard but she's always willing to help and actually wants you to do good. She gives us a free textbook and the classwork isn't too difficult, just make sure you study for exams. Even the exams aren't too complicated. She's a pretty fair grader and doesn't want her students to struggle.

She gives you the textbook for free, has very flexible lectures on both zoom and in person, and does not take attendance. Offers help when needed and is very understanding of things that prevent you from attending lectures/discussions. She is happy to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I took the 8-week class. More difficult than expected but thankfully she curves exams (brought me back to A). There are lots of opportunities to get your grade up (homeworks, labs, "misconception" discussions, etc.) and if you have any questions Winans runs a study session before each exam. She's a great prof. and I'd recommend her!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: the lessons are so drawn out and long, and her tests are proctored online
She makes lectures pretty interesting. she also allows one note card for the notes on exams. Class difficulty is somewhat Easy as long as you show up the class
Horrible professor, DO NOT TAKE
Good lecturer, difficult tests, available extra credit, make friends!!
Super easy class as long as you show up and do the work, Winans makes the lectures interesting and fun too. For exams you get a notecard so it' almost hard to fail

She is a kind teacher, reminding homework and quizes before every classes. If you have any question, she is always willing to talk with you respectly. However, her powerpoints lack of structure, and sometimes just read through the slides, with quick, short explanation and not enough time to take notes.
If it's Mandi vs Hutches, take the latter. This one can't teach.
Avoid at all costs. One of the worst in Tax
There are too many assignments and projects, and the professor doesn't seem to adequately balance the time constraints with the number of questions during exams
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Prof Alt was amazing. Tax is not exactly my thing and I struggled considerably in 312. Alt was excellent at simplifying complex topics and summarizing the main points you need to know. She spent nearly 20 years in private practice before teaching, bringing considerable knowledge and experience with relevant examples Always accessible outside class!
10/10 prof

Very kind and considerate. Expect to do lots of reading and analysis in outside of class, but the overall work itself is not difficult. all notes are handwritten as well. I should add that I took CW100.

Had her for Fiction WS II and she was super flexible and caring! She did a great job of being socially conscious without being too strict. Easily available for individual help. When she got excited during workshop, she'd sometimes dominate the conversation a bit, but that's my only complaint. Would definitely take another course with her!

I love her so much! She's hilarious and it's clear she loves what she does. The class has a couple of essays with very clear instructions. Attendance is taken by answering a couple of questions about the readings at the beginning of each class. She's always willing to meet and gives great feedback!

Prof. Clay is an amazing lecturer and teacher. Lots of assignments, but each only takes 10-15 minutes (if even). Hilarious and kind person as well who cares very deeply about her students' success. I do recommend making friends in the class early on to work with because there is a lot of partner / group work. Very accommodating of differentiation.
I loved Prof. Clay! She was really willing to help students and flexible with deadlines etc. She held us to a high standard and my French improved so much while in her class!

The class isn't structured the best as we didn't really focus on grammar and then were expected to know it, but that's a gripe with the class and not the professor. Amy Clay is a genuine human being who really just wants people to grow and get better at french. Other aspects of the class were wonderful, and overall she's a fantastic teacher.

Disorganized lectures. Not too complex content (esp. if you take other bio anth. courses), but the unclear lectures make it hard to understand. Textbook was my saving grace BUT readings on syllabus did not align with lectures so notes were difficult. Exams had uncovered content. Only 1/6 assignments graded. Lightly racially profiled a student once.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Ambrose is a very knowledgeable man, and I would love to hear about his experiences OUTSIDE of class. However, I am writing this the night before the final class and I don't have a grade in this course. I have done 4 essays and a midterm (which was 3 weeks later than he said it would be). 0 grade. Be prepared to do a lot of work with no reward.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Ambrose's class for ANTH 358 is difficult, but understandably so. He discusses a broad range of material that he is incredibly well-versed in, and the lectures themselves are fascinating to sit through. His speaking is quite monotone, but I didn't find that I minded, and thoroughly enjoyed his teaching.

Dr. Ambrose is knowledgeable about all the different paradigms of the history of evolution. However, he is extremely unorganized and you are only graded on 6 things that involve, 3 exams and 3 essays. Also there is a lot of different readings he suggests. A ton of it is interesting but wasn't doable because I had other courses to focus on.

I want to like Professor Ambrose so bad. In fact, I DO like him. But not as a teacher. He's clearly very knowledgeable and has done a lot of very interesting things in his life such as his studies in Africa, but he cannot teach or lecture. He goes on tangents that are completely irrelevant to the class.

I've never had another professor like Ambrose. He doesn't really lecture. He talks, tells anecdotes, makes sure to pass around a hominin skull or stone tool in every class. He keeps you up to date with the latest genetics research. I learned a lot in his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The guy is super smart but he cannot teach a class. His lectures often have nothing to do with the readings, he's vague, he rambles and has tangents, and his class has very little structure. Again, he's very passionate and intelligent, he's just not good at articulating his message or going out of his way to make the course easier for students.

Brilliant and has lots of great examples from his experiences working in Africa. It's unfortunate that he's not a very engaging lecturer. Exams are fair for the most part, but you need to study the book (which is pretty dull).
His teaching was a bit boring. I learned a lot more from the TA than from him. The exams aren't terribly hard if you study.

he was one of the most boring teachers i have ever had. He knew a lot about the subject but the lectures were terrible. I would just read the book and download lecture slides. Do not go to lecture and waste your time.

I enjoyed Prof. Ambrose in class. He speaks in a monotone voice, but if you listen to him he is rather hilarious. He tests off his lecture notes and they are really simple tests. He puts the slides online (without pictures.) Take this class if you are interested in the subject otherwise you'll be bored (not because of him.)

Dr. Ambrose is extremely intelligent but often gets way off course during lectures. Study off the lecture notes he posts online, they are WAY more concise than notes taken from his PowerPoints. There are only 2 multiple choice exams and they take 20 minutes tops. The lectures can be kind of dull, but the material is good. Take this, it's an easy A.

He really loves anthropology, but sometimes makes learning the information difficult if you DONT really love it.  He's pretty entertaining though, just because hes pretty awkward.  Hes a nice guy and will try to answer any questions you have.  You will probably learn more from the TAs in this class, than from the professor.
Very boring and quiet lecturer. He's a smart man, but not the best teacher.  He doesn't seem that friendly or approachable.

Boring, boring lecture.  He is very knowledgeable but speaks in a monotone voice and dims the lights during lecture...that calls for NAP TIME!  Don't bother buying the book(s) -- you don't look at it once the whole semester!!
Lecture is boring, but he's pretty funny. It's hard to study because he gives no clues as to what will be on the test. Don't even buy the book.
Professor Ambrose is a world-class scientist. He is renowned in his field and extremely knowledgeable. Its a pleasure to learn from the best.
Just awful
Good guy.  I like him.  His jokes are great... hilarious even.

WORST class ever! Whatever you do, do NOT take this class. He is smart but does not know how to present the material in an intersting way. He dims the lights and speaks in a monotone voice. If you actually go to lecture, you will want to shoot yourself. Also, the final is very hard!
Although his voice is monotonous, his jokes are hilarious.
my god i slept all the time, his monotone voice and horrible jokes are enough to make you want to die, good thing all his notes are online, take this class for the easiness not the teacher!
No Comments
Boring, but very smart and very thourough. No BS from this Prof.
Whisper-quiet and extremely boring.

Professor Hassinger is a good professor. However after you have checked your written critiques by using grammarly for spelling issues and other mechanical issues and also have read it yourself and it makes sense. She seems to still not understand your written critiques.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Absolutely fantastic instructor. One of my favorite teachers ever. 10/10 would take again.

Professor Hassinger was overall just a great teacher. She gives timely feedback that actually helps you move forward with your work instead of surface-level criticisms. Even though it was an online class, I felt as though she cared about my writing and my personal improvements over the length of the course. 10/10.

Something about Hassinger makes you like her. She's insightful, inspirational, positive. Her voice when she reads is so full of emotion. The class is pretty easy, attendance is mandatory you have to be there AND discuss in class. Two short stories over the semester with other minor assignments / reading. Really take this class if you like cw!

I loved this class. It was consistant and he made sure that we understood what was being taught. None of the work we had to do outside the classroom was majorly difficult. Professor Jain was engaging and was always willing to help with anything I needed.

Atul is an accomplished scientist who is one of the best in his field but immensely struggles to teach. The structure of the class is messy & nonsensical. Studying for this class is impossible as questions don't relate to taught topics. He rarely responds to emails, so good luck getting feedback. Best of luck ATMS students, this was a rough class
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Jain is an accomplished scientist with an impressive resume.  Unfortunately, he's not very skilled at constructing online classes for undergrads.  He casually throws out letters for chemical compounds without giving any reference to what he's speaking about. 50% of the grade is for the final exam, but he doesn't tell you anything about it.

Atul is a nice guy and an expert in his field, he answers questions effectively and is passionate. BUT:
DISORGANIZED. Harsh grading, very late, little feedback given. 75% of the grade is decided by quizzes and 2 midterms with incredibly vague questions. Studying is a waste, you won't get an A either way. ATMS majors, good luck. Non-ATMS, run away
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Assignments and essays in this class were not that hard. I really like the professor, he's always willing to help and quick to respond to emails. Would definitely take a class with him again.

Literally the best professor at UIUC. I've taken two courses with him and have loved both so so much. Literally one of the biggest reasons I chose to apply to UIUC again for grad school was because I knew he would be a great resource. Great professor, great, lectures, great dude.

Definitely will take Professor Atiles Osoria's course again in the future if he teaches any. SOC 310 was super easy, as long as you put time and efforts into the essays, and do well on quizzes, you will be fine. There wasn't any big exams, only 10 quizzes but are untimed. The essays have very clear prompts and grading criteria. Overall Love It!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Professor Atiles is one of the best teachers I've ever had, period. He's very clear on the topics being covered. I haven't read 95% of the assigned readings, but I have an A because he explains everything so well in class and engages with his students. As long as you show up, pay attention, and take a few notes you're good.
I loved his Sociology of Deviance class! Straightforward assignments and instructions, quizzes, put in your work and you will end up with a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Love love LOVE Prof. Osoria! I always look forward to his classes. He's very approachable and always makes sure his instructions and expectations are clear. Strongly recommend taking ANY of his classes, you won't regret it!
I loved SOC 310 with him! Made class very engaging which can be hard during zoom lectures. I moved around my schedule for the upcoming semester just so he could teach one of my classes.

He's very approachable and is happy to offer advice on classwork, career goals, and more. 401 was a writing course, and he gave line-by-line comments on every increment. Really cares about his students and super helpful.

The textbook is not really used. Lectures are monotone, but if you participate, he becomes more animated. Tons of extra credit.
BEST PROFESSOR EVER HAD. He gives tons of extra credits. Use that well people!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: The lectures might seem a bit dry since he just summarizes the textbook. The biggest component of the class is the HW which is challenging if you're working alone but if you work in a group, it's pretty easy. The first couple of HW's are hard, but the rest are manageable. No tests or exams besides the weekly lecture quizzes. Fair grader as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: a king. office hours are your savior because homework is 50% of the grade which I really like actually. the homework is hard because of this but if you go to office hours you can get through it. he is so nice and so funny and during online office hours, he'd always check to see how we were doing during the pandemic. a real gem.

Professor kemball's class was one of the few classes I really looked forward going to. Even though he seemed lethargic during lectures, learning the material was still really exciting for me. Really helpful with homework after class and in office hours.

Dr. Kemball is a relatively good professor. His lectures can be a bit dry, and participation in them is graded by 1-3 iClicker questions during the lecture. Homework can be a bit challenging sometimes, but he provides an extra credit question on each homework and test, and he allows for a cheat sheet during tests which do help.

He speaks a little lethargically, which makes lectures a little unexciting. Runs an easy course where moderate effort is returned with a good grade. Offers a ton of optional extra credit. Online quizzes are fairly simple so long as you have the textbook on hand.

There is a lot of material covered in the class so that's no fun. However, he provides plenty of opportunity to still get a good grade. Multiple chances to complete HW. Lots of extra credit opportunities. Good at dry humor, makes lectures interesting. Have lots of respect for this professor.

Prof. Kemball loves his students and loves what he teaches, but you can tell he is more interested in his research. He brought us cookies and coffee every friday! :) The class was not too bad (dry lectures) with a cheat sheet on each test. I loved the content of the class and Kemball was so kind and warm-hearted!
I clicker points (minimal), group project, extra credit (close to like 15%), its easy and interesting--usually. He's also happy and a nice guy. Take it.

First off, by far one of the coolest classes I have ever taken. The professor is a straight up dog! He's super nice, funny, and helpful. He assigns a bunch of extra credit and very little EASY homework. Exam is easy if you just review your homework. Once again awesome teacher.

Professor Kemball is great! He is seriously so nice and will help you with anything you need. The class was very interesting and he kept your attention with the fascinating things you learn about Astronomy. He definitely knows what he is talking about and overall doesn't assign too much homework. 1 assignment a week...and reading...def recommended!

This guy is so helpful; if u do his homework carefully u would definitely get a high mark on the exam. 80% of the exam questions are among the homework which is once a week.
