And if u do good on mid-term, u could replace the relative part in the final with the score u achieved earlier. The best prof ever.

GREAT professor. He knows what he is teaching and really enjoys it. I have heard other astronomy classes are not easy but this is easy AND interesting. you DO have to study for tests or at least show up for class  if you want an A but you get a cheat sheet. also, there's extra credit opportunities.

Love Prof. Kemball. One of the best teachers I've ever had. He's excellent at explaining things and really does try to make it a class everyone can do well in. There's a ton of extra credit offered. Plus, he makes it interesing and has a really cool accent.

I didn't have the textbook and slacked off majorly in this class and still got a B. It was interesting material too! Athol is the man, he adds a lot of cool animations to his power points. You can copy and paste all the homework questions into google and get 90% of the answers although if you pay attention you won't need too.

Amazing professor. He offers a lot of extra credit. He is very approachable and friendly. He realizes this is just a gen ed, but he still managed to keep my interest.He had open office hours for 8 hours the day of the final because that's just the kind of guy he is. If you want a safe, fun, and friendly gen ed, this is not a bad decision at all.

Kemball is such a nice and friendly person. He is also a great professor who is not only knowledgable in the subject, but also very engaged in it too. The class isn't too hard if you put some effort, and he also gives a lot of extra credit opportunities. You will definitely be awed by the things you learn about the universe and beyond.
Kemball is a very good professor. The lecture is very interesting but sometimes is a little hard to understand. He give a lot of extra credit which can help you get an A easily.

Professor Kemball is a very intelligent man who really knows what he is talking about. Lectures were very fun and engaging. His TA wasn't the best and towards the end of the semester he moved quite fast, but the class was easy to do well on and pretty interesting.
Best teacher I've had so far.  Really made class interesting, and his accent helped.  An EXTREMELY intelligent man, he really does a fantastic job.
Very hard (but interesting) material. But Kemball has the COOLEST accent and gives you a lot of opportunities to improve your grade.

Very nice guy who knows a lot about the subject.  Sometimes he gets a little monotone but still a good teacher.  He has excellent powerpoints and a lot of homework/ extra credit opportunities.  He's also british; love the accent!

He pretty much explains everything, and has awesome power points that he tells you to print out to make notes insanely easy. Homework is also not that hard generally, and you get three tries on it. definitely an awesome professor.

This professor is amazing. He has the coolest english accent, which makes you just want to hear him talk.  The class isn't at all difficult, and if you do all of the extra credit offered, it can raise your grade 13.5%. He is very approachable also.
Extremely helpful. Spoke very clearly and went at a good pace. Very willing to help students and sends lots of emails before exams with preparation tips and ways to practice. Great professor

grading is harsh and unreasonable. For example, the homework has 9 problems, 20 pts total, 10 for completeness and 10 for correctness. But if 1 problem got wrong, you will lose 8 or 10 pts. The class structure is disaster. Group study does little help on learning, but waste class time. Lectures are unrelated with homeworks.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: He is a nice guy but the class structure is not so good! I disagree that the class is group projects. It was the students forced to teach each other and even lecture in front of the class! Textbook is also not so good because it requires understanding group theory but math 402 is not a requirement!

Jayadev is an excellent instructor who clearly loves math. He's a total and unabashed nerd for math; for some (like me) this is great, for others not so much. He's always extremely helpful in office hours and his assignments and grading are completely fair. His math 301 class has group projects and a final paper but no exams.
The exams weren't too bad. He was a great professor, in my opinion.

Very smart guy but horrible at lecturing. Doesn't understand why people don't comprehend all of calc 3 as easily as he does. Gets pretty frustrated when people ask questions and uses powerpoints to teach (it doesn't work super well). I would steer clear of him if you could
Terrible at teaching and had an awful personality to deal with when trying to get help or communicate about classwork.
Not a suitable teacher for the level of the course.

One of the worst professors I have EVER had. He is extremely cocky and expects you to understand the material with very little instruction. He utilizes no examples in class and his teaching methods are very poor. I had to learn everything on my own! He is getting paid to do nothing at all! DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS!!!

Prof Athreya is not a very good lecturer. He is overconfident to a fault and his lectures are straight from the textbook. I would recommend a different lecturer. Most of the test material is also right in the book. The textbook is a must have, though I recommend choosing a different lecturer.

If you have any other choices besides this professor, please pick the other one. I have to say his lectures can actually make you even more confused on the subject that is being taught. After the first exam, I did not attend one lecture and surprisingly got an A on the second midterm. Just dont pick this guy.

I feel like when Professor Athreya lectures he is just telling you what he knows, which comes off as slightly smug. When it comes to lecturing you have to prove to your students that the concepts make sense. Not just tell them with a smile. I'll be back next semester too if wants to give it another try.
Did't even bother going to his lectures. Just read the book by myself and learned on my own. The TA was really nice and was the only useful resource in the course.
The worst professor ever. nothing helpful. DONT GO TO CLASS.
No practice exams, only goes over theory in class, and no examples, and is very cocky.

He is the cockiest professor I've met. He focuses too much on the technicalities of running the class without focusing on the actual content. His lectures are completely useless because he is so vague and his ppt slides are just scans of the book. He also rarely provides examples to the concepts he's teaching. Just use Paul's Online Math Notes.
If you learn math well from powerpoint definitions this is your guy. Too smart for his own good. Cant believe I pay to go listen to him.

He's a pretty poor professor. His ego is off the charts, and he doesn't attend his own office hours. Completely unprofessional, and he even stated in class that he refuses to do examples. I would try to avoid him if I were you.

His way of "teaching" consists of throwing out definitions and expecting you to ask your TA if you need any real help. You essentially have to teach yourself from the book. He also gets distracted really easily by phones and conversation, and will stop class for 5 minutes just to complain about it.

Extremely stressful. The work done in class was all example problems in the book. The curving is the only good thing about the class. We'd go over easy stuff in class, but the exams would have extremely difficult problems. I'd suggest buying the homework solutions manual because it taught me way more than he did.

If you've previously taken a calc class this class is relatively easy. Curved 10% on every test and then curved class as a whole. The final was extremely hard but curving the class definitely made up for that.
Don't take this guy. He rushes everything. His final was unreasonably hard. Curve is shtty.

I had him for Business Calc...  It seemed like he was just rushing through the course trying to fit information in. DON'T take this class with him if you haven't taken calc before!! the class was unfair for people who haven't taken calc before because the people who have taken it brought up the curve.
fabulous
great
No Comments
No Comments
i really didn't like her class:(
very nice, let us out early.
awesome!
Really friendly and fun!
This TA grades arbitrarily and will not be fun. Rhet is bad enough, you don't a bad TA to go along with an already bad class. Switch TA's now or you'll regret it.
No Comments
No Comments
No Comments

You would be hard pressed to find a professor who cares more about their content or their students. She is an absolute delight and her courses are perfectly structured, you know exactly what's expected of you from the jump. Rather than a long-form essay, our final  was to make contributions to a Wikipedia page, it was genuinely fun to work on!

CLCV 220: Dr. Austen is one of the best professors! Her classes are structured and clear. Rubrics and expectations are clear from day 1. Her class is very interesting. No exams, just short essays. She is very understanding when it comes to life happening and is very easy to contact. If you need a gen-ed, take this class. Best decision ever.

Highly recommend any of Dr Austen's classes. Not only is she kind but she teaches well and actually make sure that you leave knowing new things not just memorized things. You'll be engaged in class discussions and it will be fun I promise. Don't be scared to ask her questions Dr Austen is probably the most approachable professor I've ever had.
He was alright.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He's just a bad teacher. The discussions are so boring and drawn out. When you go to office hours, he may be helpful but in an awful way. I had to change my thesis which changed my entire paper a day before it was due. Who does that?! He is completely narrow minded. Bottom line - Don't take him.

I went into this class expecting an easy class that would not do much for my writing. The class was tougher than expected but I finished a  better writer. Austin is a great instructor and will take the time to clarify how  you can improve. If you seriously want to improve your writing take this class.

Austin is a very nice person. His grading is very tough, but it caused me to become a better writer. Word of advice: take risks, be different, and personalize your essays. Boring and cliched papers will get you a lower grade. Also, be active in class. This is NOT an easy-A class like others say, so prepare to work for that A, but i would recommend.

Austin is so annoying, he complains about everything then gives all his students C's and B's.  Writing an A paper is nearly impossible, and he just dishes out B's like nobody's business.  He loves to assign pop quizzes the SAME DAY THE PAPER IS DUE because he hates his life and wants his students to be miserable.  I only learned how to BS a paper.

Your writing will improve with Austin.He is very intelligent,and an interesting person.He does not give out good grades,but if you meet his clear expectations and make an honest effort you will do fine.Take advantage of his office hours,he critiques your paper and tells you what to fix.I am a better writer because of him,but it was not easy work.

Not as easy as all the other students claimed him to be... you actually need to meet his expectations! However, these are clearly stated and if you go in for additional help ... he'll gladly assist you. Plus really interesting discussions... really funny professor.

Austin is awesome, but this semester he gets really harsh on papers and readings. We've had lots of pop quizes about the readings. Probably he knows that previous students say his class is easy, he now gets really really harsh! Students in our class are definitely struggling. But he is a really good instructor!

Austin was a really good instructor, but for a 100-level English course, this was way too demanding. The readings took a really long period of time to complete. The papers were tough because he is pretty strict on writing. Also, I did enjoy the discussions held in class. Austin really allows you to speak your mind.
Clear, funny, and really wants the students to learn. The class never gets boring with Austin. Easy class, though not a complete blowoff.

Austin is very... different to say the least but in a very positive way. His approach is very unique and down to earth. He is no way intimidating nor does he make you feel awkward about your answers but encourages any comment you might make and relates it to the class. Overall he's awesome.
Easiest English class in my life!

If you walk into his class already having taken AP Lit or any other intensive English class, this will be a joke. Great man, very basic expectations. Cancels class 3-4 times a month. Shows movies. Gives great paper assignments. IF YOU TAKE RHET 105 IT MUST BE WITH AUSTIN! I hear other sections are unbearably hard, but his is a joke if you try a bit
If you mess us on a paper, he lets you redo it. It is almost impossible to get a C in his class. He told us what he expected and if you did that, you usually got a solid grade.
Very responsible and helpful teacher. Also a humorous guy.
No Comments

Good teacher. He was very helpful and had good discussions with the class. But, he is very opinionated. I got good grades on all the papers, he really wants the people in his class to be better writers and it shows with the help he gives us.
Professor Johnson is overall a good professor. She gives very detailed and helpful feedback on assignments. I'd say her only downside is that the lectures can be a bit dry and lack energy.

She is a fun professor and although I took this class because I needed the credit I would take it again. Yes there are some papers assigned but you can get them done the day before and as long as you reach the word count you can turn it in for feedback and you wont actually get graded on it until you turn in your portfolios.
Lectures tended to be boring but overall not too bad of a class. Audrey isn't too tough of a grader and most grades were just short attendance assignments and some papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easy grader but very boring lectures and unorganized course page.
Professor Espiritu was terrible at using technology so therefore it was horrible to catch up on lectures. His guidelines were hard to follow and his grading was done on a whim

The professor's class was generally easy if you keep up with the work you do. It's not too hard to get a good grade but my only complaint is that his lectures are not as engaging as I hoped they would be. He tends to mostly read off the slides, so by the end of the semester not many people go to his lectures

Great professor and great class, although it might seem like a lot of work for a 100 course. You don't have to show up to lectures, but they're interesting nonetheless. Professor Espiritu is enthusiastic and often shares his own experiences relating to the course. He loves when students ask questions. Grading, even for papers, is pretty lenient.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DON'T take this class if you're looking for an easy A. Avoid You Lan as you're TA; she marks half your attendance points down if you're more than 5 minutes late, makes everyone participate otherwise you get half off, and is a harsh grader. The materials and textbooks for this class are also SO expensive and barely offer free online versions.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: The only reason why i took this class was because his reviews said he was an easy A. This course is in fact, not an easy A. His lectures are so incredibly redundant, boring, and unhelpful. And I mean, incredibly. boring. Also be careful with your TA, You Lan is an incredibly tough and unreasonable grader and I would avoid her at all costs.

Professor Espiritu is kind and really wants to see his student succeed. We had to switch to a different professor midway in the semester but there wasnt an issue. Professor Espiritu requires you to be actively participating during discussions but the class itself is not hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I took this class on Term B (last 8 weeks of class). Fairly easy class. He collects attendance. Had 2 quizzes instead of 3 because of time-limit. Final was a 3 paged essay. He loves it when students engage with him. As long as you come to class, study the slides for the quiz, and make the final essay, you should be able to get an A. PS He's Kind!!

Professor Espiritu is incredibly well prepared and knowledgeable about the given topic. He always shows up to class with insightful lectures and perspectives, and sometimes he opens up the class to discussion. There is a good amount of reading but the books were easy to read and he recaps the information in his lectures. Top notch teacher.
He's not bad. Fair grader on essays

Professor Espíritu cares a lot about the topics which we teaches. Overall super nice guy & very approachable. His lectures are awful though, very long and drawn-out. Hardly went to class, just did readings on my own. Grade breakdown:  1 Midterm, 1 Quiz , participation, 1 homework assignment, 1 short paper & 1 take home final.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very easy class. Never need to go to lecture. Never need to read. One midterm, one essay, one final.
I took this class last year. Prof Espiritu is a great guy, and his syllabus is extremely fair. just make sure you attend lecture and take notes.
Great professor, attend lecture and discussion and youll do fine!! T.A's are extremely helpful- Merin and a nice guy that I personally did not have. Great class, interesting

His class is super easy, midterm is directly from the notes. Easy A on the midterm. He knows his stuff and his T.A's are nice (Merin and a nice guy) go to lecture everyday, bc thats where all the info is said (dirctly from slides) Movies are interesting

He was very nice, but his lectures were very boring. His multiple choice tests were very easy, and his study guides explained exactly what would be on the exams. Grades are ultimately determined by TAs though the essay questions and papers.

Highly recommended...class had 3 midterms that were each 30 multiple test questions and he posts a study guide on compass a week before the test. Test questions were all from lecture. The final was only a 3-5 page paper. Attendance is taken but it's important to be there for notes anyways. Extra credit is offered. Take any class with him for sure
Reads off powerpoint slides for entire lecture. Very boring lecture but the info on the slides is exactly what's on the test. Final took 30 minutes. Easy A

Augoustakis truly loves the material he gets to teach, and it shows in his entertaining lectures. The class material is extremely easy if you have any interest in Rome, and Augostakis provides a concise summary of major events in Roman history, so you come out of the class really feeling like you learned a lot without any super hard assignments.

One of the best class I took in the U of I!! I am accounting student, initially I selected this class because it meets my western culture requirement. This class is last for 50 minutes each class and three classes every week. I hate this class at the first because the attendance is mandatory. But gradually I thought the class is too short.
He is a very good teacher, and cool guy. He makes the lectures interesting and fun. He has a lot of energy and talks very passionately about the subjects.
Cool teacher. He is a very good lecturer, and makes them very interesting and full of energy. The class is very easy.

Such an easy class. Although attendance is mandatory for iclickers, all the test questions are straight from the power points and are very straight forward. 3 short 500 word essays with easy prompts. Very energetic and loves to teach the topic. Would definitely recommend this class to anyone.
He's not hot, but he's an awesome teacher and really cool. Very easy class.

Prof Augspurger conveyed material clearly as well as the motivations for pursuing a career and vocation in ecology.  Her calm yet authoritative demeanor made a substantial impact on me personally when she joined us in the field and when I spoke with her directly. Thanks Carol, for everything you do.

This was the hardest class I have ever taken in my college career. It was awful. BUT, Dr. A is an amazing, caring, and super helpful. If you are willing to work hard, this is a really outstanding class to take. If you don't like to work, don't take it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: class is ALOT of work but you'll get so much out of it whether u want to or not. Dr. A is amazing. She takes time to know every student by face and name & really trains ur mind to be able to think in new ways. exams fairly hard but by the end of the semester u get used to how to think about & answer her questions. this class was mind blowing.

Dr. A is a pretty incredible person. She's accomplished loads and her experience seems limitless. As a teacher, she can get frustrating sometimes. When she speaks she can have a tendency to mumble. Her homework instructions can be vague. And she can be really picky on how she wants questions to be answered. Her exams can be tough because of this.
Dr. A is freaking amazing. Can I be her when I grow up? Yes, her class is a lot of work, but it's worth it. She is an incredible scientist, educator, and all-around person.
if you take lab, get ready to forget about your social life and buy a lot of coffee.

The best Professor I have ever had the fortune of working with. She will force higher quality work out of you than you ever thought possible; and then hold you to that standard. I have worked professionally with over 15 graduate degree holding ecologists; collectively they know (much!) less than Carol. Take her Ecology class!
Very knowledgeable and care about student a lot, teaching is her life now. There will be some papers but it's totally worthy. Take her class if you have a chance.

Dr. A is one of the hardest professor's I have had thus far. She really wants you to understand over-arching concepts and be able to think deductively. Despite how hard the class was it was hand's down one of the most influential classes I will ever take. Everyone should be required to take this class. Not an easy A.
Carol is very helpful, but this course do require a LOT effort.
Dr. A is not easy but she's hands down one of the best professors I've ever had.

You learn a lot about how to "do" science. Writing help from TAs is amazing and she seems to care about her students. HOWEVER, get exams will seem very intuitive and easy while you're taking them, but you'll get your grade back and wonder what in the world happened. Here's the answer: it's arbitrary. Random answers.

Class is unbelievable. She's very selfish in that she doesn't understand that the only reason why we're taking this course is because it's mandatory, not because we want to. This class took more time than organic chem.. messed up my semester because of this stupid class.

Dr. A is a super sweet woman who is passionate about Ecology and helping her students. Although the SDP projects are time consuming and the tests do not come easy, she and the T.A's are willing to help you if you go to office hours

The class was difficult, but I think that it set the standard for the rest of my career. It's a lot of work, lecture is mandatory, and I would recommend asking your TA questions to clarify confusing assignments. Carol is great, she asks a lot of her students, but I know how to write and test hypothesis and begin research papers.
Most difficult class I've taken at U of I so far. Material is easy but workload is not. Be ready for a lot of work.
Great professor.  Very caring and wants everyone to succeed.  Tests are pretty hard and 2 research papers are very work-intensive but do-able.  Super nice woman who wants to help.
A great class. Dr. Augspurger is an outstanding teacher and mentor!

The class is a way too much work. All the pointless inclass and before class activites end up being only 15% of your grade. On the other hand, you can still struggle with the exams despite understanding the concepts due to the convoluted wording of quesions- which is particularly bad when the exams are worth the majority of your lecture grade.

I graduated 2008 and am now heading on to grad school. Was very work intensive, and we did more adv. statistics for the lab reports than I did in my statistics class. If you plan on going into research, this is the one class that will prepare you the best. Enjoy it, she makes it this way for your own benefit and does her best to help if you ask.
Most difficult class I've taken at college by far. You better be ready for an insane amount of work that does not come easy

If you take this class be prepared to work extremely hard. She assigns in class assignments every lecture that you have to struggle to complete evertime. carol is very intense. For the in class assignments and tests you not only have to know the infomation, but also know how to write it properly which is difficult. Not to mention the 2 ten pg paper

you have to work in this class. carol expects a lot out of you and its a nightmare i would rather take organic chemistry than this class. you have to write two 10 page papers about seeds and stuff likt that. it is time consuming and boring. im so glad im almost done with this class
Very helpful and cares about students. Work very intense but if you do the work you can get an A. Hardest part is writing the scientific manuscripts.

She expects so much out of her students, so there are a lot of people that have bitter feelings towards her. While the cowbell may feel demeaning, it's a reasonable way to regain the attention of the class. She solidfied my desire to go into Conservation Biology.
Enormous amount of work...you are graded by in-class activities that count towards your exam grades so you CANNOT miss lecture. she's extremely intense and very hyper/fast paced.

She really cares about her students, and her teaching method is outstanding.  If you plan on a career in science, this class is probably the best undergrad prep you can get aside from independent study.  Those long assignments show you what the scientific method is in action.  Best prep course of my undergrad, helped me later on in so many classes.

Wow...carol is somebody else. She's extremely intense and makes you work constantly. This class is a TON of work. At some times it can be fun (catching fish in a river and working in forests/fields) but it's sooo much work. Probably the hardest class I've taken so far. Good luck with it...

Don't get me wrong, this class can be very challenging if you don't stay on-top of the work load. With that said, the class is really rewarding and I felt I learned a lot.  You can't ask for a better professor who  cares more about her students (after all she is in charge of the IB Undergrad Curriculum).

Ok, so she knows everyone's name...And that makes her awesome how???  Besides the fact that she is good at remembering faces, she should probably take the seriousness of the class down a notch.  Her in class activities are way too long, and its hard to keep up with filling the assignments out while she is lecturing and flying through the powerpoint
Simply amazing professor. She knows everyone's name, is completely fascinating. Challenging and time consuming course, but nonetheless wonderful.

The prof is really nice and she really does go out of her way to get to know your name. She teaches based on examples and her tests tend to revolve around interpreting graphs and "applying" what you "learned". If you're in the lab be prepared to write alot and spend lots of time in the forest.
Her classes were the staple of my college career.  Never a more caring and awesome professor at UIUC!  She absolutely loves what she does and it shows.

She was such a sweet lady and really cared about how her kids did in her class!  She can be a little intimidating calling on people randomly in class but the questions she asks aren't hard.  Her tests are all written so that was a little hard but she definitely knows what she's talking about and she seemed to to put a lot of effort into teaching.

BADM 378 is a really fun class to take with Professor Bahrini, he is an easy grader and his test are all multiple choice. He gives sample practice problems and sometimes gives practice problems that are exactly like the test, would take a class with him again!
Professor Bahrini is fantastic overall. Genuinely cares about his students and wants them to succeed, also has engaging lectures and useful assignments without being too difficult or overbearing.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Took his BADM 3Very chill professor, he's very funny and wants students to succeed. His office hours were very helpful and he explains concepts well.

Aram was a chill professor who knew how to make the subject understanding and enjoyable as well as empathize with students. He cared about his students and showed passion, gave dynamic and animated lectures. Students don't even zone out on their phones because he does so well.

Aram is a chill guy! He makes this class easy for other students and invests in his time to help. He clearly understands how hard this class can be and gives extra points. If you try your best and pay attention you can get an A or B

Such a cool guy. He understands that students just want to pass his class and he does his best to help everyone. Very lenient with grading and deadlines, EC opportunities, open notes exam, a group project for a final that he walks you through. Definitely take BADM 211 with him!
Dont take her class. I MEAN IT. Has a history of being inflexible.
Easiest class and easiest way to fill your humanities gen ed.

My favorite class I had last semester. Learned a lot and the professor made everything easy to understand. There are extra credit opportunities and homework shouldn't take long to complete.. There are lecture vids every week but aren't too long. There is one big project in the form of a presentation at the end of the semester. Great class.

Very easy class, a few lecture videos each week each around 10 minutes long and a discussion post. Basically no work the entire 8 weeks until you get to the 7-10 page paper due at the end but the discussions every week are used to start working on the points in your paper so it is very easy to write it all.

I took this class as a gen ed and it was pretty easy. The quizzes are just like the slides and if you do good on those you'll do good on the midterm and final. There is one project which is an essay but you work on parts of out throughout the 8-weeks so it wasn't too hard when it came time to complete it. Overall, would recommend.

Spring 2022. Attend lectures, pay attention, take notes and fill out study guides. There are pop quizzes worth 10 points 5 for just attending. Exams were pretty easy and based on lectures. Lectures were different individuals from Carle and other organizations talking about their roles in healthcare.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: It is very easy to succeed in this class. Attendance is mandatory in lecture because of in-class mini quizzes (similar to iclicker) but once you reach the max amount of points you do not need to attend anymore. Test questions are given during review sessions and exams are very easy. The only "time consuming" aspect is the essays.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: While her lectures are a little scattered, it is VERY easy to do well in this class. Exams are set up for your success. Dr. Traill also has a dry, witty sense of humor that make lectures very fun. There is a bit of reading, but all of it is covered in lectures (except for the plays), so the book really is just to help you get the stories down.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment:
Take if:
You have an interest in Greek myth
Have a good memory or take really good notes to assist your memorization of the content, or are willing to put in some hours studying if you don't have one or the other
Are willing to put maybe ~8hrs per paper of work into two to three ~5 page long essays (CLCV 115 only)
Don't if:
Under 2/3 of the above
Get ready for the most insane exams you'll ever experience lol

I could tell she tried to be relatable, and I appreciated the inclusions of pop culture stuff at the beginning of lecture that tied into the content for the day, but the class was miserable. I only took it cuz my sister took it six years ago, but that was a different teacher. Save your time and take a simpler gen ed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Pay attention to the readings and the questions given in class. You will have to study so if you're unwilling to work, you might want to rethink this class, but if you have an interest in greek mythology and pay attention to the readings, you'll do well.

Terrible professor. Lecture didn't matter, and tests had 75 questions over 150 different characters. If you're not good at memorization, don't take this class. It's not even Greek mythology, it's pure memorization.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--So many papers--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I think she's really nice, she's just not great at teaching. Her lecture slides were really hard to follow, and she goes too fast. Tests are also a lot of memorization, which can be a bit annoying. I do think she can be pretty lenient and is understanding about deadlines if you form a good relationship with her.

The only thing helpful about her lectures are the attendance quiz questions that may show up on the test. The real killer are the tests. You have to put in lots of time memorizing about 100 characters and storylines and terms for her 75 question tests. Studying for her class is brutal and tiring. Would NOT recommend this class.

Lectures were unprepared and all over the place in short. Interest in Greek Mythology diminished due to how all over the place content was. In full honesty, there were some good moments in lectures, but definitely not a GenEd you want to double dip on.

Going to lectures really helps. If you are looking to put in the minimal amount of work into this class you can get away almost entirely by only reading textbook chapters, and having a friend or chat gpt, or both help you with a weekly quiz on the extra material not from the textbook. Discussion sections are usually pretty fun.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: CLCV 323 with Professor Traill is the best class offered at UIUC. She is literally the sweetest, most intelligent person who cares so deeply for her classes, students, and general area of study. She has high standards but makes her assignments so interesting you always want to complete them and will generously give extra credit for extra effort.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Traill is a fantastic professor. She is very knowledgeable,  and flexible about deadlines if you talk to her. Gives great feedback and allows rewrites on essays to improve your grade. Lots  of fun in-class activities and discussions, she tried hard to make sure we enjoyed our class experience. I learned a lot and had fun - would recommend!
Great professor, tough class

If you are taking CLCV115 for an easy A and have no prior knowledge of Greek and Roman Mythology, then you are in for a surprise. There is a ton of material to know in this class, and it is brutal trying to memorize it all if you don't care about the subject matter. Do not take if you aren't very passionate about the subject!!!

Don't take this class. Her slides make no sense, she takes daily attendance points, and her tests are just insane. Way harder than a 100 level should be, especially since CLCV 115 was a class people take to get an A. She also sticks the mic into her mouth when she talks, so you can hear her moving her mouth during lecture.

Obviously very passionate about Greek Mythology. Every lecture is like story time, with a lot of interesting connections to other Gods and modern day. Her tests come from the reading questions almost exactly, so as long as you are willing to study, it is very clear what you need to be studying.

She is a HORRIBLE professor. Her slides in class don't make sense especially out of context. She makes a disgusting noise with her mouth when she lectures. Her tests are supposed to be based off of the reading questions but they aren't. This is a 100 level gen-ed class that isn't easy.

She's a horrible teacher. Makes an annoying smacking of her lips every sentence like her mouth never stops watering. Her lectures are terrible and don't correspond with the reading questions. Her tests are even worse and completely stupid. iClickers are annoying and graded every day

Ms. Traill is such an intelligent woman.  She really knows her subject well.  She also has a great sense of humor, as we talked about lots of controversial things in our Greek comedy class and she laughed with the rest of us.  Challenging, but you will learn a lot.
She is extremely enthusiastic about Latin and very clear. I didn't do so well because I never studied the vocab, other than that she is very fair and not too hard.

A great professor! Both Traills are excellent educators- a truly illustrious family in the field of classics (it's too bad her father Professor John Traill at the University of Toronto) is retiring shortly
moves so slow that the class learns the majority of material outside of classtime.
Class was chill and interesting. I enjoyed his energy and the autonomy he gave us to roam free. Also, bought us food for every single class so I'll take this again in a heartbeat!
We had a guest speaker come in and talk about AI. We were told our jobs would be taken by AI.

I had him not for 331 but for BADM420 but it wasn't listed an as option here. He is an AMAZING professor probably in the top 0.1% of professors. Really cares about teaching and the course was extremely enjoyable. I would take a class with him again and reccomend other people to as well.
Had a great experience in his digital marketing classes. Would take more courses from him. Very useful and engaging. Super nice guy
I have him this semester in person and I love him. Very interesting professor with group passion.

Pretentious. All of his online classes are worthless. He spends most of the time trying to "be cool" rather than teach anything of value. He like vinyl records so he must be the coolest person ever (eyeroll). I watch his videos on twice the speed and wish I could have watched them faster. I've lost respect for the University becasue of him.

Useless class. Lot of hype but does not help to get even an internship. Take a database or some other class instead. Do not waste your time and money. Aric is a super-boring teacher who makes you want to sleep in class.
He was alright in CEE190, better than all the other professors but is overshadowed by him. He was good for feedback but sometimes was unaware of what other professors told us (not his fault).

One of my favorite professors at the University of Illinois. Apart from messy handwriting, which he would clarify (slides are also provided). Nothing to complain about, and he cares more that you learned the course material than to try to trick you on exams. Definitely has improved on lecture slides over the years.

CEE weeder, all my groupmates switched out of the major. Rubrics are vague. Grading is very harsh and inconsistent. Expect to have points taken off for minor mistakes. Provided examples for papers are useless. Seek upperclassman help if possible. Schmidt is consistent with grading, approachable and gives good feedback. Nitpicky on details.
190 wasn't an option but took it with him, not 350. He's an absolute teddy bear and a great jolly guy, just CEE 190 is a nightmare of a course.

Prof. Schmidt loves the material and wants every student to do well. He lets you peer review others' tests and then you can redo your own to improve your score. Lots of groupwork in the class, things are generally well explained. Some sloppy organization so you need to be proactive. Great guy.

Great person, decent professor. Passionate about what he teaches, really ties in his classes to the real world and gives take home tests. However, his lecture slides are terrible to study off of, he assumes you have taken TAM 335 already, and he uses excel for sample problems, but his spread sheets are just jumbled messes of numbers.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Lectures are all over the place, with typically 30% of the time spent struggling with his computertabletAV. Very hard to follow along lectures, so go to office hours and make sure you understand every little thing. Or just ask a bunch of questions in class. Tests were insanely difficult. But you will be too busy with the project, so good luck...

Horrible professor with a horrible teaching assistant. Professor Masud doesn't teach very clear in class and homeworks require lots of additional work by yourself. Exams are hard and need large amount of time to prepare. Not a friendly class if you are only getting MS. If you would like a good grade, make some reliable friend.

This class is very bad. His explanations are often confusing and not helpful, and they are the only source of information. He provides a book on nonlinear FEM which he completely ignores leaving you without alternative sources. He tries to touch a wide variety of topics not explaining a single one clearly enough. A disappointment

So condescending, even laughed at a student's question in class. Asks non-guiding questions to your questions. She took lecture attendance at random weeks, to make you go just in case.
TAs are so kind and helpful though, office hours are your friend. but she can override their grades if they're too nice. no clear rubric for most labs. ~10hrs a week

Definitely came off as condescending when answering questions and didn't show much care/sympathy towards students. Had a family emergency come up the day before a huge report was due and she gave me a one-day extension and didn't seem to care. No clear grading rubric for reports, but the TAs were always super nice and helpful.

She's good at teaching, and made us learn a lot of interesting things about the subject. However, she can be condescending when answering questions, although it doesn't seem intentional. She made us cupcakes on Halloween which was nice. The grading was also confusing and I wish we got guidelines, and some TA's were more harsh graders than others.

Just a terrible professor.  The class was run horribly.  Frequently we didn't have the correct materials to conduct the lab.  The reports were extremely long and a rubric was only given for the final lab.  The grading was super confusing and seemed to change every lab. There was a clear lack of communication with the TAs which made grading brutal.

She's extremely condescending to both students and TAs. Lab guidelines are inconsistent and frequently change depending on who's grading. Her grading is unfair and harsh, while TAs will follow the rubric. Lectures don't prepare you for lab calculations while taught with a patronizing attitude. Avoid her class if you can.

Professor didnt give clear guidelines. Extremely tough grader (Average on one of the labs she graded was 65%) Lecture isn't enough to fully understand how to perform the calculations for lab reports hence forcing to attend office hours hosted at inconvenient times (during peak class hours.) One good thing is that she replies to emails fast.

This is quite possibly one of the worst professors i've ever had. Extremely condescending to students and even other LAB TA's. Lab guidelines are never clear and always subject to change depending on who's grading your paper. Literally wanted to get hit by a car every time i went to lecture. wouldnt touch this class again with a 10 foot pole.
Actively tries to help students. Approachable and easy to talk to one-on-one. Engages students to learn by prioritizing hands-on practice.

In addition to the experience listed below, he also shared publicly information that a student had confided to him privately, shaming the person who made the mistake with his bossy tone. Future learners, let's brace for that.
Nice and caring professor

This professor is undoubtedly the worst, displaying a lack of competence and professionalism. He fails to align with clients in advance, arbitrarily changes project scopes without any inputs. In a leadership role, project alignment are fundamental, yet this professor falls woefully short, making him unsuitable for any professional environment.

Such a hard person to work in. I can see why he is in academia because if he had to work in any corporate environment, his tendency to pick fights with anyone probably would make him a heinous co-worker or manager.

If you are reading this Ashish, everyone thinks you are retarded

Worst professor I have ever had. Lectures were extremely unorganized and they would go on tangents unrelated to class material for almost the entire class time. Teach yourself type of class since barely any material was taught in class. When I asked for help on a question he responded with I am making too many mistakes and walked away.

Terribly organized course, there is no clear path or vision of what we are learning and it is just an abundance of random concepts in Python with no specific connections. It is really hard to reach out for help as well; the office hour zoom meetings are empty half the time during its scheduled times.

No use going to office hours because he won't help! So irritating, just go to TA office hours instead. Lectures during class and takes attendance. Exams are in person and online. The homeworks during the second half of the semester are so difficult and he does not help.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Ashby actually cares about the material he is assigning, and is very knowledgeable. The class content is actually applicable to the "real world". If you are interested in politics, government, history, and organized labor, then take this class. If the material does not interest you, this class will not be a good experience for you. Lovdit
Literally so rude, he is unprofessional he clearly doesn't know what he's doing. I emailed him very politely regarding a discussion post and he responded so grumpy for no reason. I dropped the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: unnecessarily hard
interesting but so much work
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: the class is demanding but you can tell he is very knowledgeable about labor relations and the course information is quite interesting.
mans is literally the worst grader ever and will dock you points off even if you meet the requirements of the class. probably the worst uiuc class I have ever taken

I took this class in attempt to fill credit, but mistakenly didn't review the prof or class seeing it was asynchronous. Not only is the workload outrageous for a 100-level course, you simply cannot pass without doing it all. Each week has 2 parts to the unit, typically 10-15 readings per part. It's interesting information, but not worth it.

I'm an outgoing senior, and while reflecting on my UIUC career, LER 110 was the worst class I took. Do not take this class! Ashbys GPA averages are abysmal, around 1.7-2.5. The class would work much better if Dr. Ashby moved the course on Moodle or Canvas, made deadlines weekly, created clear grading expectation, and granted some flexibility.

The content was interesting but the structure of this online course was awful. Unlike most online courses I've taken this one was on Compass with seemingly random deadlines which made them hard to keep track of. The professor always seemed aloof in emails as well. There was one extra credit activity that was really interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I have found Professor Ashby's classes to be some of the most valuable courses I have ever taken. Because of him, I have decided to minor in labor relations. He's a true labor activist whose lectures are guided by his personal experiences. Very compelling information, really liked him!

Well agree with most that's been said, I'd say this class is a grind, great to hear if you're not taking many credit hours, if you are, you're in for a struggle. She was pretty solid, the other reviews are dramatic, I mean you gotta study for any class tbh but this one does require a but more of studying. The homework she gives might be confusing but her quizzes and midterm/final are based off of the problems in the homeworks so just make sure to do all of them (submission credit, not graded).

the other reviews are dramatic asf, she literally provided the textbook for free and her accent isnt bad at all. i thought she was lenient w/ the grading but the questions can be unclear. you'll be self-studying a lot but she's rly easygoing and accessible. the only thing that was bad was the group project since there's wasn't a lot of structure.

Make sure to go to class!!!
One of the easiest graders I've had. Super flexible on deadlines. I don't know of one person who didn't get an A in the class.

Pretty easy class, just need to study the night before for tests, show up to class, and do some presentations. Lectures are interesting material but his delivery is SUPER BORING. If you want a relatively easy a take this class

Prof. Avrutin is a super cool guy who makes the material interesting. Even if you don't read any assigned books you can still get a lot out of his lectures and discussions. Exams are relatively easy and there's no papers which is rare for a history class. He is a lenient grader and really  laid back. Would definitely recommend.

He is a very friendly man. His lectures are straight forward but sometimes also engaging interesting points. The expectations for exams are clear. Basically understanding larger themes and memorization. I learned a lot interesting stuffs about European Jewish history. Should take any class with him. He is like the top expert of Jewish History
Interesting, yet brutal topic. Very open structure on papers- we wrote 4 based on the memoirs we read. Professor was an easy grader. Participation in class is required.

Love her! Very understanding and passionate. I loved this class and highly recommend. She is a very engaging lecturer as well which makes graded attendance less painful.

Discussion is important and participation makes a chunk of your grade, but ultimately if you skim the readings and get the main points you'll be able to participate well. Funny, charismatic, intelligent.

To receive a good grade you would have to speak and answer questions out loud during a lecture that had at least 40 students in it. This requirement made students speak for half of the duration of lecture. By paying a lot of tuition money to attend lectures, I want to hear what the professor has to say about the subject, not other students.

reviews.comment: Prof. Livny is an extremely knowledgable, successful woman, an amazing speaker, and a down to earth person. She also always does her best to respond to what students need!

Professor Livny is a great teacher who really cares about her students. She wants everyone to succeed and learn the material instead of just teaching for the test. I would love to take a class from her again in the future.

No textbook but required readings.  Every week there are reading questions worth 40% of grade. She is a fun lecturer and there is participation for going, but I skipped class a bunch and was fine. Grade depends on TA. Livny is adorable and really cares about the students.

reviews.comment: Livny is super knowledgeable and her lectures were engaging. Lots of interesting material, cool visualized data. Some ppl here mentioned long readings; but remember she never expected us to read every single page - selective, strategic reading will do. You'll learn a lot!

Her PS199 class was a bit too difficult for freshman. There was A LOT OF papers to read, but you really get a good sense of what real political science is about. Also she explains pretty well during class, and the class is very interesting! Seriously considering doing PS grad school after taking her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: She took forever to grade papers. Lectures and notes were very clear. Really nice and great to talk to.

While Prof Livny is a very knowledgeable person, I feel like the readings she gave for this specific class were very tiring. They were too long which lost me at times as a student. The concepts and lessons were always very interesting but homework was nothing to I ever looked forward too. Not a bad class at all.

Professor Livny is great. She's very intelligent, well-spoken and passionate about the Middle East. You get 8 options of assignments and only have to do 4, and then one paper at the end of the class. compared public speaking anxiety to doing 15 jumping jacks then giving a speech.

Pam is my favorite professor at UIUC so far. Though the content can sometimes be dry, she does her best to keep it interesting and I genuinely liked going to her class. If you have the opportunity to take her class for CMN 111 or CMN 112 definitely do it!
minimal effort will get you an A.
Great teacher, makes concepts really easy to understand, take her!

Great class, not really a blowoff but pay attention and ask questions in class for pete sakes. study two hours outside class usually, one hour before tests and an half hor before quizes. I liked her a lot. She works hard to make sure the class understands relevant concepts prior to exams.
Great prof. Very helpful and fair!!
She teaches well and has useful lecture notes posted on the web, but her gradings are strict and she doesn't curve, you will get a C if you are on the average
The worst teacher ever. Dont even think about taking her. Her explanations on the subjects are horrible. I can hardly understand her.
She was the greatest teacher I've ever had at UIUC.
Great teacher!!!!

Truly one of the most amazing professors I have ever had! Not only knows subject matter but knows how to actually teach and explain the complex nuances of a beautiful language. Very helpful and assists in all ways possible. Best professor of my college career.
Exceptionally nice!!!
super nice!!!!
She's a really nice teacher, always comes prepared and makes the class interesting.

Azeb is great, I would and already have recommended the course with her specifically to friends. Not only is she lively and engaging in the classroom but she also readily makes herself available outside of class. I thoroughly enjoyed this class and learned so much more than I had anticipated!

I took 8 French courses at U of I and Azeb was the best teacher. She speaks very clear French and makes sure we understand everything. She doesn't use English in class, which is the right thing to do in a French class. In every class, she was very well prepared and she engaged us very much. I enjoyed every minute of her classes. Dfntly recommended
She speaks French in class, that helps you a lot. Homework is checked everyday of class. Attendant is required. In general, I think she is great TA.

M. Basu was one of the best professors I've had during my time here. She lectures beautifully, and is ultimately very caring and understanding. Highly recommend taking her, because she also gives excellent feedback on the written assignments.

She is no nonsense, but she is more than willing to engage with you intellectually inside and outside of the classroom.

I absolutely LOVED Professor Basu. I had her for both 350 and 301 and she is incredibly insightful. She is very understanding of life happening and is flexible as long as you communicate with her. She is a tough grader but allows rewrites at the end of the semester for all assignments. She truly cares about her students and what they have to say.
Easy to communicate with but a lot of independent readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: My least favorite teacher ever. I think she comes off as very pretentious and puts unnecessary emphasis on words to make it seem as if she is saying something so profound when she is just reading what someone has written. Would never take a course taught by her again.

Great professor! Incredibly intelligent without coming off as pretentious. If you're already a strong writer, the class will come as no challenge. If you're not quite as strong of a writer yet, expect to work and be willing to consider her feedback-- she gives very thoughtful feedback on papers and writing responses.

As others have said, Manisha is a FANTASTIC professor and a brilliant person, but she is quite difficult. Grading is particular and makes a 200lvl feel at times like a more advanced class. However, her feedback is helpful and the particular nature of her grading WILL sharpen your writing skills. VERY worth it for the "bootcamp" quality.

A solid choice for ENGL 301, but not the easiest. Her grading was generally pretty tough. Provides great feedback on your work. Office hours were very intimidating, but she was willing to meet (and was very accessible via email). Great readings: Sherlock Holmes, Dracula, and classic fairy tales. Attendance and punctuality is very important to her.

Manisha is one of the smartest professors I have ever had. She taught me so much. She can be a tough grader, but her feedback makes you a better writer and critical thinker. Her lectures always flew by and were of top notch quality. Our selected readings were interesting and fun, too - we used Sherlock Holmes and Dracula to discuss English theory.

This class ruined my GPA. She's a brilliant lecturer, but there always seems to be a specific answer she's looking for. Every assignment is graded like a final and I don't think anyone in my class has ever gotten higher than a flat A on any assignment. I got an A or A- on everything and still got a B in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Manisha is an incredible instructor. She demands a lot from her students without overworking them. Do your reading, go to class, participate in discussion. She puts you through a writing "bootcamp" and is very useful in helping to shape and sharpen your voice and writing skills.

I wasn't sure how well I would like this class, as I'd never been good with studying the nitty-gritty of critical theory, but she made it really interesting and more than doable.  She's respectful and patient in class, her paper comments are incredibly helpful, and I learned a ton.  I ended up doing well in the class and would take her again!
Great teacher!

If you have a chance to take a class with Manisha, do so. Easily the smartest professor in the department and an all around engaging person. She's demanding, but you will learn so much from her lectures and discussion. Read the books though--she will know if you don't keep up. She is also beautiful which makes paying attention a lot easier

A little intimidating because she comes off so intelligent. Really have to work to get an A, but a B is extremely doable on assignments. She explains the readings very well, but you have to really pay attention. She doesn't give rubrics or much to go off of so it helps to go in and talk to her before turning in papers.

You will leave the classroom a stronger thinker and writer, that is, if you participate (crucial!). Manisha is an extraordinary educator and intellectual, and I consider her mentorship here at the university as hugely formative in my intellectual growth. A rare instructor that balances critical analysis and a tender love for stories and language.

Manisha is one of the most brilliant professors that I've ever had from within the English department. She is extremely knowledgeable about the subject material and conveys it in a manner so that students understand it. However, you will work for your grade, and you will try in her class, but you will leave her class profoundly more knowledgeable.

Great professor; really knows her stuff and provides great feedback on essays. Can be demanding and she'll make you work for it, but ultimately she's one of those professors that you want to impress and work hard for.  And she's stunning, has a great sense of humor, and has a great accent (kinda British?). Easily the sexiest professor I've ever had

TAKE THIS CLASS. Dr. Basu is one of the, if not the most, intelligent teachers I've ever had. She is so engaging and so dedicated to making sure the students understand the material, which can be quite dense.  On a superficial note--She is beautiful and has the prettiest voiceaccent, as well as being very funny.

Manisha is brilliant, engaging and very knowledgable about the material. Always had great discussions in this class. Her comments on writing assignments are also extremely helpful and will help to improve your skills. Take any class with her---you will not be disappointed!

Manisha was a great teacher, very understanding and very professional.  Don't be afraid to ask questions, she is always willing to explain difficult concepts until everyone understands.  Her grading is fair and her comments are very helpful for future writing assignments.  Definitely one of my favorite teachers so far.

She will revolutionize reading out loud for you. I loved this class. She is passionate and brilliant at what she teaches. Be prepared to talk in class. Class participation is essential because she doesn't lecture, she conducts class discussions, so you have to do the readings. But the content is interesting and she is very helpful. TAKE THIS CLASS!

Manisha is excellent. She does expect you to be prepared and will not teach what you are not willing to study ahead of time. Her class is extremely interesting and helpful. I learned a lot and although I sometimes struggled with grades, she was always fair.

Manisha expects her students to come to class well prepared- the only time she was upset in class was when no one had anything to say about the reading. Otherwise she is very fun and can answer almost any question really well. She's also flexible on how and when assignments are turned in as long as you discuss it with her. Great class.

Incredible professor, best I've had so far. She is very intelligent and expects you to participate INTELLIGENTLY.  While meaningless blabber is always in English courses, expect less from this one. She always has interesting insights into course material even if it is initially boring.  TAKE THIS CLASS. you will not regret it.

She is very smart and knows what she is talking about. She takes attendance every day though so attendance is mandatory, but the class discussions are never boring. She listens to her students and is very nice.
Easily the most intelligent professor in the English department.  She is challenging, but extremely helpful.  You will come out of her class a better student, guaranteed.
My first crush on a professor. I love her--so wonderful. Nothing else to say.
The best class ever. Manisha is wonderful. Wish every professor was like her--fun, smart, witty, and playful.

Manisha was probably one of the smartest teachers I have ever had, it is almost intimidating.  Her class if very difficult but there are no daily assignments or tests, just three essays and 5 email repsonses.  Make sure you are prepared and read all the text- I tried the hardest I had in any class and still got a B+.
No Comments

I just finished the course and got an A without having to take the final. It is hard but I think the key to doing well is knowing your mechanisms and reagents by all means and making shortcuts to help you memorize them. She is a great professor and offers extra credit that you should take advantage of (it changed my whole letter grade).

Organic chemistry is difficult but Axelson taught very well. Great lecturer, very knowledgeable, and provides infinite resources. If you go to class and study, you will be fine. Probably the best teacher i've had so far.

she is actually a goddess. an angel on earth. i didnt attend a single in-person lecture, i only watched the recorded videos and i learned so much from them. it might be the best canvas page ive ever seen in my life with a million different practice problems and resources. the exams aren't weighted that heavily and the homework really helps you
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: AXELSONNNN!!! Love her and yeah while orgo is a hard class she makes it so easy to understand. She does tend to put little tricks on her exams tho lol but I think her exams are pretty fair if you study the material well enough and put the effort in!! I wish she taught orgo 2 im gonna miss her class!!!
Don't know how she has a 4.1 rating! Never again
Good luck!
She is good, but also a tough professor. Please go to lectures and ask questions.
Great professor all around. Fair grading, fair tests, fair homework. And a great lecturer.

Orgo is a very hard class and nothing will change that. What helps a lot though is having prof. Axelson teach the course. She explains topics in a way that a student can comprehend and gives a ton of extra practice. Take advantage of office hours/extra practice early because if you don't you will likely struggle right from the start.

Professor Axelson is great professor, her lectures are good and engaging. Obviously ochem is tough! But she provides everything you need to succeed, you just need to put in a little elbow grease. There's a lot of homework for a reason. Even if you don't do great on the exams, it provides a lot of padding and gives you a lot of practice.

Literally has no respect for student's time. If you don't spend every minute studying for her class, you are done for. This would mean, stop spending time working on other courses too. She has the oddest policy where if even one person from her hundreds of students get a 100, the entire class suffers and gets no curve. Never again.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr Axelson is a great professor. Honestly she gives you everything you need to succeed, you just have to put in the work and shes up front about that. Shes good at explaining difficult concepts, but you have to practice them yourself. She gives good extra credit, and her exams are reasonable difficulty. Do all practice exams multiple times!!!

Dr. Axelson is a great professor and provides so many resources and help sessions for students to succeed. Orgo is for sure a hard subject but Dr. Axelson's lectures and notes make it very helpful to be able to understand the material well.

Axelson is a great professor. She explains the content very well and provides so many extra resources and materials for studying. It's a tough class, but she provides a lot of support and wants her students to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Axelson is freaking awesome and the best prof I've ever had. Always willing to help you at office hours and has tons of practice material to prepare you for the exams. Orgo is a tough subject but if you put in the work and keep up with your studying, you will do well.

Axelson makes orgo so much easier than people make it out to be! She is a great lecturer and makes things as easy for students to remember as possible. She is very clear about what will or will not be tested on. She also is very fun and engaging in lecture. If you miss a class, she posts all lectures online with essentially the same content.
Very effective professor.
She is the best!!! Love playing pokemon go w her

She is a fantastic lecturer and extremely dedicated! The class is definitely tough, and the exams are graded pretty harshly, but she is a really kind professor and provides a lot of study resources for students. She's very accessible if you need help.

One of the best at UIUC! Extremely helpful, great lectures and plenty of practice material. Lots of study resources and exams, and generous grading/drop policies. Wants you to succeed. Getting a good grade is very doable, but requires a LOT of time and work. Do all the extra practices, practice exams, and watch lecture videos. I

Orgo is a pretty tough class but Axelson always provided many resources that made it much easier to learn. I would recommend using the weekly optional canvas homework to study as well as practice tests. I can't imagine how much harder the class would have been with any other chem professor.

Orgo is feared by many, but I heard great things about Axelson, and having taken the class, I would absolutely agree with her reputation. The structure of the course is very organized, and her lectures are phenomenal. I was hoping to earn a higher grade, although I only have myself to blame for not taking advantage of all resources. Would take agai

Literally the best chem instructor I have ever had. She's put in so much effort to make the tough class fun and engaging. Provides a lot of resources and is accessible outside of class. She even gives a grace period for ALEKS homework. I don't understand why she's still a senior lecturer, Dr. Axelson deserves a position of professor.

I loved having Dr. Axelson. In an 8AM lecture, she was able to keep me engaged and awake with her fun spin on orgo. The content/exams were difficult, but extra credit and a test drop to make up for it. Dr. Axelson has made this class no harder than it needs to be. One of my favorite professors this semester because she was so fun and knowledgeable.

I really liked her as a professor but had a very difficult time with the course material. She offers a lot of help and practice opportunities, though. I unfortunately had to take the course online because it was all that was left, I would 10000000% recommend in-person classes!! Discussion sessions can be helpful if you have a good TA and group.

Dr. Axelson is amazing. She is very organized and lays out a weekly outline for all assignments and pre-lecture videos so the class is super easy to follow. She gives lots and lots of optional practice problems and many ways to exam-prep, including 6 practice exams to try. She's also super engaging and gives great lectures so I highly recommend.
Orgo is hard but Axelson makes it good tbh

She is the first chem prof who has ever seemed to care about her students, and the class is designed to help you learn and do well. It is still organic chem, and is not an easy course, but it is not designed to fail students. She lectured in costumes to emphasize certain concepts, and it was very clear what we needed to know to succeed.
she is the best professor i have ever had, she prepares you so well to do good in this course, so helpful, I literally love her so much
Awesome lecturer, will lay out everything you need to know for the exams, just study hard. In general makes the class interesting and engaging

She's a cool professor but man those exams are mad hard and graded maddd hard imo. Other than that the class is fine she just talks really fast in lecture, so might have to rewatch them online. only 1/5 star because of the difficulty of the exams but lowest scores dropped so that's a positive I guess lol.

While this is a difficult class, the way that Axelson teaches makes it so much easier to succeed. Her online lectures are so helpful and she provides SO MANY extra practice that will have you completely prepared for the exams. If you are willing to use the practice she offers and work hard, you will do just fine in the course.

Axelson made orgo an amazing experience for me. Her lecture style was approachable and well-paced. She presented helpful study skills, provided countless resources and practice, and organized TA-led review sessions. She cares deeply about her students and I truly believe that anyone can succeed in this class with even an average amount of effort.

she is a great lecturer. only issue is that for unit3 she was out because she lost her voice for almost the entire unit. we had to watch lecture videos that didn't correspond to our class notes and when the time came to take that exam and students were complaining about it she sent an email basically saying she doesn't care bc we had the material.

Excellent professor. Tons of material to be able to practice on your own. Amazing recorded lectures so we are able to learn at our own pace. Opportunities overflowing to get support. If you want to do well in Dr. Axelson's class, there is no reason you can't.

Dr. Axelson was very passionate about teaching orgo. Her lectures were very detailed and even though she gave a lot of homework, it served a purpose. Although she did not make the class easier, she gave us a ton of resources to make sure we did good in the class. She is one of the few professors who actually want her students to do good.

I love Professor Axelson. I actually think she made ochem my favorite class yet. She is such a clear and engaging lecturer. She answers questions clearly and thoroughly. She's so kind and friendly. She posts practice exams and solutions to the exams, which are immensely helpful. LOVED HER!

One of my favorite professors. After gen chem, I was so worried about orgo. After chatting with Axelson, I was able to find a perfect tutor. I am so thankful that Axelson cared enough to help me find resources to be successful. I ended with an A which I thought would be impossible since chemistry doesn't come naturally to me.

Dr. Axelson is a good professor. She's really organized and the past lectures are posted on canvas. She also gave a lot of useful resources. But she never ended the class on time and sometimes assigned more work than necessary.

I took this class Fall 2021, don't go into this class with a bad mindset, purchase/download the "textbook" and take detailed notes, if you don't know something there are plenty of office hours to attend. Do the extra hw because it'll prepare you for different problems on the exam. Reach out for help with ANYTHING, she will get back to you.

Axelson does a really great job of making orgo a lot less scary than most people think. Her extra practice problems are amazing and the practice exams are really similar to the actual exams. You never really run out of resources. The help sessions are also super helpful. Just be mindful of how crowded they will get 2-3 days before the exam.

Axelson is a fantastic professor. Organic chemistry is very difficult, but the course is built to be forgiving. She drops your lowest exam score and duplicates your highest. She's super available to any answer questions and provides tons of practice material.

Axelson is the best professor I have ever had. I was really stressed out going into the class because I didn't do well in gen chem but the amount of "optional" practice materials Axelson provides ensures that almost anybody that puts in the time they will get a good grade. She always brought good energy and comedy to lecture as well

she is an amazing teacher and makes sure to explain how each process works. she offers a lot of resources and her exams are really as easy as they can be considering the tough material (she doesn't have trick questions)

Dr. Axelson is the greatest professor of all time. I had to balance 18 credit hours while working 10+ hours a week at my job, and I am going to end up with a B-. I spent hardly any time on this class at all so I'll take it. Lectures are super interesting. Axelson is a wonderful person. Don't miss any homework. Practice a lot and you'll get an A!
Great professor who tries to make it interesting, just a really tough class!

Honestly, if you give this class your time and energy it is an amazing experience. Professor Axelson gives great lectures with a well organized class. She gives a dropped exam which helps a lot. Do the assignments, watch the lectures, take good notes, take the practice exams and you'll do great! Orgo is a hard subject no matter what!Put in the time

Take my advice with a hefty grain of salt. Try to do really well on Exam 2 (and exam 1) if you can. Exam 3 and 4 both build off Exam 2 content HEAVILY, so if you don't learn the Exam 2 content you're screwed. I failed two exams (not proud of it) and still ended with a B, so do this if you're of average intelligence like me lol
She give all the resources possible but it will be hard. Do all homework, get help immediately, practice test > everything else.

Dr. Axelson provides all of the material required to be successful in class. Orgo is difficult but she provides you with the skills you need and it's up to you to practice. She is always willing to help outside of class. Make sure to do the practice exams. It is 4 exams and a final but we can drop one exam.

Give this professor a raise. She puts so much effort into her lectures, extra explanation videos, help sessions, and she even let me take an exam when I missed the time for my section. She is understanding and generous with her help.

Axelson was a great professor when I took this course SP2021. I think she gives her students everything they need to be successful, it is up to you on whether you want to use the resources. Most of her exams reflected the study material given to us ahead of time, so nothing was 100% new. Orgo is hard but if you use the materials, you will pass.

I took this Fa21. This class is extremely hard no matter what because it's orgo. However, Axelson breaks things down into more simple terms. She does give you some options for extra credit, but it is very few. The lowest exam is dropped which makes the final optional and replaced by the highest exam which creates a semi curve.

OChem is difficult, but Axelson is fair. She is extremely willing to meet with students. Her teaching staff hosts help sessions throughout the week (several times a day). Not a "easy A", but it is not impossible. Take Practice exams Learn R and S (axelson loves to rotate molecules) Attend help sessions (get help quick, class builds) OMSA
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: If you do all of the practice tests and worksheets she gives you in class, you'll be prepared for the tests. Chegg has also all of the connect homework answers.
