Excellent professor with strong understanding of the material. The problem sets and exams are very challenging, but if you put in the work, you will be rewarded with a strong understanding of organic chemistry.

Incredible professor. The course was extremely rigorous, but I came out of there with a very strong understanding of organic chemistry. It's rough, and you have to put in work, but he's a great teacher.
She is so nice but very very VERY unorganized... Also a very tough grader but as long as you put a little effort into it you'll be fine I think

She's the hardest grader. She doesn't care about your progeess as a speaker in terms of grading, so even if you work to improve your grade it won't do much. This course doesn't teach much as a course, so I find this grading too much. Have to say though, she is a nice person and cares about making you a better speaker.

Carrie is a wonderful person, however, she lacks at responding well to emails and her lectures can get kind of tiring. She also doesn't give much mercy with deadlines, but that is to be expected sometimes. Personally, I think the class is okay, but if I had the opportunity to go back and pick a new class...I probably would.
All I can say is never take her class, and if you still take it you will regret and then come back to thank me.
She is a nice person, but a really hard grader. Not much feedback in general.

professor bunch is nice but her lectures are boring and she grades way harder than she needs to for an intro course. she's unorganized and does not respond to emails. take any other communications professor

The worst public speaking professor at the University of Illinois. If you see her on your schedule, drop the class and switch to someone else! She does not answer emails or give any feedback. She also does not grade you on your own personal improvement, but grades as if you had been giving speeches your whole life.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Tough grader. Really got me to work.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Carrie is the best! Really nice and easy to talk to, her classes are actually pretty fun.
Tough grader, makes you work for your grade, nice person.

The course was well-structured, with clear assignment deadlines. Concepts were explained clearly, and she encouraged questions to help students. The textbook was optional additional reading that reinforced what was taught in class. Pay attention and take notes during lectures you'll do fine.
She is an amazing person who is always willing to help you outside of class if you need it!

Dr. Buetti is a phenomenal professor!! You can tell how passionate she is about the topics, and many examples are used to summarize the lesson ideas. Attendance is optional, but I would highly advise to go as understanding the slides without doing so may be hard. Got a C on one test but extra credit helped me get it up, tests are also pretty basic.

Psyc 230 with Professor Buetti and Lleras was great, I highly recommend taking this course. The lectures are interesting and interactive, and all video lectures are uploaded a couple days before the test. The class is content-heavy but tests focus on general information, not too much detail. Overall, an easy and interesting class!

Dr. Buetti is one of the best instructors on campus. She is kind and helpful to everyone, and she is extremely passionate about what she does. The class is lecture heavy, but the video lectures and study guides can clear up confusion, as the exams focus only on more general information. She is also always open to questions for anything after class.

Psyc230 was awesome with Dr. Buetti and her co-instructor. She was funny and made the content more entertaining. I cannot recommend this class enough, as the content is interesting and the test are super easy. Save your money and do not buy the book because it is not required.

Very fair exams, not a super large amount of work. The lectures can be content heavy but the questions on the exams are always very straightforward. She is super caring and willing to explain tougher concepts in detail.

The class is lecture-heavy, but the lectures are interesting and interactive. You will be fine if you show up to class, take good notes, and study a little before tests. The only thing that I used the book for is vocabulary. Most assignments are graded by completion. So easy and fun!
Loved her. Lectures were super easy to follow and the tests were directly testing what was taught in the lectures so I was never surprised and knew exactly what to study.

Asynchronous version = pre-recorded lectures, 3 proctored exams, and assignments. Lectures are engaging, Professor Buetti is clear, material is fantastic. Some modules combine very basic physics and biology, and some human anatomy as well. Overall, a very straightforward and easy class, especially if you have a background in science.
Super lenient, asynchronous, 3 exams but entirely based on lectures and textbook, very understanding professors
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The structure was different than previous years due to the circumstances that led to an online course, but the professor was highly accessible, especially when I needed accommodations. Though the class was lecture-heavy, she made the lectures enjoyable.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: One of my best professors during this pandemic. Proctorio exams, but quizzes and homework are open-note. Gives study guides for exams. Know whats on the study guides, know the key terms in the book, use flashcards and you'll get an A on every exam. Near the middle of the class nothing was mandatory and only EC - including final exam. (b/c pandemic)

if you have the opportunity to take any of her classes - do it. She is really passionate about psychology and is such a sweet lady! In addition, I found her class to be very interesting and it would make me want to come to class.

Although I took the course online, Professor Buetti communicated with students very well through email, and was very responsive. She was also incredibly understanding: when I had an issue with a proctor on ProctorU, she actually stood up for me and emailed the company. They eventually sent me an apology email, saying they would oversee the proctor.
She's so sweet! This is a large class yet she still manages to do demos in class. She tries her best to make the content simple as possible. I find this class much easier than Psyc 201 to be honest.

Dr. Buetti is an excellent professor and Psych 230 is definitely worth taking! The teaching style is filled with examples, in-class activities, as well as the possibility for extra credit points for coming to class. The class is a lecture style but it is also interactive. The content is very interesting focusing on sensation and perception.
Best professor at UIUC

SHE IS SO NICE. Her lectures aren't mandatory but they count towards extra credit. She has an accent but its adorable and it's not hard to understand.  She posts the lectures online and any other info can be found in the book but its not mandatory to have. She gives a lot of extra credit and is always willing to answer questions.

I love Simona's teaching style and pretty much everything else about her. She definitely cares about her students' success and is willing to help anybody out. There are 3 exams and a ton of extra credit. TAKE THIS CLASS!!
I enjoyed the class, and Prof Bronski was pretty funny
GOAT professor 100% would take him as a professor again. Funny and actually explains problems

Took calc 2, after 2 weeks realized lectures were pointless to go to. Frequent errors in slides and teaching, lectures not engaging. Grade composed of 3 tests, a final, discussion worksheets and prairielearn hws. self studying for tests when the time came was enough to get an A. I guess I'd do it again? But self studying wasn't fun.

He's an awesome lecturer, easy to follow, and always cracks a joke in his canvas announcements or during his lectures. However, while attendance isn't required, the canvas is really poorly updated so if you miss a lecture it's quite punishing and you don't really get to catch up. So, make sure to have a friend in the class.
Great Professor.

One of the few people in UIUC Maths that can ACTUALLY TEACH. Super fun guy.
The only weak point: sometimes, theorem/formulae in-class derivations were redundant. We could have gone over them on our own. Wish we had skipped them and done more topics.
I think anyone should take a class with him though. Interesting HMWK problems.Super smart guy.

Great professor. Lectures are engaging and easy to follow. There are plenty of office hours available, and the assessments are very reasonable. He explains concepts clearly and guides students patiently. Highly recommended.

Not actually a UIUC student, but am friends with one of his daughters and he made an excellent vegan chocolate cake for her birthday. Impressive quality and texture given constraints (no egg, had to travel); demonstrating clear attention to detail when working flour into the batter.
OMG look its Bronski (add me on stardew valley)
Amazing prof, he goes in depth into theory for those interested, and he shows us the quick way of solving for the exam!
He is a great professor! I had him for MATH 285 and his lectures are very helpful. Definitely recommend choosing him when taking the course.
Very straightforward class, made easier by Professor Bronski's clear lectures. Very funny prof, S tier.
Very good lecturer and made class fun.

bronski was amazing at answering questions during lecture. he answered them clearly and concisely. he also frequently cracked jokes during lecture which made it more fun and definitely more engaging. overall a very fun class simply because he was the teacher.

Bronski is a great professor. I'm in his 285 honors section and he's a genuinely nice and intelligent guy who cares about students. The class is also very interesting and quite useful for other theoretical STEM applications. Tests can be a bit hard but just do practice problems and you should be fine.
He made those knowledges of Mathematics very clear and lovely!

Bronski is amazing. His lectures are fun and engaging, he essentially wrote his own textbook that he gives us for free. He not only dressed up for Halloween but also brought us all candy. His office hours are amazing. The exams are pretty fair and the class is reasonably easy if you put the work in.
Good professor, very accommodating. Lectures can be hilarious.

His lectures, tests, and homework were pretty straightforward but had little room for error. Almost everything was on PraireLearn/Test, so it always took forever to type in large answers, and you could very easily make a mistake and lose 5 points. Practice the homework and practice tests, and you'll be solid.

Professor Bronski gives excellent lectures that allow students to understand essential concepts well and also tells you what is expected on the exams, which makes studying and expectations more tolerable. He is very kind and understanding if something comes up during the semester.
Great prof, great sense of humor, tests are reasonable and he wants students to succeed.

I really enjoyed having Professor Bronski. He does a lot of practice problems during lecture which make topics easy to understand. 1-2 homework assignments a week which were very doable. All lectures were posted online as well. Exams were pretty easy and usually mirrored the practice tests. Highly recommend.
He's good at teaching and he is a great person, but 2/3 of our exams were significantly harder than the practice material.

Bronski always makes clear why he's doing what he's doing when he works through problems, which is much appreciated. Don't be afraid to ask "dumb" questions, he is very good at explaining things in simpler terms. Tests are pretty straightforward if you do the weekly homework assignments. He's got great sense of humor too. Highly recommend.

Really amazing he teaches everything u need to know and how to do everything. You can tell that he cares about his students by the ways the tests are structured. They always have this little joke of some type at the end to which is great. Take him if possible .

Bronski is a great professor, make sure you understand your calc 1,2 as they become essential when doing diff eq. The exams are similar to the practice ones but as always make sure to review everything holistically. After you know what to expect on the first exam the rest of them become easy and the final was open note for us. highly recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Bronski was great. He's very patient and actually listens to and cares about student concerns. He responds timely, his lectures are informative and he makes class fun. Exams are doable. Take good notes and you'll be just fine-everything he says in lecture is fair game unless specified otherwise.

Math 285, Differential Equations, is a tough class. Math is by far my worst subject, and I went into this class worrying that I wouldn't pass, but Bronski made it bearable. Do well on the homework (go to CARE), practice using the practice exams, and the class is passable. For that, I am eternally grateful.
Amazing lecturing skills. Very reachable. He even wrote his own textbook for this class!
Bronski is an amazing professor who truly wants you to learn the material. If you see him as an option for your math class, definitely choose him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The best professor that I have any seen. Organization at its finest, explains key concepts very easily, and gives feedback very fast.

Fun and responsible professor. He has great lecture notes and decent videos. He holds accessible office hours multiple times every week. However, as many online classes tend to be, you need more motivation than in person, as the only synchronous component is the required discussion sessions.

MATH 231 is a hard class, no matter who you take. That being said, I've never had a more attentive, knowledgeable, and caring instructor. Professor Bronski's lectures are excellent, the practice tests are great, and he tries to make it fun, adding little jokes in to make sure we don't go crazy. Bronski a real one, one of the best math profs at UIUC
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great teacher, 10/10 recommend. Always available outside of class and constantly emails for questions to go over for help.
Great teacher

Great asynchronous lectures and the office hours 2x a week are very helpful. You don't need the textbook because he writes you note sheets for each week and they're fantastic. Haven't received a grade yet because I have my final soon but it'll probably be decent. Prof. Bronski is really good and I would recommend him.

Professor Bronski is easily one of the best professors I have had. As a freshman in Aerospace Engineering, I knew that Calc 2 was one of the harder courses but Prof Bronski makes a true effort to make sure everyone knows the material for the midterms. There are tons of opportunities to attend his office hours to succeed in the course.

Professor Bronski is one of the best professors at UIUC. He knows his material in and out - and then some. Office hours with him are the best, he starts with random youtube videos and he gave all of his students free hot chocolate on the last day. He genuinely wants his students to succeed. I'd take another Math class just to be taught by him.

Best math teacher Ive ever had. Im a freshman in aerospace. MATH 231 was a hard class but he made difficult material easier and fun to learn. He had tons of opportunities for your questions to get answered through office hours and campus wire. I had his class during COVID and he was still very accessible online.
I Love Bronski.

My calc 2 professor was the TA to Bronski, and I absolutely loved her. I knew Bronski was going to be a real gem. I heard so many good things about him and he did not disappoint one bit. Amazing professor, HILARIOUS, and very accessible. He delivers the material in such a well, concise manner. I would take him again in a heartbeat.

This was my second course with him, and it was just as good as the first. He is very active in communicating with students via piazza, and he is very easily reached. He explains the material in a great way that is fairly easy to comprehend. I have friends that take other professors and I always make sure to rub it in that I am taking a great one!

There are not a lot of professors I have taken that make me want to go to class, but he is one of them. He is a very funny character, but this does not take away from the fact that he knows his stuff. He is a very, very good teacher. I would take him again in a heartbeat, and I recommend everyone to take him if you can.
Calc II is gonna be a bunch of work, but Bronski usually does a pretty good job of explaining concepts. Make sure you pay attention and don't get behind, it can go pretty quick.

Great professor. He makes lectures interesting and usually starts class with a random calc related video that's hilarious. There's a lot of homework but its not hard at all and the midterms are pretty easy as well. The puzzlers are a great way to earn extra credit

Jared is insanely funny and makes the class interesting with his own questions. But, he isnt a great teacher as such (no one shows up for lecture) and that is hard for people who need good explanation. But, there are so many tutoring and helpful resources that this class should be fine (it isnt hard a very hard class).
Wonderful professor it's so lucky to have this professor in my first college year!!!
Great professor!! I took both his lectures and other prof's when he was away. His were the best. He is super clear and funny. (still remembers his joke about that thing at standford) I love diff eqs!
Bronski was hilarious but dont let the tests make you think this class is easy. Final is brutal but he does curve if his averages are too low. Great professor all in all!

Great professor! Very smart and funny, which makes you look forward to going to lecture. The class was very easy overall, and I felt like it didn't go much in depth, but if you wanna understand concepts with a greater depth you have to do it on your own.
Hes absolutely hilarious, but more importantly, hes an amazing professor. He takes time to answer questions during lecture, through email, and on piazza. Made calculus bearable.
He's a good teacher but the class is just very difficult.

It's a tough class, no doubt. The homework (assigned weekly) will take you at least 2-4 hours each week. Bronski was a very good lecturer and clearly explained any of the material. He was tough, but fair, and he tries to make it as engaging as possible. Overall a really good professor.

Prof Bronski is a nice guy. He always tries to inject humor into his lectures, which does keep you engaged with what's happening in the class. If you don't find his lectures  very clear, visit him after class or during office hours with doubts. He may seem a little uninterested, but he does care about his students

I enjoyed Bronski as a person,  but not as a professor. In lecture, he sped through material and covered only the easiest and hardest example problems, but nothing we would see on homework or an exam. I ended up learning most of the material on my own from a guy on YouTube. Also, don't take 231E if you only took Calc 1 in high school.
Great lecturer. Class is tough but nothing I didn't expect going in. Definitely one of the better Calc professors on campus.
Bronski is always there to help you. His lectures may not be the clearest so I would suggest going to office hours if you dont understand the concepts. He will always try his best to teach you.
Really Cool Professor, Really helpful and Provides fabulous notes . I wish he was my professor for Calc III
Good guy

Took fall '14 engineering section. The engineering section really isn't needed, take normal if possible. The final was unexpectedly hard compared to the midterms. He is a pretty dry instructor, but he is clear in his lectures. He usually makes small mistakes in the work of solving a problem in lecture. He's not good at responding to email.
Lectures are really good! He moves at a normal pace and is really good at answering questions in class.  Really focuses on how the material is presented.  Highly recommend taking a class with him!

He is one of the few Math Professor in the UIUC that actually are good at teaching. He is really good at giving lecture and his explanation are very clear. I really like the way he wrote the blackboard and he is also humorous and intelligent.
He is very funny. Sometimes it seems like he's talking to the board and not the class, but overall I would recommend him.
Great professor! Really funny, witty, and smart. I thought Calc 2 was hard, but he made it way easier.

Overall a pretty good class. Kept things simple during class yet exam 2 and 3 were really hard. The curve is way off. You can work your butt off all semester and get a B- in the class but there will be no curve to your advantage. However if you mess up and get a 65 you will be curved to a C-. Curve is unfair for those who work hard to do good.

He was a really good Calc 2 teacher. He taught the concepts well and was really good at understanding what someone was asking whenever there were questions. If you need to take Calc 2, I'd try to take it with Bronski.
Keeps lectures interesting and discussion sections are very helpful.
Sometimes goes a little fast, but you can't do much better when it comes to math professors.  I would recommend him highly.
Decent guy but I felt like I spent every class frantically copying from the board: he goes really fast and doesn't take the time to explain things.  I had to basically teach myself everything.

Prof Bronski grades easy, but the exams can be really hard or extremely easy, never in the middle. Tends to take quizzes once every 2 weeks, and we used to get a decent amt of HW which was essential to the understanding of the material. Diff eq concepts are hard though, and sometimes you just feel like you're copying from the board. Take him!
If you want good grades, take this guy's class. He goes easy on tests.
EXTREMELY GOOD.

If your idea of a good prof is somebody that instantly gives extentions whenever you want then he is the best.  If your idea of a good prof is somebody who makes sure you learn the material, he is awful.
Go to class. Study for exams. Ignore all others who tell you Calc 2 is the hardest class on campus... your reality will be that it is the easiest!

He was by far the easiest teach I have ever had.  He is a really nice guy and always willing to help out.  He actually seems to care about teaching and his students.  His exams are the easiest things imaginable and I have gotten 100% on 2 of the 3 exams.  If you have the option of taking this professor, make sure you do.

He's not the greatest at explaining things or answering questions, but I took it last semester and me and my friend both got like a 96 or 97 in the class, the tests were easy if you tried. He's a nice guy (extensions and stuff) and helpful.
Professor Bronski started off slow, but as the semester went on, he just got better and better. He does a lot of examples which helps, and he's overall a nice guy. The class isn't too hard either.

Professor Bronski was the best teacher I have had since coming to U of I. He remembers peoples names and I believe he truly cares about his students. The class is pretty laid back and his lectures are easily followable. He is easy to approach and more than happy to help any student at any time. He is understanding and an overall great teacher.
He is an amazing teacher! he is sooo helpful! He will give you extensions on hw, labs, etc...So great teacher! TAKE HIS CLASS! its so easy! :)
WOW I had heard so much good about him, but in reality he is just like any other math prof, but he is more boring.  After having Carty this was a huge disappointment.
Pretty good lecturer. Easy class and very helpful.

Prof Bronski was seriously one of my favorite teachers I've had! The class was decently hard, but you learn a lot if you try. He was very approachable and willing to answer any questions anyone had. He was such a sweetie and I honestly wish he was teaching my calc class this semester.

This was my favourite math professor ever! The exams are not difficult if you study. Very good at clarifying sequences and series, they were actually my favourite part of the class. Awesome guy, understanding and definately is there to help students! I don't think there is a great curve, but if you work hard, it pays off. seriously, take his class!

This guy is relaxed, friendly and normal... not a typical math professor at all.  Good at answering questions, glad to give you hints on the homework, tests were take-home and not too hard, informal lecture style.  Only issue is confusing sloppiness on the blackboard.  To demonstrate one result we proved, he actually used a power jigsaw.

His lectures are.... pretty bad. Talks in a low, depressed tone, and is not clear with important details in the lectures. Your questions in class would also not likely get answered as he is very unenthusiastic and unclear. His projects are also often hidden in the syllabus, and you have to dig around to find if there are projects due.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He was not amazing at explaining concepts in class but v knowledgeable in office hours. Thought his tests were totally hit or miss. Never felt good abt them but got really good grades on them. I think hes fine, he deserves at least like a 3.5 he is not that bad. You just have to try!

Extremely boring. It's hard to pay attention to his monotone British accent for an hour straight. Atrocious at explaining difficult scientific concepts and goes way too fast. The slides are disorganized and very difficult to study from as they offer no context. He writes harsh exams too.

Shes great. Really devoted to the subjects and she will make you think about things you never thought before. Super understanding. Easy to reach by email and office hour.

Easily one of the top 2 or 3 professors I had in college. I took her class on a whim to fill a curriculum requirement my final semester. The "Dan-o-saurus-rex" is an absolutely quintessential American gent. Top bloke. Clever academic writing. Welcome in UK anytime. Doesn't like Trump.

Dan is THE MAN. Seriously. Best Intern ever. I wish I could take another class with him!!!
Awesome dude. Best Danosaur ever.

I LOVE CHARLES BYRNE!!! He's a great teacher who cares a lot about his students and makes an effort to get to know people on a personal level.  Makes the class interesting; has great powerpoints and is very approachable.  He also finds ways to make learning the information fun.
Charles is a great instructor! He keeps class interesting and enjoyable. But you have to read. Memorization is essential for the midterm and final.
Charles is an excellent teacher. He is friendly, explains the work thoroughly and makes class really interesting. This was my favorite class by far last semester.

One of the best professors I've had at UIUC. Genuinely enthusiastic, both about the subject and about his students learning. Somehow made learning calculus somewhat enjoyable. Class was tough, but that's to be expected from Calc III.

Cellarosi is a fantastic professor.  You can tell he's really excited about what he's teaching, and he makes it rub off on you.  Always eager to answer questions, sometimes will keep you longer after class to explain more than you asked about, just cause he loves math so much.

Even if you are fully prepared, there is usually 1-2 tricky question on each exam.  By far the best professor for this course (average scores higher than others)

Cellarosi is amazing.  There are many concepts that were pretty difficult for me to grasp, but he made it entertaining and possible!  The tests were very hard, but the curve worked out for everyone in the end.  Also, willing to meet with students one-on-one.
Nice guy, does a pretty decent job explaining difficult topics
Really funny, very good lectures, wants to help students
Great teacher with interesting lectures. Great fashion sense. I also like his accent.

Dr. Cidell is knowledgeable, caring, and creates an environment conducive to student success. It is a pleasure to listen to her lectures and take part in conversations in her courses. I couldn't recommend GGIS 465 enough.
insanely difficult grading scale, is not understanding, does not reply to emails.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment: Julie is amazing out of class during her office hours and her lectures are very engaging and streamlined. Tests are fair but make sure you do the required readings as parts of the exam draw directly from reading material not touched on in lecture. There are also frequent mini papers and two larger assignments but those were pretty manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Amazing professor. Lectures were super interesting. There is interesting content in this class for everyone.
I love her.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Respected

reviews.comment: Really good professor! She assigns a decent amount of reading, but it is all relevant to the tests and lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Cidell is very respected and distinguished in her field - she's a true geographer! Get to know her outside of class. Easy grading and clear guidelines, not too much homework, and the homework we did have was easy and the same each week. Field trip for this class was super fun! Even if transportation isn't your thing, this is a great class.

She drops a decent amount of assignments but there are two weekly assessments (a lab and a quiz) so it's a decent amount to keep track of if you're in other demanding classes. The textbook is used for at least half of the quizzes. However, she's super nice and a great lecturer. Great to talk to outside of class if you're struggling and in general.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: Engaging lectures and super nice lady! There's a lot of reading but if you follow the reading schedule on the syllabus and dont fall behind you'll be ok! Midterms are not too bad, she gave very thorough study guides beforehand. Good professor and the class is very doable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Extremely organized, fair. Good lecturer.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures--Would take again

reviews.comment: Required participation but great lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures--Would take again

reviews.comment: Professor Cidell is kind and always willing to answer questions. Thought class would be more interesting (Cities of the World) but is just ok. More of an urban planning course. Exams aren't bad (combo of readings & lecture) and three easy projects throughout the semester. Readings assigned for homework (5-15 pgs) which is not included in lectures.
Very kind. You'll love geography after taking her class!
Very easy to work with and very clear. I really enjoyed her class and the way she brought the real world into what we were learning. Read and do the assignments and you'll be fine.
He's very knowledgeable about what he teaches, he just isn't engaging. It's a struggle to pay attention in his class, he's very low energy. But it's an easy A so it's whatever.

The class was very easy. No tests or papers, and the occasional homework here and there. The class is flipped so the class meetings are more of a discussion and you grade yourself at the end of the course. He is a very sweet instructor and cares about what he teaches!

I don't have enough words to type how caring Professor Cisneros is, and he's VERY passionate about what he teaches. True to the material (social movements), he doesn't agree w/ graded assignments, we're told to give ourselves (fair) grades. There aren't papers or tests, decent amount of daily reading/discussion though. Participation is important!!

Professor Cisneros is a great teacher to take. I took 396 Intercultural Rhetoric and it was extremely well organized and expectations were clearly stated from the start. You MUST participate every class period and read read read! I would not recommend if you aren't going to read the materials. Great professor and very well organized.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Regret taking this class because it's a lot more work than I originally thought it would be. The lectures are long and redundant and the teaching style isn't so effective. He is a nice person, but does not do a great job of keeping the attention of the students. If you're looking for an easy class, this isn't it. Two 10-page research papers....
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: I am in this class right now, and I already hate it. Most of the hatred comes from the professor. He makes things way more dramatic and drags lecture out way longer than it needs to be. He teaches as though he is an "arteest". Lots of projects that take a lot of effort as well. Don't take this class unless you love the topic or need it.

I absolutely loved the class I took with Cicneros, The Rhetoric of Social Movements, it was interesting and he seemed genuinely interested in the material he was teaching. He was a fair grader and if you participate in class he will give you a good grade.

Personally, I hated this class. I feel like he never responded to my emails when I needed him or had a question. Teaching not so effective. Never wanted to go to this class. However, attendance is mandatory for participation grade. Favorite part was the grading contract. You can pick how your grades will be weighted.

You don't need to buy a textbook which is nice. There is only readings and projects as homework. The reading is manageable and only skimming will work. I didn't read after the first 4 and I was fine. There are no tests and the final is a 7 page essay. She is nice, smart and makes everyone feel welcome. Class can be boring but content is cool.
There must be almost 600 people in this class, but it feels smaller because Ciafone's lectures are smart and interesting and she really connects with students

Very left leaning, which isn't surprising. Other than that, the class was very easy. There are a lot of readings but you can easily get by without them. The tests claim to be based off of them, but most of the info on the tests is straight from lecture. Just go to lecture and you'll be fine. Final project was a lot of time but fun.

Not even a film or media major but would continue taking classes with Ciafone if they fit in my schedule. Not only does she sound smart, but she sounds engaging. Got me interested in a class/subject that I thought was going to be a blow off beforehand.
lectures were sometimes boring but the project of creating your own 2-3 min film was fun.

I love Professor Ciafone! She really knows her stuff, and cares about her students. Go to office hours, not because you're struggling, but because she's really interesting! I also did the Honors project for this class and it was actually really fun. I'll surely be taking some sort of class from her in the future.

Easy and interesting class. I didn't study for one exam and am going to get an A or A+. Literally do the readings(I did them but you probably don't even have to do those), watch the movies, and pay attention in lecture (which shouldn't be hard because she is a great lecturer) you'll get an A no problem. A really fun class that covers 2 GenEd Reqs.
so interesting to listen to in lecture. knows her stuff since she has worked in the industry. love love love.

Lectures are mandatory since she doesn't post notes online and there are iclicker points. 2 lectures and 1 discussion. 2 papers in discussion that are pretty easy. 3 exams and no final. Good amount of extra credit. 1 group project where you make a short film. You have some readings on compass, but can do without. Overall fun class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Super easy class where you will still end up learning a lot! Andrei is a great professor and a very nice guy!! Take him!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Very good professor! He makes an intro class quite intriguing with a lot of examples. He's very knowledgable and always willing to answer questions during the class. Exams are very straightforward, just follow the review sheet and you'll do great. Best choice.

Andrei is very nice and helpful when you reach out to him. However, he is not the most exciting lecturer. This is a pretty standard intro class, and not difficult at all if you take notes during the lectures.
Very easy workload and midterms were very clear. He is super sweet, but his lectures are bit boring at times. Overall good teacher though and very approachable outside of class!
His slides are clear and easy but the lectures can get boring at times. He use very little amount of videos. Just refer to the textbook for whichever part that you missed.

Very straightforward, attendance was not required but extra credit opportunities were offered in class which removed stress for the exams! Just study everything discussed in lecture and the tests will go fine.
Great teacher and very interesting class. Although he splits time with 4 other professors teaching this course, he is very good and teaching his material and I would recommend this course to anyone.

Dr. Cimpian is the best. His lectures are so clear and you can tell he has an in-depth understanding of the literature. He definitely made me more interested in learning about child and cognitive development.
DR CIMPIAN KNOWS MATERIAL WELL. AND I LIKE HIS TEACHING STYLE. BUT IF YOU DO NOT LIKE READING ARTICLES AND TEXTBOOK, DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!! !

BEST. CLASS. EVER. Prof. Cimpain is great. The class is extremely interesting, and grading is fair. If you study hard, you should have no problem acing it. He is always willing to help if you have a question. But be warned- the class involves a lot of reading (especially of journal articles), so if that is a problem for you, I would not take 462.

Communication with Clifton was almost impossible. For our final project, we were required to get our topic approved. My group sent multiple emails throughout several weeks to Clifton without a response. Canvas is experiencing a shutdown, and we have received no communication from her regarding our class expectations or assignment deadlines.

Dionne is a nice person who has done well for herself in the world of sales and real estate, but her class sucks. She makes students buy a separate platform for discussion posts instead of using Canvas or other free platforms. She made us purchase pdfs that were mostly available for free online. Her class was an easy A, but not an enjoyable one.

I really liked Dionne's class! I thought it was a fun class to scatter through my tougher classes! I'm not sure why she doesn't have a higher rating tbh. You can tell she deeply cares about the world of sales. She's highly knowledgeable in this field, as she has a real estate brokerage, which I feel only adds to the course! Just do the HW and EC!

She is LAZY and her class is HORRIBLY structured. She genuinely only cares about her real estate business and gives out credit for following her on instagram 💀💀. She doesn't respond to emails and her TAs aren't very timely either. They also take forever to grade assignments.

Many reviews on here have a negative rating of the ADV320 ONL course and Dionne, which I don't understand. Personally, I don't feel strongly on her, but I didn't mind the class. This course is very easy as its dependent on Canvas Quizzes, short papers, and discussion posts. I don't like the way the final project is formatted. The course is okay.

In a class that's fully remote, with no Zoom component to interact with peers, we have TEN group members for our final project. Guess what the project is! It's not a powerpoint. It's not an activity. It's an ESSAY. Just laziness in terms of not wanting to grade individual essays tbh. She makes it so much harder than it has to be.

Will never understand professors like Dionne who want their students to struggle. On top of paying for the textbook, you also have to pay for a discussion board website, despite Canvas having a space for discussions for free. Clearly her real estate business is suffering, otherwise she wouldn't be begging students to follow her Instagram.

She does not check her emails and her classes are very disorganized. She is highly invested in her outside business and does not seem to put in much effort to her classes. Overall easy classes with the same structures. Pretty costly class as she puts all the reading in $40-$60 platforms.

Easy class, terribly organized. Lectures are old and deep within the files section. Also, having over ten people on a final project is asking for disaster and giving extra credit for students to follow your instagram page is just down right unprofessional.
Pretty terrible professor. Whole class is basically a plug to her real estate business. Not organized at all and talks about nonsense

Her class is probably the most disorganized excuse of a class I've ever been a part of. It's almost impossible to reach her though email, so expect multiple days for a response. Lectures look like they are a decade old, the structure of assignments and especially the final project was horrible. 10+ people for a final project is ridiculous.

This class has been the most unorganized, poorly communicated class I have personally taken at here. Dionne seems like she puts no effort into teaching this class. The lectures are 10 years old, she is difficult to get ahold of through email, and her Canvas page feels unorganized and hard to navigate. Easy class, but it was not worth it.

I heard a lot of bad things about Dionne before taking the class but tbh I think if you are doing everything you are supposed to do, you shouldn't have any problems. She isn't lazy, she is just a business woman and has a lot of things on her plate. She is also funny and engaging in class! Overall an easy A if you are good student.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment: Do not listen to the bad reviews! Her in person ADV270 class was so much fun and very manageable! There are some readings through coursepack but not bad at all, weekly discussions, some quizzes on the readings, and a group project. She is hard to reach via email but there are TAs. I would def recommend this class to anyone looking to take it!!!

Lectures are clear and interesting, although sometimes it is painfully obvious that she is just reusing things from past semesters - so much so that her announcements have wrong dates etc. Overall though an easy class. I've heard from others that she is not super responsive, but I haven't had that issue.

She is by far the worst professor I have had in my time here. The very few times that I have emailed with her, she was really rude and passive aggressive. She grades really hard and takes forever to put in grades. Some assignments I even got a 0 for even though I turned it in. Overall, I would not reccommend taking a class with her at all!

She is the hardest professor I have ever had. Doesn't respond to emails. Hasn't graded any assignments the whole semester and the class ends next week. Puts 0s for assignments that aren't even due and then it tanks your grade for the rest of the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: Did not grade one of my papers worth 10% of my final grade even after final grades were locked in. (I messaged her about it and showed proof I turned it in on time)

Class is pretty easy & manageable even for a non major. Group project is a mess. Over 10 people in one group in an asynchronous course is a recipe for disaster, plus the PowerPoint based on our research paper was due before the paper itself, creating a hassle. Also didn't like that I lost points for having one line on page 2 of a 1 page assignment

Avoid her at all cost. She provided the link to the wrong reading materials, made us buy it, then refused to acknowledge she linked the wrong thing and I still have to drop another $50 for some online articles. Her class is a mess and honestly feels like she's abusing online classes as a side hustle. Also made us buy discussion website for an 8week

You have to take the quiz first before you are even allowed to watch the lecture, this is the weirdest part. But this class is very easy, light workload, the quizzes are a little hard, but acceptable. The class is very easy to get an A, but the teacher is terrible, it takes her at least a week to respond to your email. She is a real estate agent.

This professor was ridiculously hard to work with as a DRES student. Expensive coursepacks/discussion portal. I have accommodation to miss class/assignments due to a medical condition and she gave me a very hard time. Class content is extremely surface level and basic, she relies on youtube videos and breakout rooms to avoid lecturing.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Turn in a 1 page paper on a quick reading, around 10 pages a week, and do a couple discussion posts and it's an easy A. Open reading quizzes. Every class she teaches is the same structure with different readings. Highly suggest taking it online to avoid pointless lectures with required attendance.
awful
Lots of writing and discussion posts required every week
She's a the toughest grader I've ever seen in my life. She even gave us more homework during the thanksgiving break. She's also a very mean professor that gives no understanding to her students.
Had no idea who is in my group for the final project and received zero communication from any of the TA. Did it on my own and she said it's not acceptable. WOW

Not a very flexible instructor. Most of the teachings come from the assigned readings. What's the point of the lecture videos then? Not a hard course, but small mistakes (AKA not understanding the instructions in the beginning)will greatly affect your overall grade). I love what the readings had to offer though and the case studies. ugh. good luck

Dionne seems like a great lady! She always has a ton of energy and I would love to be her friend. However, grades took a long time to get put in and class was very unorganized. Due dates were not updated from previous years. I enjoyed the class, however, cause she respected if our cameras were off, graded things lightly, and cancelled class freq.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: I liked Dionne a lot. We zoomed a lot one on one this semester and she helped me through a really hard situation personally. I read some other person say the quizzes are not fair, but the TAs make and grade the quizzes. The TA is useless but if I had a problem I would just talk to her directly. I learned a lot in this class and it was easy.
I learned a lot in this class and ended up doing really well in an interview by talking about the things I learned in this class.

Super inattentive, does not even bother to check if her quizzes have spelling mistakes, a lot of her quiz questions are missing words so they do not make sense, asked to zoom with her about potentially dropping the class and didn't even bother to show up to her own zoom call. She doesn't seem to care about what she is teaching or about her students
The class is easy but you have a lot of reading. Not too many assignments
Took this course with a friend. We both got A+. Its very easy to get a good grade but you cant miss the assignments
This class is online so you dont have to attend. There are weekly due dates you cant miss but not a lot of homework. The quizzes are fair and you dont have to read if you watch the lectures.

I dont know how anyone does bad in this class. The quizzes are open note and easy if you watch the lecture videos. If you miss a question she will give you the points back if you explain. The case studies are kinda hard to read but I spent 2 days and finished all of them. Group project was bad because my was lazy, but overall the class was good.

This class is not hard, but there is a lot of reading. Not too many papers due, only 5. Group project is kind of annoying but she let us pick our group. grading is slow, but she has a good personality and the class is fun and interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dionne is a good professor. I learned a lot in this class and she helped me get a internship. You really do have to do the reading but it is not hard to get through. If you go to her office hours you will likely get more out of her and the class since its is all online.

Dionne is probably the most unorganized and unmotivated teachers I've ever taken a class with. She pre records all of her content and reused all of it from 2017 when she first made them - even if they are inncurate! Every class with her is built exactly the same way, showing no creativity or effort. Rarely responds to emails, poor communication.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Class is okay, material is very easy to get through and assignments arent too difficult. She isnt a very fair grader though. Myself and some of my group members didnt comment on other group projects at the end of the semester and she failed us on the entire project for it because she doesnt do partial credit.
extremely unfair and she does nothing to help her students. learned absolutely nothing in her class.
Dont take the class. It is not worth the money. Zero academic interests sparked and you wont get your feedback until the last week.
She has no idea what she is teaching. Plus she won't get back at your work until the last minute. Not cool at all.

Not a hard class, but she's very unorganized. Case studies from the second week of class were not entered until last few days before grades were due. Hard to reach outside of classrooms. For her online class, she was always claiming that assignments and documents were open when they were not. Very unprofessional when answering email.

No easier class on campus where you receive so much knowledge useful in the real world. Do not copy assignments from friends, you will get caught and get an F the case studies are so easy and Dionne is so chill but a little disorganized. She brings in awesome guest speakers and her MDIA370 (online) class is even easier. 1 big group project -- easy

This class is basically the same as her 320 class: case studies, quizzes, online discussion forum, case papers, and a group project. Easy class if you do the readings & don't wait until Sunday night to do everything. If you just watch her lecture videos you can get by without reading the case studies.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Easy online class if you do the readings (case studies) & stay on top of things. You usually have a quiz based on the readings & then a 1-page paper on them too. Only an 8-week course so the cases aren't too bad, but some can be long & a bit boring (the ones in 370 were more interesting to me). You have online discussion posts & a group project.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: 1st yr teaching. Overall I liked the way the class was set up, really easy (average 95%). LOTS of case studies, guest assessments (people come in to talk about their experience in sales industry), & a group project/presentation (it was a big class too). I really like her I think the class will get better as she gets more experience. I recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Professor Cinda Heeren is the best professor I ever had. She is caring about students to learn the material properly and enjoy the class. She keeps involving students in the class. I took CS121 at UBC with her and she is great in relating the material to upper year courses (CS221).

Cinda Heeren is best professor I have had at U of I she made cs 225 enjoyable despite the material being very challenging, the class has a lot of extra credit and it isn't that hard to get an B+ at least if not an A if you put in the time with the extra credit. Good luck if you're taking cs 225 next semester

Great professor! Unlike Professor Fleck, Cinda makes the conceptually hard contents easy enough for us. Though there is a great amount of knowledge and workload, it is way more satisfying taking this course than CS173.

She's honestly one of the best lecturers in the CS department. There is a lot of extra credit in CS 225, so passing shouldn't be hard if you didn't struggle in CS 125. Learning the C++ language (even just basics) before taking the class can make things much easier on you, but isn't required.
The class was not really too difficult, but extremely time consuming, you can easily get an A if you put in the time

Best course ever. You can tell she loves what she teaches, and she's good at teaching it. She cares about students very much. There is tons of extra credit - more than a letter grades' worth, so it's not even difficult to get an A as long as you put in time into the MPs and Labs.

Dr. Heeren is AWESOME! Her lectures are very clear. She managed to cover the materials in detail. MPs and LABs are fun and useful. Tests are straight forward if you pay attention and spend time learning the content.

Lectures are clear and concise while still being in-depth, most of the course content is laid-out and easy to understand. You will have to sit down and think about the concepts but they're not bad at all. Professor Heeren is respectful and dedicates a lot of time to improve the course as a whole. Generous with extra credit, so DO IT.
Great lecturer. The whole course is really awesome with helpful TAs and interesting MPs. Exams are generally fair. Tons of extra credits. Learnt a lot.

She is an amazing professor with enthusiasm and entertainment. She loves to listen to students' questions and participation during lectures. She demonstrates and covers the materials well. TAs & piazza will help answer questions about the materials. MPs and labs takes time to complete and the class overall is not easy but worth it.

Cinda is a great lecturer who is very enthusiastic and covers material well. The TAs & piazza will be your main source of help with questions on material/mps/labs. Though the MPs and material may be difficult, it is worth it. Plus, there's extra credit. Lectures are also online but on occasion slides can be glitchy. Work hard and it'll pay off.
Cinda is an awesome professor! She made me fall in love with data structures and her class helped me land my first internship!

She is enthusiastic but she is not a good communicator. In fact, you have better chance getting help from TAs. TAs are awesome. She barely replies to the emails. Don't get me wrong, she teaches well. My point is she doesn't help students who need help. Overall, I learned what I wanted to learn but it was a horrible experience.
She was just awesome!

Cinda is one of the best professors I've had. She's super chill and easy to talk to. Going to her class isn't necessary (lectures are online), but I benefitted a ton by going to lectures and asking questions. She understands your questions and gives great explanations. I have never written a review for a professor before but Cinda is worth it! :)

Amazing woman! Tests are tough, but she loves what she does and is so passionate. Very approachable, and is very willing to answer questions. She knows her stuff and cares about her students. MPs are hard, but we're CS @ Illinois. You will learn a lot from Cinda and from going to lecture! Highly recommend her! One of my favorite teachers ever. :)

I like how she is always excited to teach this class, but she speaks very slowly. And she goes over the material in a very slow pace making you feel that the course is very simple while the hw is accelerating rapidly in difficulty. The labs are very useful and fun, though. She also takes a lot of questions which makes the class a little boring.

Granted, Professor Heeren is very enthusiastic about teaching and this course, however I did not enjoy my experience in this class at all.  Professor Heeren attempts (unsuccessfully so) to keep lectures interesting through jokes tangents that actually distract.  She also refuses to release answers to the previous exams making studying impossible.

Always so enthusiastic and willing to help students. But the course is tough, if not required by ur major i dont recommend taking 225. BTW, dont cheat on code, she will know and the consequence is harsh.

Cinda is amazing. Data Structures, with her at the helm, has been the best class I've had at UIUC. It's one of the few that has really made me feel like I'm actually in a world class program. She will challenge you but also give you all the tools you need to succeed.
A great teacher! She really cares about her students and wants them to learn. Love her!
She's a pretty good lecturer. Only complaint is that she goes past the end of class and expects you to stay, despite needing to get to other classes. Very enthusiastic, which is a plus.
Best lecturer I've ever had in any class. Amazing.
Excellent Teacher. My best class in uiuc only because of Cinda!
Great lecturer! Very enthusiastic and tries her best to keep the class engaged. MPs can be a bit challenging at times but Cinda and the 225 course staff were always willing to help.

Excellent lecturer. She teaches the information very well and keeps the audience engaged with her entertaining personality. Breaks the mould of the typical CS course. I wish more of my professors were like this.

Very fun professor. The course was challenging, but there is a lot of extra credit available. The exams were fair. Her teaching style is fun and clear, but goes through material quick. She is perfectly willing to help out other students.
Tries to be funny and bubbly but overdoes it to the extent of being unclear. Needs to be more focused on teaching than cracking jokes

Cinda is a Wonderful teacher. It was her teaching style that made Data Structures seem so much more accessible. She's lively, bubbly, and VERY knowledgeable. Approachable too, always willing to help. Also she cracks corny jokes... but best part is that she KNOWS they're corny which makes it stupid funny- the best type of funny. Epic teacher overall
Like a boss

Probably one of my favorite classes at UIUC. Her lectures made the subject extremely interesting and I found them quite enjoyable. I would highly recommend her as a professor. Her class was pleasantly challenging, not easy but very doable.
You can tell she really loves her job. Very cheerful while teaching and promotes a fun atmosphere to be in which makes lectures more enjoyable, even if they go a bit slow at times.
Enthusiastic, but sometimes gets annoying.... Her narration of subjects are really confusing. Need to pay close attention, especially proofs
Extremely enthusiastic! One of the rare professor you will find at UIUC. She is extremely kind and her exams are fair. She often times makes jokes indirectly :)
Extremely helpful, clear, fun - I'm in love with this professor!
very nice instructor

The best prof I've had yet, she has great aids, is cheerful (sometimes a bit too much) and enthusiastic, the quality of the class in itself is really high, and together with her and the TA's help, one ends up learning a ton of stuff. Must take class and professor for anyone looking a good C++ background. MP's are hard and time consuming though.

I took the class a while back then (it was i think fall 09). She's pretty awesome .. She's friendly and very "active" while lecturing - don't expect the normal boring talking-to-him/herself professor! Cinda has perfected 225 with her charisma & new ideas! THere's even a Facebook Page for CS225 where they now upload videos for MP related tutorial!

Cinda doesn't spend as much time on the course as much as other top professors that I've had, but she's an excellent lecturer.  Other reviewers have criticized her knowledge of the material, but at the very least she has the concepts down pat.
Cinda is fantastic at teaching CS225, and she's very passionate about making sure students learn.  CS225 requires a lot of time-consuming work, but it's not too difficult if you put the time in.
She is very funny and nice!
hot

Cinda is a genius.  Her lectures are pretty clear given that some of the data structure implementations aren't intuitive.  She is always willing to help if you seek her out.  The class demands a lot of work, but is rewarding.
Cinda is more than willing to help each one of her students and her exams are fair. Her lectures are interesting and she  is able to keep your attention very well. I recommend!!

Cinda Heeren is a great professor. She knows the course content and beyond very well, makes class fun and entertaining, and is considerate of the students. She is clearly enthusiastic about what she's teaching. This was my favorite class I've taken at this university, and I think most of the credit for that is due to the instructor.

Cinda is a great teacher that teaches the class in a structured and organized way.  Whenever she teaches a data structure, she goes over why we need the data structure fist.  This helps understand why we need the data structure and really helps us understand how and why they work.  Cinda teaches the class well.

Her classes are hard (her exams and MPs are almost insane!), and she is not the most organized person to teach the subject matter. However, her enthusiasm in this subject, along with the fact that she's always willing to help makes her a really good professor. Though some people does not like her, I would strongly recommend her.
she is one of the best teachers i ve come across.. simply the best!

Umm...Cinda doesn't know data structures and she doesn't know how to write tests (avg. score was ~60%). With the useless TA's, I think a lot of people relied on the Internet and each other to get through this class.

Pretty good instructor. Lacks the ability to explain things clearly, but is very enthusiastic and always responds to students. Makes the class fun, even thougth it is hard to understand what is goin on sometimes. Overall, pretty good professor. I would take her again if given a choice
Just plain out sucks at teaching this course. TAs don't know what's going on.

she's nice that's no lie. does she know**** about what she's teaching? **** no. the windbag shows powerpoints that look like someone with down syndrmade them, fiddles with her mac and drinks her starbucks rather than explaining hws that TAs cant even do. READ the book to pass!! the class isn't hard she's just an idiot that you get stuck with

A decent teacher. It seems like she's a little inexperienced and is not the best at explaining things or organizing, but she's friendly and approachable and tries to help however she can. The material itself isn't particularly difficult, so I think she suits the class well enough.

Fairly good teacher. Her energetic teaching style will keep you slightly awake - and that is helpful, because the material is BORING. Heeren has so many students and is so unorganized, however, that she never gets back to emails on a timely basis. Material from the class is covered in the book, so reading it can help. Section leaders are worthless.

Cinda is fun and energetic, but she sometimes gets carried away with an example to the point where it's taking so much time that we don't learn other things.  The class is hard, but she does try to make it bearable.
Noone understands what she is teaching..
lectures were fun.

Cinda is the most enthusiastic professor I know. She really enjoys the material and shows that. Very nice, but a terrible teacher.

Difficult to understand, and she had a lot of trouble teaching this class.  Every other student you asked did not understand half the material in the course, and most of the others only did because they had background or taken a similar course.  Nice and approacheable, but not the best teacher.

The course itself is a bit hard with a lot MPs. But I think she (and her TAs) did a good job. She covered the whole material, and asnwered questions whenever asked.  She's slow in responding to emails, which may be fair because she should recieve lots of them.  It was her first time teaching this course, hence some problems. but overal a good one

A totally pathetic class with the instructor clueless abt what she is teaching. Officially asking students to cheat on MPs to make up for her incompetencies was not a good idea. Also the corrections are totally inconsistent and no sample solutions for examsare provided to help. It is a shame that CS dept offers this low standard of teaching...

She presents the material in a manner that makes it much more difficult to pay attention then is otherwise expected. She should stick to grade school math. Additionaly, if she dosn't like you, you WILL receive a lower grade because of it.
We want to learn the material, not have fun in class and see ur merge-sort dance! Atleast not if we have absolutely no idea wht's being taught.
hard to comprehend what she was saying. She would do a lot of fun stuff but deviate so much from the subject that learning 80% of the material was done by myself which made it extremely hard.
While the material is mostly straightforward, Cinda is pretty disorganized and kind of annoying, which makes the class much less enjoyable.
She could not teach the class, or competently set it up so that you could learn using what she provided.

Cinda and Discrete Maths are polar opposites. Cinda is fun but the materials is tough. She tries SO hard to help her students and she puts much effort to make materials fun for us. She is also generous with points, trying to give more incentives to people who wants to improve their grades.

Cinda provides a great first impression of the CS Faculty to freshman Computer Science students: friendly, helpful, and approachable. No Comments
She has a daunting task of teaching this class as it  is probably one of the hardest in existence. She does a good job of keeping you awake.

173 is not an easy class to teach and most students end up hating it, and therefore the professor. Cinda, on the other hand, is incredibly energetic, fun, and helpful in and out of class. Students leave still hating the class, but loving the professor. I cringe at the thought of anyone else teaching it, but the class is actually kinda fun with her.
A very good lecturer. Very clear.
awesome tacher, very energetic, nice and sociable. Class is hard though :)

I only had her for one class, but she was also some kinda advisor person. In class, she's energetic and fun, tries really hard to keep students awake in a boring class - her enthusiam is admirable. She's knowledgeable about what she teaches (cs173 at least), she's very friendly/nice.

Love this professor. Fun lectures coming from a stem-major. Reasonable expectation for work outside of class. Gives no busy work and makes lectures reflective of the learning objectives. Very accommodating and reasonable. Exams are very reflective of his expectations which he makes transparent. Super nice.
we love dr. schroer he's so awesome, really good professor

Overall a great professor - I had him for Latin 101 and 102. Although sometimes he was strict (like his attendance or homework policy), he was always willing to help and lectured well. reviews.comment:
Dr. Schroer's Ancient Cities class is a genuine pleasure to attend -- The man exudes passion and his deep attention to the students and to his course are constantly made obvious through the semester.

Grading is generous. Three exams, prompts given ahead of time, and a "cheatcard" is allowed. Attend, participate, take notes and the class is easy.

This class is ridiculously easy. There is a lot of reading, and a quiz based off the lecture every week but expectations are incredibly clear. There are also three written essay tests, but you get a notecard, and they are graded very forgivingly. If you need an HSC and want a pretty easy A take this class.

Dr. Schroer is great!Classes are based around a lecture, with a discussion at the end and a quiz each week.The lectures are intensive but he makes them super interesting and understandable. He always is willing to answer questions and is a super caring and personable guy. Accessible,  passionate about his field, and encourages student participation

I am taking STAT207 with Kit this semester. He is a super understanding professor with clear lectures and notes. He is passionate about both lecturing and really cares his students. I recommend taking STAT207 with him!
Very caring, understanding, kind professor. Great at teaching and puts his students first.

If you're not gpting everything it's a bit too much for a three credit intro course in my opinion. Several extra credit opportunities, though test performance is still the most important factor in your grade. Participation matters, which is also kind of baloney since you're randomly assigned a partner/group.

Very gracious to students during class, explains everything in a clear and simple way, and wants everyone to do well. I think the structure of doing lecture videos outside of class and collaborative work in class works really great and is a much more effective use of class time then vice versa.

Not the biggest fan of the "lectures at home, work in class" thing, but he is very very helpful whenever you have a question. The tests are very similar to the practice tests and he makes sure you understand at office hours. You will have to watch the lectures on Canvas and take a quiz after but its not bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: good class, very group work focused, plenty of opportunity to get grade back up

Stat 200 with Dr. Clement is a very easy A. He uses a flipped classroom which was intimidating in the beginning, but it's nice being able to look back on lecture videos to study for midterms. He also has class discussions about the work we do in class, making it easy to get an A on all the activities. You can tell he wants you to succeed.

The class functions on a flipped classroom structure. There is lots of opportunities to practice and ask questions. Kit is a delight, always willing to help and explain concepts in easy to digest ways. He makes learning approachable. I have previously taken a stats course, but I don't doubt that someone new to stats would succeed under Kit.
helpful and patient
Tons of helpless assignments and in-class works.

The way this class is structures is honestly unrivaled. The way Rstudio and TinkerPlots are used to develop a very intuitive understanding builds a very strong foundation for future statistics courses. As someone who's done stats before taking this class, I'm not too sure how this class is for a new stats student, but I'd say you're in good hands.
Enjoyed listening to him yap in class and in video lectures. Fun guy to be around and a pretty easy, laid-back class. Often able to get out of class 5 - 30 minutes early too.

Super caring teacher who wants everyone to succeed. The main parts of your grade will be in the in-class activities so it's important to go to class, and these are completion grades. There's only two midterms and no final, midterms are definitely outweighed by the homework and in class assignments.

Kit is an amazing professor. He piloted a new, collaborative learning format for STAT 200 and it was an instant success. He cares for his students, is open to feedback and improvement, and designs the course with the intention of his students succeeding. His online videos were informative, and he was very accessible inside and outside of class.

This guy cares about teaching and about teaching effectively. He cares about his students and has compassion and flexibility for their circumstances. His course can be annoying at times, but that's because it's built to pull you towards success and understanding. He's always trying to improve—it makes him one of the brighter minds on this campus.

Kit is a great professor, great personality and makes his lectures and videos very engaging. Class goes over a lot of great and interesting statistics topics and R code. Tinkerplots assignments were great visualizations for understanding topics. Very clear grading criteria, generous grading, and plenty of EC. Great professor and awesome class!

Kit is one of my favorite profs I've had here. You learn by watching video lectures outside of class, and class time is spent working in small groups on assignments based on the videos. He's a really nice guy and very approachable during office hours. Relatively easy course if you've taken some sort of stats class in the past.

Kit is one of my favorite profs I've had here. You learn mainly through the video lectures outside of class, and the class time is spent working together with a group of about 3 people on activities based on those lectures. This really worked well for me. The course is relatively easy if you've taken some sort of stats class in the past.

Kit is one of my favorite professors I've had here. He is very upbeat and made lectures exciting to come to, and he was always super accessible outside of class. Video lectures are watched outside of class, and you would work in groups of around 3 during class to finish related assignments. The class is well structured and I thoroughly enjoyed it.

Kit was a very good prof. He clearly cares about Stats and his students. He does lecture on videos that you watch over the weekend and Tuesday and Thursday are small group (3ppl) homework assignments. Makes an interesting style but can be difficult if you get paired with a bad group.

I really admire the way Kit designed this class. There's no textbook, lectures are recorded videos that we watch for homework, in-class group work is productive and always doable, there's many assignments but they aren't burdensome and it makes it so nothing has too much weight on your grade. Overall great class procedure, lectures, and workload!

He was a good teacher, but I found him a bit boring in lectures only. He is a sweet person during office hours. He low-key rocks. But during lectures, the talking is way too long, and especially hour-and-a-half classes can get really long. Paying attention was really hard sometimes, but if you can handle that, he's the best to go to.

Kit is by far the most understanding professor you will ever meet and for that alone he deserves every star possible. He was easy to reach outside of class and very easily accomodated me when I missed a quiz and THE IN PERSON FINAL! Seriously, this guy is an absolute gem of a professor and you would be lucky to have him. The class wasn't too bad.

Kit is SUCH a great professor. Made stats fun and engaging, truly a great guy who cares a lot about his students. His lectures can get a bit long, but he's early in his teaching career and really takes feedback into consideration so I don't foresee this being as much of an issue in the future. Highly recommend!

I wish everyone could know how great prof clement is! He's funny and cares for his students a lot. As long as you come to his office hour he would spare no effort to help you better understand the content. Always patient and easy going, a professor really loves education and math.

I had Professor Clement for STAT 100 and I thought that he was a great professor. While sometimes it's annoying to have mandatory attendance to just sit for a lecture, Professor Clement takes a different approach and makes the class more interesting. Majority of the points come from attending and participating in the class.

My favorite professor at this school so far; you can tell that he's a genuinely very nice person who looks out for his students. Although our lectures were long, I appreciate how much he tried to keep us focused through relatable examples. My only complaint about his system is his attendance checks, but he's mostly lenient on that as well.

Professor Kit is amazing! The lectures are long (1hr 20 min), but he tries his best to break it up with practice problems (although he will stop if not enough people are actually working together). The homeworks and tests are straighforward. Office hours are great and the course staff is very helpful.

reviews.comment: One of the best professors when it comes to teaching an introductory statistics class. His guided notes allow you to focus on the material and not worry about writing everything down. 10/10 would take his class again.

reviews.comment: Good lecturer and knows his stuff but it can get boring. The lectures are long and the information is thrown at you. Needs more collaboration and discussion to get to know people. He is a great lecturer and provides fill-in-blanket lecture notes for the course.

This ice skating class is super fun! The Canvas assignments are easy to complete, and most of the grade is from attendance. Dr. Clarke is very caring and looks out for all of us on the ice. She'll notice if you're struggling and directly guide you, so she is engaged during class. I have much more confidence to skate on the ice now. Great professor!

Prof Clarke is one of my favorite professors, and SOC 162 was one of my favorite classes. She is an incredibly caring person and never hesitated to help me out. She also encourages her students to go to interesting seminars and events for extra credit. I would highly recommend!

A decent amount of extra credit opportunities, interesting readings and lectures, and clear grading criteria made this course very engaging. Prof. Clarke cares about her students, and she is very kind, accessible outside of class. I highly recommend taking her classes, as she teaches a variety of classes, from Sociology to Community Health.
