TOO MUCH READING. This prof sounds exhausted every time when she starts to talk - not a qualified lecturer at all. What she simply does is to repeat the words in the textbook with terrible explanations and examples. No feedback.

SOC 162:International Health policy Lots of reading, in-class activities, Map quizzes, exams and one group project. really cares for her student success, the map quizzes are easy but you really need to read the articles and the textbook to pass the exams. interesting lectures, has power point slides , works with students if they struggling!

SOC 196:Issues in Sociology sport and mental health Amazing Professor!! there is a lot of reading and a research project , but really cares for her students. reviews.comment: Professor Claborn is a very nice guy, would definitely take again! RHET105 is composition 1 for the University of Illinois so the curriculum is standardized no matter who teaches it. he's a great professor, probably one of the nicest professors i've ever had. 

had him for ENGL259 and he very clearly knew what he was talking about.

the class organisation was a little iffy sometimes and he didn't always respond to emails the best, 

but we all (the whole class) LOVED prof claborn he was the best ♡₊˚

reviews.comment: He loves his students and he makes all assignments manageable for his students to complete on time. He is really nice and I loved hearing about his personal life. He understands that students are taking difficult classes and that his class isn't probably a priority. Take him if you can. It will be fun and stress free.

John is AMAZING! He is genuinely so caring and wants the best for his students. If you have to take RHET105 at UIUC, then I would more than recommend selecting John as your professor. There are a lot of essays to write but they are all very manageable.

I love this man. He is so kind and truly cares about his students. He doesn't make us do busy work assignments, everything he does is for a reason and helps in the long run. We had to write 3 pretty long papers, but he is very gracious and gives valuable feedback to everyone. Definitely recommend!!
Amazing teacher TAKE his class if you can!!!

Professor Claborn is a kind and approachable person. He is always willing to help and contact with students. It's easy to get a good grade if you can follow his instructions and write some decent essays. We like John.

Really nice professor, very passionate about what he teaches, very friendly. Honestly very thankful of how understanding he was with me this semester since I had a really tough time overall in my classes. Would take the class again, the movies we watch are interesting too, old movies and newer movies keep the class feeling fresh.

Very caring and understanding. Insightful class. Make use of the material and show up to class. There are a few papers but the grading criteria is very clear, you will get an A. Highly recommend this course and professor.

Best word to describe John is chill. He's just a guy who really likes movies and wants to teach you about them. reviews.comment: He is so nice. love him. He absolutely loves this course and it is enjoyable to go to classes and watch all films required. Don't need much workload, show up and remember the quiz, you will pass

John is great. Really great. Participate in class, go to class, turn things in on time and you will pass. John is a really good guy and knows his stuff. He was always accessible and gave great feedback. Super understanding. 10 out of 10 would recommend

He is a great guy and I respect him as a professor. He is a sarcastic person who makes the lectures easy to get through and semi fun for someone who doesn't care for English classes.  Just do the work that he assigns, ask questions in class, and you will get an A.

He is a humorous professor.  His quizzes and tests are easy as long as you go over the PPTs and the handouts.  Feel free to go to his office hours and email him your draft, his advice is valuable and inspirational.

Very helpful, nice guy. He's also a 'merciful' (bordering on easy) grader, but seems to assign a lot of what I feel are 'petty' writing assignments in between major papers. He's funny and his class is entertaining.

Very manageable workload, read some excellent novels, would take the class again for sure. Discussions were always really interesting. He's the kind of instructor that gets students to talk - not the type that rambles about the novel for the whole hour. Great class
He is a very chill, funny guy. Really easy to talk to. He is also an awesome teacher and his poetry class is a lot of fun. If you pay attention it's easy.

Claborn is a good film teacher, and his material is usually pretty easy if you just go to lecture and listen.  Beware however he doesn't accept late work at all, nor is there such a thing as an excused absence even if your mom died or something.

His class seems like it might be hard at first, but it was easy and pretty fun.  He's a cool professor.  Just make sure you take decent notes and look them over before quizes and tests.  Go to most of the movie sessions.  B forsure, A is very possible.
Never had him for a course but was in his group. Not a good PI at all. Does not care about his grad students! avoid!

This course tries to convey too much material for one semester. Homework problems are very time consuming, sometimes going up to part (h) for a single problem and are not very instructive. The second exam was also much more difficult than the first exam, leading to a very easy final. If this course cuts down on some material, it can be instructive.

Covey is a OK person, but the lecture often leaves with few information or lets you confused. Learn with the TA and be aware of the final exam that worth you 30% of the grade with only about 12 questions.

reviews.comment: Professor Covey is decent. His lectures are inoffensive but nothing special. You'll do more learning from practice problems and the discussion section anyways. reviews.comment: Covey is a ok to good lecturer. However, good lecturer is not required to do well in the class, as the class mostly consists of conceptually understanding formulas. I learned mostly through my discussion TA and understanding practice tests. 50% of the class is non-exams, so as long as you get above 80s on all the exams you should end up with an A.

Does not care about students. He prevented me from accessing study materials for the final because I had to take it late due to illness. Lectures were delivered in the most monotonous way possible and concepts were extremely hard to understand. Steer clear.

Extremely awkward when lecturing and just kind of drones on. Absolutely no personality, I just kind of wanted to fall asleep, which I might as well have because he explained pretty much nothing well. I would highly recommend choosing the async grading scheme if you have this prof because his lectures are not worth your time
Not a great lecturer. Tests are hard. Overall not a great experience.
Great professor. Covey is patient and helpful and explains quantum physics very well. He responds to emails quickly and is friendly with students.
Covey was a great professor. His lectures were informative, straight to the point, and error-free.  He's also accessible by email and in-person. Would recommend he's a solid professor.

reviews.comment: Cool guy, very smart, nice lectures. Took him Spring 2021, but ended up having to drop the class due to family matters. Most of the work for the classes is determined by SmartPhysics, which Covey does not have much control over, so keep that in mind.

Prof Covey is a great instructor and very attentive. If you've never taken physics before, I would highly recommend doing as many practice problems as possible and going to as many office hours as possible. Knowing the concepts without having to check your notes is really important for the tests.
He was a good professor who gave students the opportunity to learn. I liked the way he lectured and definitely would take the class with him again

reviews.comment: Professor Covey was attentive and great at explaining concepts during the lecture.

reviews.comment: This class is the easiest thing ever if you have a working brain. The practice questions are EXACTLY like the exam questions if you do enough. The only students complaining are the ones who don't wanna show up to class.
Bad delivery of material, had to self study everything anyways, but wasted time being had to sit in the mandatory lecture
the mandatory lectures were about as helpful as watching paint dry

My main problem with this course is that the self-readings cover a good chunk of topics, yet the lectures will only cover a small portion of the reading. reviews.comment: Attendance should not be mandatory. Everything talked about in lecture is not on the exam. Always asks  us to boo her when she makes a mistake in lecture. She says yo atleast 10,000 times during lecture. You need to self learn everything if you want a good grade in this class.

I would highly recommend taking an alternative class if possible because genuinely what is this. She doesn't even know what she's doing. The lectures are absolutely not helpful at all when it's mandatory which I don't understand because I had to self-learn anyway. The questions in the exams are so different from what we learned in lectures.

Colleen does not know what she's doing. the lectures are no help at all and there is limited resources to help you. we have 4 exams and a final asking the most irrelevant questions at times making you lose points for a question about the internet. coding questions on the exam are hard to do with no help or guidance from the prof during lecture
Attendance for this class should not be mandatory, the content in lecture did not match the quiz content at all, had to self teach regardless.
Everything you learn will be from the Zybooks not lecture
The lectures were so unhelpful they should not have been mandatory. Avoid if possible!
Hopefully they find a new professor for this mandatory course
wouldn't wish this class on my worst enemy

Worst prof ever. Mandatory lectures and points off for checking your phone. The lecture was not even helpful, and when all the students asked for live coding she did it once and did it wrong. Worst 2 hours of my week.
Yo, so if you're reading this and yo let me tell you you might be the most patient person on earth but, yo, I can't emphasize this enough: Yo gone get sick of the word "yo" if you take this class.

Colleen's class made me reconsider taking more CS courses. The material wasn't very difficult, but lectures were often disorganized and hard to follow. Attendance was emphasized more than clear instruction. Many resources were mentioned, though few were truly helpful for understanding the material. (RMP doesn't support free speech)
Basically needed to teach myself everything to actually learn. This course is very test-heavy and has lots of homework. The professor does not listen to feedback.

Probably the worst professor at UIUC. Lectures aren't worth anything so get ready to teach yourself everything. She's also really annoying and will say 'Yo' about 99 times a lecture. Take stat 107 this is the worst class ever taught by the worst professor ever.
She's really goooood, best professor
She's great

Her lectures are pretty much useless, she doesn't talk about what's on the test in lectures, the only reason for my A is self-teaching the material. There is an exam every other week which must be completed outside of normal class time, and she takes attendance in lectures by making all 300+ students scan their ID's before they leave every lecture.
The lectures didn't connect to the homework, nor did the laps; nothing connected to each other. This stuff doesn't make any sense.

Lewis teaches the class well but for some parts I feel the lectures could be improved upon. One 2 hour lecture causes people to lose attention compared to 2, 1 hour lectures. Homework and labs and textbook are good but the key to success is doing countless practice exams as they are as similar as can be to the real exams.

She's an overall good person and a respectful teacher but this is a very test-heavy class. Lectures are long and boring and labs are not very helpful. You really have to put in the time to learn everything on your own if you want a good grade in the class.

This class is terrible. Professor Lewis seems like a nice person and she is enthusiastic about coding, but not a good teacher. Lectures and labs are useless for the most part. Most of your grade comes from the tests so take  practice tests. I also emailed Professor Lewis a couple times with no response, which I thought was unprofessional and rude.

reviews.comment: Very bubbly and outgoing in lectures. Makes the long lecture more interesting.

No coding background here. The class isn't bad but it is self taught, most of what you learn is on zybooks. the practice exams are essential, doing multiple practice exams are key to doing well in this course. Lectures and Labs are long and inefficient. 4 exams, 4 quizzes, and a final is annoying, some T/F questions are curveballs,do practice exams

The course is mainly a self-teaching structure, so majority of what you learn depends on you. Lecture is once a week for review of what you learned. Colleen was alright, didn't really see her much. The TA's were great for the course. I did well and had zero background in CS.

The class was pretty hard if you have no background in coding. However, Colleen is really nice and I enjoyed her energy and passion for the subject. I struggled a bit with this class but I would take her again.

If history isn't your thing, I don't recommend it, but otherwise really covers the basics of global history enough to pique interest.

You only need to study the key terms and relate them to other terms. THAT IS IT. Lecture is beneficial, as he expands on those terms which will help you on exams. He makes the course much more complicated than it has to be.  REALLY BORING LECTURES. Reading the primary sources is unnecessary, as well.

One of the nicest and most approachable professors ever. Always willing to help you. This class has a large research paper and he is very willing to help. Lots of reading, but no more than any other history class. he's extremely intelligent and passionate about what he does, and humorous as well so he's not just a dud professor.

I had prof Koslofsky last year. He assigns quite a bit of reading, but all professors do.. He is extremely helpful and kind. I recommend seeing him during office hours, it helps him know that you are making an effort. also, his name is Craig not Gregory..

Yup, the lectures are not the most exciting. It is definitely a lot of work for a 100 level class but the grading was fairly easy. There were 2 3-4 page essays to write and exams paragraph form. Not much memorization is needed, just basic knowledge of the concepts and ability to connect aspects of the class together.

I love this professor! I had him in a discovery section, and he was engaging, super nice, and really tried to help students understand the material. His exams were tricky, but he was a fair essay grader. I would recommend this teach to anyone.

Lectures are extremely boring and rarely relate to what is given on the midterm and final exams. Writing a 750 word essay every 2 weeks in a 100 level class and your grade in the hands of your TA makes it worse. Don't recommend him at all.

This professor was extremely vague.  We had to write five 750-word essays for the class, only one midterm, and discussions were mandatory for a good grade, as 25% of the final grade was participation.  His slideshows were pointless and he was always repeating himself.  TA's all graded differently - do not recommend.
Interesting class, and very educated Professor

Not the worst I had, but his lectures & labs are definitely harder to follow. His teaching style almost expects students to already possess a certain level of understanding of the content. I don't think this course was difficult, but it was less structured than expected. Note: his office hours are pretty helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lectures are just reading slides for 1.5 hours for a 1-point quiz, labs are 15 minutes of reading slides and "you're free to go", the homework has more reading and writing than a literature major. Halfway into a class called "Database Concepts and Applications", we've only covered basic CRUD operations and joins.
Really bad, AVOID!!!! He does not respond to emails, late with grading too.

Doesn't actually teach anything that the class is about, instead expects us to learn through a certification website you could access and accomplish without this class. Lectures are difficult to get through and don't go over anything important for the assignments or papers. Grading rubric isn't clear and he won't provide feedback points taken off.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment:
Very bad professor. 

If you need recommendation letters, do not ask Craig!!!
Craig promised my friend a grad school rec letter but never submitted it. Despite multiple emails and visits, Craig didn't respond or upload the letter on time. My friend missed a great school's deadline because of this.

Ramon is a fantastic professor who gives interesting and hilarious lectures. We had readings every week, but he always made them enjoyable and digestible. You will not receive many grades in this class, but he gives helpful feedback and insight. As long as you answer the essay prompts as thoroughly as you can and participate, you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Lectures were fun and inclusive, It is mainly the class discussing our assigned reading. Grade is made up of a few assignments. I enjoyed the readings and never felt like I was assigned too much.

Would take every single class he teaches if I could. Incredibly silly guy, very engaging classes. Everyone in my class became friends because of the positive class atmosphere Crespo fostered!! If you need to take Engl200, Ramon is your guy!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Fun professor and course is definetly better if you really read the material. Chill class overall and you can learn a lot
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He was a phenomenal professor who was really passionate and well-versed in the content. The course was presentation based and student led, but every silence gets used as an opportunity to raise a new perspective the class had not yet discovered. The class is much more enjoyable if you thoroughly read the content!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I loved this class. It had nothing to do with my major but I genuinely feel like it was one of the most worthwhile courses I have taken at UIUC. At first the content was a little daunting, but after establishing a good writing format for the papers this class flew by. This professor truly cares about the content, and was honestly so inspirational.

I loved this class! The style of the class was that we would read the material before class and then during class we would have the chosen presenter present a slideshow on the text. Toward the end of the presentation were to answer discussion questions On Fridays, we didn't have class but instead had to answer weekly writing prompts.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I had Professor for ENG270. It was online due to COVID but it wasn't any less easy to follow. If you do what's expected, which isn't much except for watching films, writing one page papers and participating in the discussions, then expect an easy A. Professor's presence was a joy and discussions were interesting if you're into environment films/doc

I had Professor Ramon Crespo last semester for English 373 and I couldn't have been happier with that decision. He gives you ample opportunity to show what you've learned throughout the course. Participation in class discussion is really big but it's pretty straightforward and as long as you add to the discussion and support opinions you'll be fine

ENGL 116 would be a great option for people with a genuine interest in reading classical literature. Thanks to Professor Ramon Soto-Crespo, one can enjoy this class without any relevant background; the secrets to success are to read, to think, and to think more. The coursework is moderate and can fit in a busy schedule. Fame awaits future writers!

Prof. Ramon is a professor unlike any other. You will learn so many things while having a blast and being unable to control your laughter. He engages all his students in the discussions and preaches a classroom atmosphere where everyone can share their thoughts. Couple essays, couple exams, everything manageable and nothing over the top!

I am not usually a fan of American literature, but the variety that Soto Crespo had us read this semester was fantastic. Most of the readings are on the website, except for two novels that we had to buy and read. The essays are short and graded easily. Every student has to present on a reading. Tests aren't hard. Good intro level course for English
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Mr. Soto-Crespo is a wonderful professor. While you do read many things, they are often short stories and he gives you the PDFs instead of making you find them yourselves. He really engages the class in discussion and makes you feel like your opinion matters. Overall, one of my favorite classes so far. Just do the reading and you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: I really loved this class! it's largely just a group discussion class with a few page 2-3 papers and one presentation that I found pretty easy. Besides that and reading, there's no other homework. Ramon is a funny and interesting prof who really enjoys the class and makes it fun

Super enjoyable presence and great person. Passionate about what she does and cares about her students. Brings in a lot of cool guests but is kind of restrictive when it comes to what you can ask them which I never liked. But I do like the professor a lot
Professor Craft was a good professor, but do NOT take JOUR 100. It is easy, but completely unnecessary and a waste of time.

She is very knowledgeable and willing to help. But for JOUR 205 I think the course overall is not well-designed. The points provided are limited so each test or essay weighs A LOT in final grades. The close-book test requires a very comprehensive understanding of all lecture materials and remembering most of cases the reading or lecture talk about.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She was always super nice, super helpful in answering any questions you might have. She asks questions about you and you can tell she cares about getting to know her students, even online during a pandemic. Interesting class, taught me to question A LOT of different morals and look at things from a different perspective, especially as a journalist

Prof Craft does a really good job relating some complex topics to students without making things overexplained. She also has a bunch of connections in the field and brings in multiple guest speakers over a semester which is super cool

I only went to this class twice and easily received an A. Online tests that are incredibly easy. About 8ish writing assignments that aren't bad at all (actually kind of enjoyed writing them). At first there are 15 possible points of extra credit, and then at the end of the semester we were surprised by a 30 point extra credit test!

Craft was really nice and you can tell she enjoys journalism. She is a tough grader, harder than I expected, but she offers up to 20 points extra credit so use it to your advantage. Granted her lectures can pretty boring but the information is necessary for bi-weekly quizzes. Reading is a big part of the course as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: It's a journalism class, so get ready to write. You'll have bi-weekly journalistic assignments due, and bi-weekly online quizzes due Monday mornings. The final was online too! Prof Craft was fun, approachable, and knowledgable. I recommend to anyone interested in journalism! I'm a journalism major but know lots who took it for a gen ed requirement.
I really enjoyed her class. She's funny and knowledgeable

Craft was a great professor for JOUR 205. However, there are NOT a lot of opportunities for points. Your grade is ultimately determined by 3 tests (which are only out of about 40 points) and some reading responses if you choose to do those. She was not clear about how important the tests were, so it's easy to not do well in the class.
She seriously rocks and is so smart. This News Literacy class was so interesting and I would take it every semester if I could. No tests; just assignments.

She is a amazing professor, but you have to work for it. You can choose your grading option, which is nice. She seriously rocks. Take anything with her! She used to teach at Mizzou, so look there for more reviews.
Pretty good lectures but the tests were very difficult. Not in his control though
Professor Shultz explains concepts very well, and uses computer-based simulations to explain difficult concepts. The class is difficult overall, but Shultz's lectures are quite useful.
Explains concepts well

If you have a disability or any health issues, do not take this class. This is a required class for my major and the way she would argue or not respond to even the most basic DRES requests made me genuinely almost drop out of this school. Only class I didn't get an A in as of the end of my junior year, STAY AWAY!!!

REGRETFUL enrolling this one. ECON202 IS DISASTER!!The TI-503SV calculator is mendatory. This thin has no undo function, take a whole second to respond, cannot square.Yet she requires 6 decimal places during calculations which make simple cal like variance&sum up so time consuming. Also you have to write down all the numbers for your cal. DONOTCOME
She is an excellent teacher, and conveys the material in a manner which makes it as easy as possible to understand.  She makes econ 202 much more bearable.

TAKE A DIFFERENT STAT CLASS IF POSSIBLE. The course content is not that difficult(basic stats), but the class is put together so incredibly bad that you have to try way too hard for a good grade in an INTRO stat class. If you get the mean or something basic wrong, the whole test is cooked. no partial credit. teacher, kinda mean, flipped classroom.

I don't get these reviews. I loved Schultz and I loved the class. My TA was great, Xinxuan. Often gave us answers in class. You don't need to go to lecture since it's really just practice problems (which helps a lot), but she does need to see your packet is "completed". Just take notes on the pre-recorded lecture modules and study that.
Not conceptually hard, but poorly structured. Long pre lectures, unclear grading on homework. You often don't know where you stand in the class until the final grades of the semester are posted.
Has no regard for mental health.
Such an unreasonable professor. I wouldn't take this class. Just take STAT 100.

This is the worst class at UIUC. The material isn't hard but the structure is so bad. Everything graded is very tedious to do and they don't give any partial credit, so one misclick on the awful calculator they require you to use and you're cooked. You wont learn anything in lecture. The required book is literally slides printed out. Take Stat 100.

The professor did not teach anything in the lecture instead we did questions based on the pre lectures that you have to watch on canvas every single week before class. These videos were sometimes 2 hrs long.
The materials itself are not too bad, but the way the class is set up for sure troubles a lot of people. Don't take this class unless you have to.
the homeworks are pretty long, they do not really match the exams, but other than seeing past the passive aggressiveness that presents with some students, she's not the worst but not the best either.
don't take this class. the homework is useless and because of it your grade drops. exams reflect what's going on in class but the majority you have to teach yourself. take stat 100 if you can instead
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Don't take this class. She is nice and all but the class is 50 min and you don't learn anything. Also, the calculator is so unnecessary to buy. The tests are heavy and the material does not prepare you well. Don't take this class!!!!!

Very mean and inflexible professor!!! She only allows us to use one unsophisticated calculator that only has few basic functions to calculate very complex statistical functions, which can be totally solved with a higher-tech calculator such as TI nsipre. This imposes much more unnecessary heavy workload on students. AND MOODLE is terrible!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The kiddie calculators were pretty bad. The tests had few questions with sequential parts, so if you drop a negative sign early on, its over. She somehow found a way to make easier content annoying to learn. I recommend taking this class somewhere else.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Uses a flipped-classroom so all learning material is online and practice problems are done in-lecture. Lectures aren't useful unless you need practice. Homework and reviews match Midterms well. The final which requires you to pore through the video lectures is an exception. I liked her teaching style but her grading is a bit harsh.

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!! She will show up late everyday and make you do all of the learning by yourself online. Not once did she show up and do her job of teaching. Lectures consist of 2-3 example problems that she barely explains. There are discussions, but they are NOT relevant to the class and what we are tested on.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Schultz explains the course content well, but you'll be spending less applying it on exams than you'll spend punching numbers into the required kiddie calculator and trying not to double-tap "=".

most redundant teaching method/class I've ever encountered. Lack of effort is notable from first week when directed to watch pre-recorded lectures online and purchase her textbook, which is simply screenshots of the online lectures for $50. Prof. Sun, Buckley or Bebczuk all more competent. Also, is she adding fake reviews on here? Econ dept tarnish

Literally high school stuff, no laptop or any other electronic devices in the lecture, HW requires calculating a lot of tedious but time-consuming stuff such as correlation coefficient by hand even in 21 century…… never would take this again

It's hilarious how much potential this class has to be fair yet isn't. I liked the online video format because it allowed me to revisit the material. There were 6 midterms, 2 drops, which I liked because you don't have to memorize as much. But the midterms were written UNFAIR. Got 1a wrong? The rest of 1 will be wrong too, bye bye 15% of your score

Professor Schultz was very good at explaining the course content.  If you attend lectures and keep up with homework assignments, you'll do well on the exams.   She sets clear expectations upfront and gives you the road map to succeed in her class. It's up to the student to follow through.
Unfair grading practices

She does use pre-lectures online, but she uses lecture time for practice problems that are really similar to exam questions. She gives a lot of resources for practice and help as well. She is always willing to help and she's a tough grader because she sets clear expectations. I had no trouble with the class.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Classes were supposed to be moved from Moodle to Canvas. She just copy and pasted her Moodle link on canvas. When you do homework she doesn't even tell you what you got wrong. She's also just really rude to students. I was in class and saw a student on their laptop and she called them out to 300+ ppl and said "you're probably watching something."
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Class is set up horribly and the professor ignores her students. I had to reach out to her 3 different times about a technical problem during one of my exams that made me get a 0 and she ended up telling me to use one of the exam drops. I told her I had other exams I wanted to drop so she asked for my name and NetId and ghosted me

uses covid-era videos as 'pre-lecture', 6 exams and only meets twice a week (she basically gives herself every 1/4 lectures off), no technology in class, required to use bummy calculator. exams are not partial credit questions for reasons against common sense. class is unnecessarily tedious in every regard. avoid if possible!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class has a reputation for being quite challenging, but if you stay on top of the material and utilize helpful study tools like Unstuck study, you can succeed. The professor's teaching style may not work for everyone, but putting in the effort pays off.

Was terrified of this class based on what I heard about the professor prior. I bombed two online midterms, and still passed with an A because she lets students drop 2/6 of their midterms. Final was the easiest final I have taken at this school, and she gives clear due dates and instructions. Go to TA office hours for homework assignments.

Dr. Schultz definitely has a hard course; however, she is very helpful to her students and does an excellent job conveying the course material.  Additionally, she has recordings of all her lectures online which are great for review (they are so thorough that she could make the class an online course tomorrow).

I can not believe the econ department is still letting this class be taught by this women. Students are having mental breakdowns over a entry level course. She does not care about her students and enjoys putting students in a situation to fail. horrible does not even begin to say how my experience was this course.

6 mid terms for a basic stats class is this department out of there mind?? They also on proctor U so every other Thursday she gives herself the day off. Want help? She does not have office hours. Tests are impossible. Does not lecture she does nothing. If you are seeing a positive review on this course, she probably wrote it herself.

I DO NOT RECOMMEND TAKING THE CLASS. SUCH AN AWFUL CLASS. This class is structured so that you fail no matter how hard you try. The professor doesn't convey anything important during the lectures and her presentation skills are sooo bad. This class is setup for your failure.

Absolutely horrendous professor. In fact, worst teaching I have ever experienced PERIOD. Professor belittles and acts like god when explaining mean, median, and mode in class only to drop the most inconceivable word problems on the test asking you to find the coefficient of variation with bummy poverty calculator. STAY AWAY IF POSSIBLE.

Only THREE answer attempts allowed for those HUGE chunks of homework, NOT QUIZZES, and you will NEVER know which question u got wrong and you'll repeat the same problems OVER AND OVER again, trying to figure out which questions you got wrong until your head explodes and you can salvage a little bit of your GPA in these pathetic THREE ATTEMPTS.

Econ 202 is a terrible class taught by a terrible professor and I got an A. Lectures are pointless. She doesn't respond to emails. Online tests are dumb for this because it only takes one small mistake to mess up the whole problem. It should be a test graded on work. You have to use the simplest calc that is horrible. It doesn't add to anything

This is for those who want to take ECON484: STAY AWAY FROM THIS CLASS. She is awful. The exam is 72% and attendance and participation are 28%. You will NEVER know how she grades your attendance, which means she can do whatever she wants to your grade. Even if you get two 90s in your first midterm, useless, you still get a B. Horrible torture.

why she doesn't teach anything during the lecture time. i have to learn it all through the video from covid time?? so it's time killer. if you dont have enough time to spent on this course, skip it! using stat100 instead.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The exams are way harder than any of the homework or lecture quizzes. She doesn't lecture at all in class it's all COVID videos. She gives hardly any practice and the practice that she does give she doesn't give the answers. Awful teacher.

Her lectures are very good, easy to understand and are all online.I would say if you watch the lectures the quizzes will not be too bad. However, she is not reachable outside of class, and will not respond to emails. The class is very cookie-cutter, follow syllabus and you will do fine. It is not an easy, but if you put in the work you will be fine

took her 202 in spring 
Impossible to reach outside of the class

Let me put it this way, if you want to put yourself through misery, then take this class. Lecture slides give you minimal information for homework and exams. There are 6 exams throughout this course which is unheard of. Office hours are pointless b/c the TA's just read off of the cheat sheet and explain the homework to you. Don't take this class.
Very difficult and you could never see the grade until finished the final exam. That's awful. The professor ignores the student's emails and never reply them.

There are many exams and all fill-in-the-blank questions, no step score, as long as the result is wrong is 0 points. lecture basically can not learn anything are self-learning, can only say is a piece of shit.

Worst professor ever. She gives very few examples that are not at all representative of what is asked from us on the homework. She'll also expect you to use an outdated, non-TI calculator for complex problems. Yet you'll still lose points for not rounding correctly. Also, no electronics in class, despite it being... 2023!

Avoid her at all costs

Very misunderstood professor. Yes, she teaches a weeder class. Her uploaded explanations are so good and you don't need anything else to understand the course. The homework and tests are difficult though and she does throw in some curveballs in the quizzes but the final is easy enough to get a good grade.

Don't listen to the description of this course, it is 100% online in a covid-era format, and the only thing you ever do in "class" is 2-3 easy example problems from the lecture she posts online. She is very rude to her students in class, not allowing them to use any electronics in class. Avoid this class and professor by all means necessary.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Don't take if you don't need to. Professor found out how to replace most of her work with covid era stuff, screams lazy. Online Exams with required invasive browser extension, most material taught through pre-lecture videos, actual lecture just 1-2 problems, inaccurate Moodle due dates, harsh grading, tedious rounding requirements. Save yourself

Easily the worst teacher I have had in my entire life. Has no respect for any of the students. Forces you to use a clunky, "simplified" calculator which makes actually doing homework and test problems near impossible. If you absolutely have to take this course, do it with another professor or try to subsitute it.

For Econ major, 202 is counted in your 30 hour major courses so it is mandatory.all the course materials and knowledge points are all online and she will not say a single word on class. And she will actually stop the course the prohibit students from taking photos of the slides, because she said nobody can use devices on class, which is ridiculous.
Homework due first week of class and have to watch all the pre lectures before class which makes real lectures meaningless. Stupid rules too on attendances and homeworks. No clear instructions.

The exams require answers with 4 decimals, and being a single decimal off means you miss the entire problem. She makes you buy a book (printed out powerpoint slides) for 3% of your grade. Lectures are useless since all learning is done by watching videos. She tries to make an easy stat class difficult for no reason.
the course was extremely bad

prepare to do a huge amount of difficult calculations without using TI, as well as a bunch of projects and case studies. A fun fact about her class is that she seldom taught lessons on lectures since all the courses can be accessed as online class which are also mandatory.

Quizzes make the class horrid. Her online lectures honestly aren't too bad but they don't contain enough information for the quizzes. Her wording on quizzes is absolutely awful and you are not allowed to backtrack. She also seems to not care about technical difficulties on the quizzes either, so if your zoom recording messes up, too bad you get a 0

Absolutely horrible class. For a class that can be substituted, it is so difficult. She goes out of her way to make the quizzes way more difficult than anything in class. She also removed the grades tab on Moodle. Also, you can't go back on the questions in the quiz. It is completely luck based. Just pray you get the difficult ones first.

One thing about Colleen is that she is really good at teaching, I was never confused on any of the topics she taught us. However, the issue with this class was the tests. The tests almost never reflected what we were taught. I would come into the test feeling prepared, leave thinking I did well, and then get a bad grade. No prioritizing of students

I don't know why everyone hates her. The online, pre-recorded lectures were easy to understand. There was one meeting weekly for an Excel project, but attendance was optional and you could do the project solo in 30 min. The 3 midterms just covered the content from the lectures, but her calculator rule is stupid. The material was pretty simple math.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I don't think that teaching a class with a good amount of math through videos is a good idea. The calculators were pretty much useless, and the test was too fast-paced. If you can take STAT 100 instead, go that route.

Midterms are ridiculous. Only simple calculator allowed and too less time. Grade doesn't reflect how good you are in stats but rather how fast you can do computations and without mistakes that excel can do within seconds
schultz is rude, not understanding, everything for the class is online & its difficult math material
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: lecture videos are bad, no time for exams (40 mins) 15 problems, no study guide,

1 midterm worth 24, 1 final worth 25 percent of the grade. Test questions are word problems, and there is no partial credit. The topics are insanely easy but the prof manages to spin it in a way that makes it super annoying.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: she is unresponsive to emails & incredibly rude when she does respond. Given that this class was online, the majority of the questions (unanswered unfortunately) could be found on course hero/chegg/& similar sites. It seems like Professor Schultz copies & pastes her whole course, yet expects & looks down upon the slightest slack in her students.

I took this class first semester of my freshman year and it wasn't so bad. I took AP Statistics so I had a strong foundation of statistics already. Moodle is the main thing used for learning as there are pre-recorded lectures on there so lecture is pointless. Lecture is not mandatory and it's a waste of time in my opinion and the TAs are helpful.

Easily the worst professor I've ever had. Her lecture videos are not helpful when it comes to the homework assignments and quizzes at all. She never responds to any emails and is just a horrible teacher. You're best bet is to go to your TAs office hours every week for hours to understand how to do the work.

Extremely unorganized course. Professor doesn't answer questions thoroughly, she only refer us to the TA's. The TA's don't answer questions thoroughly either. The basic calculator rule is bad. There are no advantages of using a basic calculator vs a scientific calculator. Doesn't reply to emails. Doesn't even teach in lecture. Lots of extra credit

I'm not sure why she is an unpopular professor generally. I thought that she put exactly what she said would be on the quizzes and tests on the quizzes and tests with few surprises. She also hit us with random extra credit to inflate everyone's grades, which no one dislikes. She is good, I recommend, but there is a lot of busy work.

The class would have been fine without being required to use those awful, basic calculators. One little mistake typing into your calculator and you have to restart from the beginning! I do not even think she has office hours. Oh well, at least she is becoming better compared to her previous semesters. The final was not difficult.

The course is well distributed amongst many different aspects and hence allows the students to learn a lot of different things. Pre lectures are self explanatory and hence going to lectures is not mandatory.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Hoo boy, literally one of the worst professors I've ever had. Her class is poorly run, she isn't helpful at all aside from her videos. hated this class.

Shes easily the worst professor Ive ever had. Im still getting a B, but this professor wont ever reply to emails, explain anything clearly, or use an ounce of common sense. Some assignments are due at 5am, some classes we go over one sample problem for an hour, you cant use a laptop for notes but its a stats class, etc
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: She's mean person and doesnt even care about teaching I think.
worst professor ever, dont take his class.

Prof. Schultz does everything she can to make students succeed. Her flipped classroom method works great and lectures are really helpful. She will drop some grades if the class seems like they are working. The videos are very informative and exams are just like the homework. Study HARD for the Final though, it's tough
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I liked Schultz, she really tried to help us good grades and rewarded us for working so hard. My advice would be STUDY FOR POP QUIZZES and STUDY FOR THE FINAL. I had a solid A+ in the class, but failed both the quiz category and the final and dropped to a B+. Overall, not a bad teacher but you gotta work for a good grade.

I was able to understand the material, but the test were pretty hard. She is not the nicest as a person. Half of the final was mostly not from the previous exams, but the last it of class and some previous exams stuff.

reviews.comment: Material is offered on a "you either get it, or you don't" basis, as in the professor gives the impression of being bothered when asked to explain something differently. Questions on quizzes/tests/etc. are frequently vague or don't match the difficulty of what is presented in the lectures. She is also the only professor to give this class.
