This class was pretty rough. Just make sure when quizzes are announced, start studying the related powerpoint THAT DAY. Study for exams with lectures and HW. Exams questions are asked the same way homework questions are. Directional/speed shear are ALWAYS on the first exam, which I thought was unnecessary. Final is terrible from what I've heard.
Highly recommend it!!!!!!!!
Go to lecture for iclicker points. Lab is easy. Tests are more difficult than one might expect, so study if you want an A. Frame knows the material and keeps things interesting.
Iclickers are not grader for accuracy and online homework is usually simple but his tests are difficult if you don't understand all the concepts. Be sure to pay attention and read the book.

Very good professor as he was so good at engagaing interesting and funny jokes in lectures. The exams are a little challenge because good memorization skills can not guarantee you to do well, TA are nice and helpful, assignments are straight foward and easy. Highly recommend this class for a science Gen Ed.

This is a "field observation course" where you go out on the plains for two weeks after finals in the spring. It was SO much fun, DEFINITELY worth your money! Try to get on the first trip cause the second one is after tornado season is dying down/over and is notoriously not as good as the first trip. I learned so much about storm structure. AWESOME

Great guy with all his puns and jokes about current events. Made the weather very interesting and easy to understand. You will get an A so long as you study the lecture slides and form a study group to do RAs together (to get the full points!).

I took this class because it sounded interesting and ended up getting an A+. Professor Frame explains the material well, constantly makes puns and jokes (which was great at 9am), and was very thorough in his explanations. This class is all about understanding concepts and not memorizing, but it's interesting and well taught - you'll WANT to learn.

This class is awesome because of the professor. He explains everything so clearly that it's hard to misunderstand him. Overall, the course has easy reading assignments due before every lecture and iclicker points. As long as you go to class and study for a few hours before each exam, you will get an A or a B, guaranteed.

This class is not hard at all, but there is online reading quiz before every class, and iclicker questions for attendance. He gives out study guides and you can find all the answers from the powerpoint lectures he put online. Overall, the exam was okay, not very easy, but not hard at all. As long as you study a little bit, and knows the concept.

Memorize and remember the concepts of the powerpoint. Go to class for i-clickers. If you do all reading assignments and labs correctly, you can ensure a good grade. This class isn't difficult, you just need to study the powerpoints.

Go to class to get the iclicker points, do all the has (take 5 min to do), go to every lab and its impossible NOT to get an A. Enthusiastic professor that wants kids to succeed. Tests are easy as long as you put one night of studying every chapter on test and he offers extra credit after every exam worth about 8 points
Enjoyable and well taught class.  Also very easy.  Professor Frame is the man!!

Used the book on ONE lab because he copied it too big so it was too pixelated. Luckily it was isoplethed in the book. Exams are easy - just memorize EVERYTHING on slides and know how to do specific things like recalculating resolution. 2 exams + final, labs due every week (sometimes the day they're given), forecast due every class. Not hard though!

KNOW EVERY LITTLE THING ON EVERY POWER POINT. Labs are not as helpful for exams as they were for 303 so rely heavily on lecture slides for study material. On the first exam he asked us something he grazed over in class which was very disappointing. It was one line on one slide in one lecture and it showed up on the exam - 6 points wasted. So sad.

If you can deal with the huge amount of Greek life during lecture then this class will be a breeze. Labs & Reading Assignments really keep your grade up. So do good on those. Exams are hard but they aren't easy. Frame is awesome and really knows his stuff

Frame was Great! I hate that everyone says this is an easy A class. I definitely wouldn't say so. Yes the homework & labs are fairly easy but the exams were not! So, with that being said do good on every homework and lab assignment. It will help your grade in the end. My friends failed the exams and got B's or C's. I got B's on them all & got an A

Frame is one of the best forecasters and storm chasers in the nation. With that, he is also a great professor. ATMS 100 is quite easy and I took it only for the A since there is only crossover with ATMS 120 & 201. Still he delivers the material very well and also his ability to spew out puns is insane and great. Can't wait to have him in 300 level.

I adore this professor. He was so intelligent and nerdy, but it just made learning about the weather that much better! The class definitely wasn't an easy A, but as long as you pay attention and do your labs right, you'll do well and enjoy the class that much more :)

Consistently puts students down & raises his voice when they ask a question he thinks they should already know. Very nit-picky about material so KNOW THE MATERIAL. Preaches about how we will use the book required for this class in 314 but we never use it in this class. But I did learn a lot. Be prepared to isopleth on exams. STUDY LABS!!!

Pretty easy class if you pay attention in lecture and lab, instead of sitting on the computer. Quiz questions come from straight out of the book. Attendance mandatory because of i-clicker questions. Overall, pretty good teacher.

Super easy class. Attendance is mandatory in order to get i-clicker points but the lectures really arent too boring. Labs are pretty easy and so are the exams. I got a C on one of the exams and still got an A due to extra credit and the homework which is worth a lot. this class requires work but its nothing bad at all. take this class, easy easy.

Frame is a great professor who is very knowledgeable. You can tell that he loves meteorology. He has the best puns ever.  Go to lecture and attend the labs, and this class will be a piece of cake. The tests aren't too bad if you go over the slides. Great class and great professor, he truly made me become interested in the weather.

Frame is awesome. One of my favprite classes. The punniest man I know. He made class fun to attend. Very fair syllabus. Go to class, go to lab, and finish all hw assignments online and you will get an A. Get passed a few voice cracks and you will fall in love with this guy
my favorite class!! as long as you do the work and pay attention in class you'll be fine. very interesting and professor frame is hilarious

Great Guy, Frame and the TAs do everything they can to get you an A, all you have to do is put forth a little effort. His jokes are kind of corny but some are really funny. Great QRII class, i'm horrible at science and he made this so easy and fun.

He is really easy if you do your work . The only thing you have to do is go to class for i-clicker questions (only answer 3 out of the 4), do the reading assessments (which you can google the question), and attend discussion. Even though the 2nd test is the hardest, there is no reason anyone should fail until you do nothing at all.

BEST TEACHER EVER! Super enthusiastic-he actually made it interesting. Very straightforward, just look at the powerpoints for the tests. He gives plenty of extra credit, but go to class for i-clickers.

Professor Frame is awesome.  He makes puns and quotes the Simpsons, and he is also very informative.  The exams can sometimes be tricky, but if you do all the work you should be fine.  A very enjoyable class!

This guy is awesome. Extremely passionate about the weather, will gladly tell you about his storm chasing experiences, etc. He makes the corniest puns and talks in a super-nerdy, high-pitched, nasally voice that cracks occasionally. Very amusing guy, easy class. You don't really NEED the textbook though. At least I don't use it.
Great teacher. I clicker questions, compass reading quizes, labs were easy. Tests are easy if you pay attention and review the slides and study guide. Worth taking.

He does not try to give credit on assignments. If you are somewhat wrong, you're getting many points off. He likes to hear himself talk. He will repeat himself over and over as if you are in grade school. He seems power hungry and he wants you to call him "doctor". Least favorite by far.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This was an easy A of a course. Only a brief discussion post, a 300-500 word paper, a 5 question quiz, and some reading each week. Probably the easiest course I've taken. Dr. Fredericks also put effort to make it that way, he explained a lot through email and was very accessible. Although its an online class, he makes the class better.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Asynchronous online class. There's a weekly narrative paper (at least 250 words), a quiz based on the readings (provided to you, no need to buy a textbook), and a discussion post with at least 4 replies on the Packback platform, and a final paper (at least 500 words). As long as you follow all instructions, you should get an A in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Every week you would do a reflection and a quiz (open book/a provided RG, but timed). Prof is enthusiastic, but a tad bit pretentious. Expect almost every class to be a lecture with some form of class participation and instead of a final exam, it's a position paper. Also beware, he randomly calls on students.

If you're looking for an easy A, this class is it.  The homework takes a long time, but it was easy.  He's not as bad as the comments say he is.  Just remember to not miss a single deadline, and follow his instructions properly. He is strict, but if you do what you're told, you can get away with a high A or A+.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Brand new professor at UIUC, classes are significantly harder than they should be, which is not uncommon for new teachers. I wish Robyn still taught these classes. Randomly calls on students to answer. Also quite boring with lots of lecturing.

Made us pay a $40 Packback fee to "get access to the full platform", then micromanaged every single sentence that we could write. PB is already ridiculous, and if you're not going to give creative liberty for us to "earn" the curiosity points, then why use it in the first place? Overall, really overbearing and slightly pretentious.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is a caring professor.
Great course but the content is challenging. Professor cares about his students and the importance of research for advancing the field.
He does not answer emails, but he does give feedback on papers etc. I would definitely take his class again, because he does not grade harshly and answers all questions during class.
Great professor. Very understanding and taught well

Professor Karle and Professor Wade were a great duo. They made the lectures very engaging and were often available outside of lecture time. The practice exams they assigned are very similar to the actual exam, so if you have any test anxiety, I'd highly suggest doing the practice exams.

Karle and Wade work so well together and they make the class interesting. They just overall make the class as easy/understandable as they possibly can, and I appreciate that so much. Loved this class, these two are amazing, and it's such a good intro to python class!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Omg he is amazing! Her and Wade honestly were so welcoming. I would take this class again if I could. Please take this class if you have to and attend the lectures. They are so much fun! She is so sweet and helpful.
One of the best professors I have ever met! Clear explanation, countless office hours, interesting labs and so much extra credits! I highly recommend everyone this course!!!

Fun professor, if you get the chance to take her definitely do it! Be aware the content is not hard but it is very difficult if you're not keeping up to date. Explains very well in lectures and does a great job at answering questions.
Cutest silly lady ever

The class is very easy and the content taught in lecture is similar to what appears on the homework / tests, so it is very manageable to get a good grade. Offers a lot of extra credit. She is very nice!
Good teacher

Attendance policy was extremely frustrating. Scanned the QR code and selected the answer, yet attendance wasn't recorded. It feels unfair and discouraging when technical issues affect your grade and the instructor refuses to correct them cuz the professor said they had no authority to adjust attendance???
You can tell her and Wade enjoy teaching and enjoy their jobs
Great professor who has a passion for the subject which is clear to see! I love how strict she is with the AI usage. “Sincerely apologize” in phrases. Very doable class!
very good and easy to understand.

good.
very good.

She and Wade are so great for STAT107! They're both super passionate about the field and lectures are genuinely enjoyable and interesting. The class does have quite a bit of work, but the way the homework/labs/projects are formatted makes it really engaging so this class never felt like a lot. They also offer a TON of extra credit opportunities.

Easily the most interesting class I've taken. Great environment and prof is so sweet. even if you don't show up to a single lecture you will still be able to get an A. hw is very helpful and make sure to study practice tests A LOT. also make sure you have a great lab group, and understand the labs because the hw for 207 are lab difficulty times ten

LOVEEEEDDDD this classs!!!!!! Looked forward to it!! Prof. Flanagan and Prof. Wade were some of the best profs to teach this class, they designed it so well and it is such an easy course if you pay attention and try.

Amazing professor. Always willing to improve. She brings a lot of positive energy to lecture and office hours and always has a smile on her face. Much less intimidating than Wade, but I think that's what keeps the balance. Also course materials are under $10 and there is so much supplementary material available. And sooo much extra credit!
LOVEEEEEE HER
All the good things!
He is really good, and has many extra credits opportunity.
The lectures were engaging and I thought information was presented in a very digestible way.

Amazing course and chemistry with co teacher Wade. They have created an incredible course with plenty of extra credit, as well as great lectures. Homework is free points. Projects and labs are concise. They have brought Illinois to the forefront of data science.  Also Karle has a Barstool endorsement, so that shows how great she is.

STAT 100 with Karle has to be one of the best courses to take at UIUC! It is very organized and easy to understand if you put in the work. Utilize the practice exams and homework assignments to review for any of the exams. As someone who is not the best at math, I was genuinely very interested in statistics after taking this class.

Took STAT 100 this semester with Flanagan and was one of the most well-structured class I've taken at UIUC! As someone who isn't that good at math, the lectures are very straightforward. The practice exams and homework are a great resource to do well on the exams.

I loveeddddd her. I took Stat 107 which was outside my major but required for my minor and she made me want to take more stat classes because I enjoyed it so much. The exams were somewhat difficult but they give she gives you every opportunity to succeed.

Karle is an awesome teacher. Everything is presented so clearly during lectures. There are a lot of opportunities to earn extra credits throughout the semester. STAT107 with Karle and Wade is one of the best classes in the university!
Karle is the goat

Karle is honestly the best college professor I've ever had. At office hours, she makes sure to make things clear if you don't understand. She has such a great personality but you do have to work for your grade. There are a decent amount of extra credit opportunities. Easy class couldn't say anything bad about Karle she really is the best.

If you're a psych major thinking of taking either this course or the psych specific one, trust me and everyone else in the reviews, take this one instead. Extremely easy to follow lectures, with topics that will actually help you later in life as well. Also, extra credit literally all the time! Flanagan is the GOAT!!!
Engaging lectures, helpful professor, and lots of extra credit make this an excellent class. Unstuckstudy AI was a game-changer for study prep - highly recommend it alongside the free textbook.

Super boring. Didn't learn anything. If you know even a little bit about computers youll be bored out of your mind. If youre afraid of computers, 107 may be good for you. Otherwise take a more useful class instead of wasting your time and money.
Wouldn't give me extra credit because I was missing 1 section of one page in the workbook for stat107.

Stat 107 was my very first college class and it was by far the best class I have taken so far, the course staff is amazing and the lectures are very easy to follow. Assignments are easy to navigate as they mimic the examples done in class. Overall this class is super interesting and there's a lot of extra credit opportunities!
One hundred times YES!!!
Stat 107 was the first co-taught course I've ever taken and it was so well taught and interesting.

For this course, the python required was clearly shown in lectures, but lectures can also be viewed online on their website. The python was basic level, and used the pandas library. If you've taken a programming class before you won't struggle. Similarly, the statistics used in this class are very introductory, similar to AP Stats. Good class.

SO accessible outside of lectures, so many extra credit opportunities and homework is actually prep for what will be on the exams. Is caring and wants to see you succeed. I loved Karle! Take this class, she explains everything so well and I took so much away from it.

Karle Flanagan is the best. Lots of opportunities for extra credit and as much as I disliked the course content, she made the experience very enjoyable.
Good class

Hands down one of the best classes at UIUC. Super easy gen-ed too. She offers so much extra credit, and there's only 3 exams in the semester plus a final. Prof. Flanagan is amazing. The way she talks in lectures are always so fun and interesting, she makes her lectures feel like you're talking to a friend! Karle is honestly a literally angel who has never done anything wrong. She's super upbeat and always engaged, love her!
I took the online section of this class and I felt like all the materials were very detailed and I didn't miss out on anything by not showing up in person.

She is nothing less than AMAZING. She is nice, she loves what she does. She is ALWAYS willing to help. I went to her with problems from another math class and she was excited to help me. It is obvious that she really cares about her students and wants everyone to succeed. She radiates positivity and that made the class 1000x better. You rock, Karle

She's a really good teacher! She's always available for a student in need and not only does she clearly know what she's talking about, but she's really good at explaining it all too. If you have to get stuck taking a stats class, be sure to take it with her.

reviews.comment: I literally love her so much! she made the class so enjoyable and fun. Would defiantly recommend! Lots of extra credit and the tests are easy as long as you do the homework.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT--Would take again

reviews.comment: Karle is a really great professor. Shes easy to understand and extremely approachable. Theres so much extra credit, its unlikely to get a bad grade. I honestly may have gotten an A had I done more of the bonus. And attend class if you want extra credit. Stats seems hard to most people, but Karle makes it so simple almost like common sense.

Karle is a gem. The online class is the exact same as the in-person class, as she uploads the lectures that she gave. Content can be dry, but Karle will literally run out of breath when excitingly lecturing about stats.

Professor Flanagan is the best! I took her for stat 100 and if I needed help with anything, she would always be available for office hours! Her class really helped me better my math and statistic skills! She is so sweet, understanding, and really cares for her students. Plus she gives out extra credit!! She is probably one of the best prof at UIUC!

BEST PROFESSOR AT UIUC HANDS DOWN. Karle cares about you and about stats and never puts you in a position to fail. Show up, take notes, do the extra credit and its an EASY A. She wants you to succeed but she also knows how to teach.
She seems extremely passionate about teaching Stat 100 and keeps what many would consider a boring topic quite engaging and interesting.

Karle is the best professor I had here so by far. She's literally always happy and smiling, ALWAYS. She's great at explaining in detail and she even answer questions in lectures. This course is easy if you go to class and do all of the bonus. The exams are exactly are like the practice exams that are in the book.
She is so awesome! Learned a lot in her class.
Karle was very nice. She gave extra credit opportunities every week through pre-lecture videos, iClicker points, and surveys. If you go to class and fill out the notebook you'll get an easy a
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: So nice, fill out the workbook its so helpful and do the practice exams, the practice exams prepare you well for the real exam

The only way anyone should learn math is through Karle Flanagan. Karle is absolutely adorable and sweet as can be. I suck at math, but she makes concepts so easy to understand and always has really helpful test review sessions. She is everything that anybody could ever hope for in a professor. Not to be dramatic, but I would die for Karle Flanagan

Karle is an amazing professor who makes statistics both understandable and enjoyable. Her love for statistics is so evident in her lectures, which is rare to have in a teacher. I can't recommend enough!

I absolutely LOVE Karle! One of the best professors at UIUC hands down. Her class isn't really hard, I ended up getting an A. However, don't underestimate it. I did have to study and look over some things. Plus, she gives bonus points which really help in the end.

Karle is, and I've used this phrase before I started this review, a real gem. I heard horror stories from my older sister about Stat 100 at a different school, and now I'm trying to become a TA for Karle's Stat 100 class. She's such a fun teacher, the class is easy if you go to lecture and pay attention, and office hours are great for more learning

STATS 100 is the best choice you can make if you'd like to take more math but aren't ready for something like Calculus. Karle is a fantastic teacher. I took her class online (which I highly recommend!) and go to her office hours semi-frequently. She is super helpful and sweet.

Karle is an amazing professors! She makes Statistics interesting and easy to learn. All the tools that are needed in order to get an A+ in the class are given to you. Take Karle's advice and take the practice exams prior to the real exam without your notes. If you put in the time by going to lecture and reviewing for exams, the class is an easy A.
A super nice lady. She is so passionate about statistics which is awesome because I hate math, but she makes me at least wish I loved it :)

You can take this from someone who hates math-karle is freaking amazing! She made class interesting and fun and is willing to meet with you bacially whenever she is free. All you have to do is show up and copy her markings in her book into yours and you are set.

Great teacher! She made statistics fun, easy, and taught it in a way you can remember. tests were exactly like her practice tests, and her final was super easy! Easy A class and also a lot of extra credit opportunities by attending class and taking surveys!

Karle was fantastic! Frankly, the best math-related class I've ever taken. She makes stats easy to understand and even fun/funny. She's very accessible, sweet, and driven to see her students succeed. There are a ton of practice problems/exams and extra credit opportunities -- it's almost impossible to fail unless you don't take advantage of it all.

Karle made the subject of stats way less intimidating and was able to explain things really well. She is available all the time for office hours and is extremely helpful! Even if you're not confident in your math abilities, I'd say take this class because it's not as math based as you'd think.
Bubbly and sweet. Karle's stats class is insanely easy as long as you dont forget the assignments.

Karle is the best teacher i've had not only in college but ever. She's so sweet and makes it clear what you need to do well. It's easy because she makes statistics easy to understand but you still have a put work in to if you want to do really well. If you struggle at all go to office hours Karle and the TAs are so helpful there!

Karle is a great women.  She cares about the students, and really takes time to make sure she is understood.  Awesome teacher, if you have to take stat 100 make sure you get her because she is awesome.  Homework before every class (twice a week), but that's nothing.  Definitely an easy A, and you'll learn some useful stuff
Best teacher I've ever had, explains material so well.  Catch her at TRL on occasion.

STATS100 is known to be an easy class, but if you don't keep up with the homework your grade will suffer (2 assignments (mandatory) & 2 prelectures (bonus points) per week).  It's easy to tune out in class because Karle repeats concepts and goes slowly through content, but if you pay attention it makes it easy to memorize concepts for testing.
Great teacher! !
One of the best professors I've ever had.

This class was insanely easy. My one complaint is that the professor went so slowly through every single example, which may be good for some people, but felt like a huge waste of class time (and therefore the money I spent on that class time).  A 1 for difficulty means "show up and pass" but you could probably pass without showing up, honestly.

Super easygoing, funny, and explains things in a simple manner. STAT100 is an easy class, even for someone like me who doesn't like math at all. You have to buy the notebook but it will be your holy grail. DO NOT buy the textbook, waste of money (she said so herself). So much extra credit, it would be hard not to get an A or B.
The content is easy and Karle is good at explaining it. If you go to lecture, you will most likely get a B or higher.

Karle is the best! You only need one book that you fill in with her during lecture, but if you don't go get the notes from a friend. Lots of extra credit in lecture (iclicker) and online. Homework isn't too bad, it's on lon-capa and if you get stuck read the comments or ask for help. 3 exams and a cumulative final. Fun and easy class overall!

Karle is super bubbly and keeps the class's attention even though the class is super long. She does a great job of explaining but if for some reason you don't understand something, she offers a ton of office hours!
Was such a joy to have as a professor!
She's the sweetest teacher ever and is very understanding.

Karle Laska is my favorite professor so far. She is genuine and loves teaching. It's easy to pass as long as you follow along during lecture and study up a little before the exams. Literal favorite part is looking at survey results in class. Best. Ever. She's just great. Recommend her class highly! She posts lecture videos as well in case you miss.

This class was pretty easy. Show up to lecture, do the homework, and study for the exams and you should be good. I suck at math and got an A. Her and her TAs will always answer your questions. She is super sweet too and tries to make lectures interesting.

reviews.comment: She is a  good lecturer. Stat 100 was an easy course, but it is easy because she is so good at explaining the concept.

reviews.comment: Great teacher that cares about the students
Great

REALLY REALLY REALLY EASY A+. Just review your notebook once and do one or two pass exam before each test and you will get a really high score because the test are basically identical to the pass exam. Super easy, and give a lot of extra credit.

There is weekly online homework on Lon-Capa that is pretty straightforward. Lots of extra credit available. Highly suggest filling out the incomplete lecture notes because it is very similar to exam questions. Go over past exam in the notebook and you will be set for all exams. Highly suggest taking STAT 100 with her. Sidenote: She is pretty cute.

Karle is amazing! She's a really good lecturer who makes concepts easy to understand. She's very enthusiastic and helpful with the everyday office hours with her TAs. There're a LOT of extra credit opportunities to boost up your grade online with pre-lectures and the completed notebook. If you need to take STATS 100, definitely pick her class!
Exams are easy as long as you can memorize formulas and apply them to different scenarios. Lots of online homework
Exams are easy as long as you can memorize formulas and apply them to different scenarios. Karle is hilarious and you should definitely take her if you need to fulfill that Stat100 requirement!

She AWESOME!!! She makes statistics interesting. I know that stat 100 is known for easy A course, but I think it is easy because Laska is teaching. She is really good lecturer. Nice person, nice lecturer. GO FOR THIS CLASS!
Nicest teacher I've ever had

My favorite teacher ever. Assignments can be tedious, but it really helps you learn for the exams. She's really enthusiastic and is always available during her office hours. Lots of extra credit opportunities as long as you go to class. Easy A as long as you attend class!
Nice person but she assigns a lot of hw.
Amazing professor

Her attitude is so positive and bright every class. She explains the concepts veryyyyy precisely and clear. The class was an easy A and still offers a ton of extra credit. The incompleted class notes are veryyy helpful and make taking notes really easy.
STAT 100 is really easy, and that's probably only because of Professor Laska. She gives tons of extra credit and is incredibly sweet
Super nice, especially for such a big class. Hard to not get an A.

If there is any professor to take STAT 100 with, it's her. She's seriously amazing. If only all professors were as understanding and helpful as her. She gives extra credit, gives clear directions, takes great notes, and does not try to trick you on homework or the exams. Best class I've ever taken by far.
Go to class to get bonus points. She offers so much extra credit. There is a good amount of homework but it is easy. Easy class overall.

Karle is incredibly nice and is engaging to listen to. She is one of the nicest teachers I've had and is always available to her students and makes sure we understand the material. The course packet has practice exams, and TA Rachel gave reviews of previous exams which were really helpful. These reviews are optional but she gives good hints too.

Karle Laska is my favorite professor at U of I. She is very clear and concise and is always thorough in her teaching. She offers an insane amount of extra credit and iClicker points. I hate math, but she made me want to pursue Stats 200 next semester just because she made 100 so enjoyable for me.
This teacher is the best!

Karle is amazing! Even if you're not a math person you can do well in this class. I've found that stats is actually very useful in real life. You do have to do weekly homework and go to lectures to understand what's going on, but I promise Karle makes Stats great. Definitely not hard to get an A.
Easy class don't need the book unless you want to fill it out for extra credit. But it does help explain stuff if you don't go to lecture. Homework is on Lon capa and there's 3 midterms and a final.

Stat 100 is a super easy class and it is almost impossible to not get at least an A. Laska is pretty boring to listen to, and we end up writing down the same thing multiple times in the notebook, but the class is very easy, so not much to complain about.
The best professor I have had so far at U of I. Class was easy and she goes above and beyond to help her students.

Pretty clear and concise during lecture. If you have a question, she's always willing to help you out. Usually, she explains things at a simple enough level to where you can understand it even if you aren't really a math person. My only problem is that she has this weird quirk where she always talks like she's about to laugh. It just bugs me.

She's adorable and it is hard to not get an A. She gives it straightforward and as long as you know how to do simply math you are perfectly fine. A very good teacher with tons of extra credit opportunities. She is way too excited to teach her subject but hey it was entertaining.
She is awesome. If you take STAT 100 with this woman, you will easily get A. She is very respective to students and she is always there for you. TONS OF EXTRA CREDITS

I loved this class! Karle explains absolutely everything that you need to know in class. Despite large class sizes, she is easy to contact and eager to help. There are a lot of opportunities for bonus points. In general, a really good teacherclass for new students.
She's amazing, take this class!
Wonderful lectures and she is one of the best stat professors.
she super nice and the class is really easy
She's the best!
I'm not a math person and Ms. Laska actually made me like stats!  Definitely take stat 100 with her if you can!
Easiest class ever.
Such a great teacher.  Explains all material and has the students prepared for exams, and plus she's a 5/5 on the hotness scale

Heidi was fantastic for PSYC 201, my first semester at UIUC. I only ended up with a B due to an accident I was in that semester, but she was accommodating through that process as well. The class was fairly easy and you can do very well as long as you pay attention in class, take notes, and review the slides that Heidi uses during class.
She was amazing. The lectures are long but she made them fun

She is amazing, the topics are difficult but she explains things so well and clearly, definitely my favorite teacher of the semester. So kindhearted and passionate, makes class fun and provides study guides to ensure success on tests. No textbook needed as she covers everything in lecture. iClicker attendance and frequent quizzes, but not hard

Heidi was very kind and understanding. If you do not understand a concept in lecture she is more than happy to go over it with you anytime. The only thing I did not like about the course is how heavily your grades relied on the midterm and final. However as long as you pay attention in class, and do the study guides the exams are extremely fair.

Heidi is a great lecturer and very caring for her students. If you have questions she will always answer them. However, this class is graded by quizzes and tests only. They are not hard if you look over your notes though!

Material isn't difficult, but her teaching makes it hard to follow. Her lectures are disorganized, and her handwritten notes are difficult to read. She believes she's an excellent teacher and better than YouTube, but she really isn't. I've heard there's another professor who is clear, organized, and easy to follow. Please take him instead.
She's really helpful if you go to office hours. I loved the subject and felt that she was a great professor.
Hard to follow. She takes questions but sometimes her answers weren't great.

reviews.comment: She is not a good teacher period. She has temper outbursts, does not care about the students, gives very little feedback and gets grumpy and moody for no reason. She's helpful in office hours and can explain the intuition behind the concept. After you know her exam style from the first midterm, the later exams are relatively easy and are completely what I would expect.

The only issue I had with this professor is that she doesn't accept alternate methods of completing problems outside of what she shows you in class. Also, make sure your work is clear and includes EVERY step - I once should have gotten a 100% on an exam, but instead got a 90% because my work was unclear/not what she wanted.

Funda is a great and lovely professor. She's willing for help and she's very helpful during the office hours.  People who think her tests are hard is because they didn't study. Her exams are straight forward with 10 bonus points. Remember, it's proof class, don't think you are better than professor, be modest and put some effort, you'll sget an A.
She's honestly not that bad. Tests were hard but she gave a VERY generous curve at the end. She is also pretty hot..
Not a great professor, although she did teach you everything you need in class, she doesn't care if students understand it or not. Can't give useful answers to students' questions.
Hard course. Hard class. Hard exam and she is extremely strict to every one except herself.

Gultepe made more mistakes in her examples than I have ever seen a teacher make in my life. She can not make any positive connection with her students, her lectures are boring, perhaps a by-product of her terrible English. Avoid Gultepe  at all costs.
Terrible instructor.  Tons of homework.  Harsh Grader.  Absolutely no curve.  Tests are hard.  OMG... Hopefully I could get an B+.

I wish I took this class from some other instructor. Turned a perfectly enjoyable subject into a painful experience.  Prone to flattery, so you know guys! I am not sure why she exercises such hostility for 99% of her students3219. Awful in explaining, terrible English-not just the accent her grammar is poor too.

I beg to differ with the previous post. If Gultepe's accent is so thick that the majority of the students have trouble understanding her, then it poses a bigger problem. Whatever "Turkish accent" means foreign to me but we as students  should not be constantly taking notes and suffer in her hands,  because Gultepe has poor English.

I have to say something for Professor Gultepe. She is an incredibly nice professor if you have ever gone to her office and asked questions. She has Turkish accent so that students may have problem what she is saying during lectures. However, if you copy down everything she wrote during lecture you will get an A guaranteed.
She made more mistakes in her examples than I have ever seen a teacher make in my life. Hard to understand her English.  She puts us to sleep, boring lectures.

I agree with the majority of the posters here. The contents of her class is good, it is the way she teaches and her accent  makes it useless to attend her classes. She has a short-temper that is not appreciated by many and she shows no effort outside the classroom to help out the students. Her lectures are boring.

The other ratings do not do Dr. Gultepe justice. She is an absolutely amazing professor who actually cares about why you are taking the class as opposed to just giving you the information. If it is not your cup of tea to feel like your instructor cares at all about you, then take a class with someone else because she is truly invested in you.
She is probably the rudest teacher you will ever come across. She is horrible at teaching and grading, her English is bad. I highly recommend that no one takes her class.

Avoid this professor at all costs. I attended all her lectures and office hours, went to another professor's lecture AND the engineering hall's peer tutoring sessions. I was even able to tutor kids from other professors and help them achieve A's while I barely passed the class. Unless you have taken the class, her tests are impossible to pass.

Worst teacher I have ever had in my life. Not worth going to her class, since her English is very hard to understand. Unhelpful, always in a bad mood, unfriendly. She does not curve. Avoid her class if you can.

Thick accent, almost impossible to understand what she says. Poor teaching skills, can not relate to students, frequently mean, loud, yells in class, not helpful outside class. I agree, she should not be allowed to teach in the U.S. with such poor English and hostile demeanor.

She should not be allowed to teach, horrible teacher. Rude, yells a lot for no reason. Poor English, difficult to understand,does not care about the students, on a constant ego trip. AVOID her. Never clear about what she expects and turns around and blames the students. Lack of communication skills, oral and written. AVOID.

She's horrible. GET OUT NOW! She refuses to curve anything even when the average grade if failing, and then she blames it on all her students that it's their fault their grades are so bad. She never says what's going to be on a test. She gives practice problems that she says may not have to do with anything on the test. so unfriendly
nice professor

Her teaching methods are terrible. Some exam problems never appear on worksheets/homework. PatrickJMT on YouTube is your hero if you get stuck with her. But then again, math 231 is hard with most of the professors at uiuc.
Difficult to follow, exams are very difficult. Avoid. If you do somehow unfortunately get her, be prepared to rely on Youtube and the text very heavily.

Really bad at teaching.. As someone else noted, first few weeks was filled with a lot of attentive students, then slowly people stopped showing up. People either went to a different Math 231 lecturer's class or just gave up entirely. AVOID AT ALL COSTS. If you do get her, be prepared to rely completely on YouTube and the textbook.
HORRIBLE TEACHER! Very hard to understand and doesn't explain anything well.

she's not clear with what she is teaching. The lecture hall was full during the first few weeks. Slowly, nobody goes for class anymore. She spent so much time reviewing things that students already know instead of explaining new and harder topics. Don't choose her for this class!!!!

Prof. Fuller is amazing! This was a class on how to use R for statistical analysis, which I had never done. The class was difficult, and she talks really fast! But she's also incredibly kind and put in a ton of time during office hours to coach you until you understand. Amazing class and professor!

reviews.comment: I thought her portion of IB 302 was very well done. She covered about 5-6 lecture units per exam, and sure enough there were 5-6 questions on the exam--one from each unit. The questions themselves were basically just regurgitating exactly what she taught us in lecture. Gives RIDICULOUSLY long study guides for the exams though.

She speaks fast and if you didnt catch it you'd be lost. Im currently taking IB 202 and 302 with her teaching 1/2 of the material..and all I have to say is you have to attend lecture to get the notes..that is basically what is on the exam.
She's super nice and tried making evolution as interesting as possible.

She is a good teacher but the class is pretty tough.  A lot of fact/description memorizing.  The only requirement for getting a good grade in this class is "memorize and regurgitate" style learning.  Really fun class though.  Labs are spent catching fish!

I graduated and I still miss her quirkiness.  At first her onomatopoeia drove me nuts, but then I grew to love it.  Her notes are really helpful, I brushed up on my artistic biology skills.  She also makes you think her tests are gonna be very hard with her study guides, then you overstudy and they are easy.  But thats good!  You learned something.

You should definitely attend lecture because she writes all of the notes on the board, and she doesn't post them online. However, she's an awesome professor! She's quirky and funny and makes lecture interesting.

She has a different type of teaching method where she writes every note on the board. This may seem tedious, however it helps you to understand the information better. Overall, she is an extremely nice teacher who wants her students to succeed at her classes. Tests aren't that bad either. Negative- talks way too fast

This professor was incredibly nice, and super understanding when it came to issues in my personal life. The movies we watched for the class were super interesting, and I really enjoyed writing the paper I did for the class. There was not a lot of assignments other than readings which is expected for a history course.
He has two faces and couldn't be reasoned with.

Really understanding. 2y ago my class was taught so a movie would connect to the history theme. While yes movie days are fun, these were well thought out, fun, and relevant. I learned SO much in this class. TA's were also smart. He's a caring person & a smart teacher. You do have to read/pay attention though because he expects you to study and work

Professor Fu is one of the friendliest professors on campus. Seriously, I don't think I ever saw him not smiling. His class wasn't the easiest class I've ever taken but it's structured that if you show up everyday, you should ace it just fine (extra credit for perfect attendance). I could understand how some would find his class boring though.

Stop hating of professor Fu. He is a very generous professor. If you have perfect attendance he will give you 5 EX points. the whole class is based on watching 3 movies, writing (3 seperate) 1 page movie review and then taking a take home final (30% of final grade) and determining if China is developed or not. there are also 2 easy midterms

Prof Fu is a very nice and helpful, though his lecture could be hard to understand if you do not know about Chinese. He is generous in grades, but usually change assignments and forget things. Take this class if you are really interesting in China, and you will learn a lot from this class.

reviews.comment: Honestly, this is a super easy history class. We watched six movies for the whole semester. And for each movie, we only need to write for a one-page feedback of the movie. I will definitely take his classes again!

Dr. Fu is legit. He knows so much about the subject and makes the lectures very fun. When I took the class, he changed it up to include more movies and less lecturing, which was awesome. reviews.comment: lecture is not very good. But the professor is very nice.  No long papers, only film reviews. Easy to get A if read books.
He can be hard to understand sometimes but overall he's pretty easy. If you need help--he will help you.

Very nice professor and passionate about what he teaches. Attendance is mandatory and readings are fun. The class had so many interesting discussions throughout the semester. Highly recommend this professor as the best professor at U of I.

Professor Fu is a friendly gentleman. However, his class have too much long books to read. Attendance is mandatory. The films are boring as well. There is no exams but one long final research paper. This class somehow is not a easy A. You do well which still can hurt against your grades for non reasons after all.
great prof.a easy course!the only thing you need to do is keeping the notes and attending the discussion.I got A+at last

There's a lot of info to cover in class, so you definitely want to take notes. Discussion sections are helpful; you review material vaguely or briefly covered in class. He's not hard, but you have to pay attention. Read the book for background info. Exams consist of defining key terms and one essay question.
easy gen ed class but very boring. hes hard to understand but if you study the terms before midterms you will do fine
Four long books to read, but I did not and still got an A.  You have one presentation, no exams, and one final paper 8-10 pages.

Professor Fu gives interesting and stimulating lectures. A lot of people find it hard to get past his thick Chinese accent, which makes him somewhat difficult to understand, but he cares about his students and loves the material he teaches. I recommend him to anyone looking for a good history class.
He's boring and hard to understand.

This class was soooo boring.  I wanted to kill myself rather than going.  He spends more time on China than Japan (my area of focus) or Korea so I wasn't interested in most of the lectures.  He's also kinda hard to understand sometimes.
Booooring.  Way too much reading for a 100 level non-western.

I did not like this class at all. He was very knowledgable, but did not get his information across well. his scheduling was always off, it was hard to understand him with his accent. the tests were pretty easy, just a lot of information and writing, and graded very strictly
Challenging and interesting class, NO TESTS! Great teacher
easy class and a great guy
Excellent and nice professor
Excellent class, excellent professor
worst professor, most boring and meaningless course. Why such a guy who can not distinguish database from data structure is in the department of COMPUTER SCIENCE, as a professor?

In the very first lecture, he said CS465 is a B class, and only a few people can get A at last. So I tried really hard and got A+ at last!!! I must admit that he is a great researcher in his field and he is knowledgeable. But TBH, I don't like his lecturing. He didn't express things clear enough, at least that's what I feel.

He taught very well and all instructions were always clear. We always knew expectations and he was accommodating if we didn't understand something. He also seemed very caring and an easy person to talk too!

Prof. Alberti is the GOAT. He is very responsive to emails (so email him for advice for speeches), and gives good feedback.

For giving good speeches, please practice. I practiced for 3 hours for each speech, and I did well. If you put in the work, you will do well.  Alberti is clear on criteria for an A, so pay attention and enjoy the class.
The ideal CMN 101 teacher to have, gave great and relatable feedback. Was very flexible and easy to reach if help was needed.

Absolutely the CMN 101 teacher to take if possible. Usually cut class short unless there was lots of material. Made class entertaining with stories about his friends or family as well. Plenty of writing & he is not lenient at all with his grading. The books read in class are pretty interesting & attendance is not required but there are about 3 or 4 pop quizzes per semester so watch out!
So hot.

Very funny, personable professor who makes you feel engaged while in a large lecture hall. Very knowledgable and passionate about history! Passes out candy to students who participate. Gives you a study guide before the only 2 exams. A few in-class quizzes and a few easy online quizzes. No final test, but final paper must be 5 pages, 1.5 spaced.

This class was stupid easy and a good gen ed to take. Textbook is unnecessary so don't even bother. Learned a lot about history from him so I am satisfied. Take online quizzes with a friend and you will be fine. Final paper is 5 pages long, single spaced, and there are 2 (easy) essay exams. This is literally a "show up and pass" situation.
He is an amazing lecturer, very intelligent,  knowledgeable and entertaining.  He really cares about teaching you something new more than grade related issues.
Very easy. The answers to the tests are given to the study guide before the test. Occasional online quiz.
Pretty funny professor. Sometimes can be monotonous. Need the textbook for discussion, all the tests are essays and their is no memorization on any of the tests.
Great guy! He's funny; he Passes out candy to people who participate in class. The class is very interesting and I learned a lot. I would take any class of his.

I took this as a freshman. I noticed that he has political views and he does out them into his lectures, but because I mostly agreed with him I didnt really care. In the first month he talks about bias and how it is impossible to escape it as a historian. He is one if the reasons I chose to major in History, loved this class.

Extremely nice guy. Really seems to enjoy teaching. Wants to see students do well in his class. In-class and online quizzes are TF or MC and not too difficult if you've at least looked at the reading. One midterm which he gave potential questions beforehand to study. Final paper 5-6 pages, flexible on topic.

I had Behrooz for Modern Iranian History and you can definitely tell he's passionate about the subject (it's his home country, after all). He managed to weave history, sociology, politics, and culture into one beautifully taught class with movieslecturesbooks. He's very personable and I'd recommend taking a discussion based class with him. Superb
Boring
Tough grader on exams, but a funny guy and always willing to help students when they're struggling. If you go to class, he tells you the quiz and exam questions.
I did not think he was a good teacher.  There is something offputting about his style and his demeanor.  Overall, I felt that his class was a waste of time and money.

Looks like Borat. Interesting professor. He is a pretty funny guy and I did enjoy his lecture. There is no section so you may need to go to office hours if you need clarification. Overall, a good 100 level history course. I recommend it.

Completely useless class. Do not take it. Gharami is an terribll teacher who tries to sway you to his political views. Screwed us on our midterm and final. Should have been an easy class. NOT AT ALL..DO NOT TAKE
Loved, loved the class. Really down to earth, cool guy.

Hands out candy to students that are falling asleep or give good answers. Clearly loves history. Sometimes hard to understand or is not clear on what he is trying to say. Make you spell things correctly on exams! Overall a really good teacher.
Funny guy, and clearly knows his material.  Enjoyed having him as a professor.  I think he annoyed some students with his political statements, but I wasn't bothered.
He is very into himself.  Something about him seems ingenuine.  I didn't learn much in this class, and he didn't inspire me to want to go on in this field.
One of the best classes I have taken so far. The class is easy and Tabrizi is a cool guy. Very approachable and seems interested in helping you out. Overall a fun class.

I really don't appreciate a professor attempting to sway students to his political philosophy (especially in a 100 level class with many freshmen). Condescending. Disorganized at the expense of his students and their grades. Annoying.

You dont even need to go to class, just read the book. If you do go, you will notice that he just recites the text to you and misses parts of it that are on the test. Very liberal, and pushy about it. Funny though, and worth taking.
Very funny, tells you when taking notes from a powerpoint, what will be on the quiz.
Behrooz is amazing!He is so funny and charming, he even gives you candy!!! The class is easy! just show up and you will ACE

Show up, listen, get an A. Not much work required...at all. He's a very interesting lecturer, he's very enthusiastic about what he teaches, but he can ramble sometimes about the most useless stuff. Probably one of my favorite professors. Only problem was it's at 9am.
pretentious!

This class was fairly easy and somewhat entertaining.  If you read you will be fine for all quizzes/test. His lectures were kind of all over the place and at times he was hard to follow. The biggest detail I would remember for this class is that spelling counts.  If you spell something wrong...it's wrong...
he is pretty eccentric/sometimes awkward, but I liked it. I  thought it was funny. very nice guy, and he knows what he's talking about.
Pretty easy class, needs to learn how to speak non-chalantly though.
This class  started off difficult but eventually got easier. You learn a lot about world history. The study guides don't help much, you just have to keep up on the reading in the book.
No Comments
He's very nice, but in the context of a large lecture class that covers a HUGE span of time, I found him to be an average teacher - that might've been the class, though
He's very nice, but in the context of a large lecture class that covers a HUGE span of time, I found him to be an average teacher - that might've been the class, though
I don't know how someone can make a class that meets at 8 in the morning fun to go to, but he somehow managed it.  He's so nice, funny, and very intelligent.
Interesting class.  Nice teacher, very friendly and helpful.  Lectures sometimes aren't spectacularly exciting, but still fun.  Final exam is a research project.
No Comments
Dr. G doesn't seem very connected with the material, or with the students.  He talks about a lot of things in class, but I can't figure out what the meaning is.

Good teacher. Alot of reading but it really helps for the quizes. Very perky even at 8am. Mildly awkward but in a fun way. If you read you'll do well. Power points are not always clear but if you know how to take notes and have read the material you will catch on and do well on the tests
He's awesome. Funny and lively even for an 8 o clock.
I don't think that I learned much in this class.  The professor liked to talk to hear himself speak.
He wasn't very clear in his lectures.  He often seemed to be 'acting,' and I didn't feel that he was sincere about his concern for students.  He seemed nervous around students.
Good professor. He is a funny guy. Tests were easy if you study. No final exam, just final paper. Ultra-conservatives might not enjoy the class because Ghamari is awesome and tells it how it is.

He tried to push his liberal political views on the class, but overall the class wasn't too hard.  Do the homework, and just put what he wants to hear on the essays, and you'll do fine.  I missed a few lectures and it didn't harm me too much, and don't get the reader for the class because it is entirely pointless.
He's really enthusiastic and probably the nicest prof. i have this semester.  However, his study guides for quizzes don't help at all.  Make sure you do all the reading!

Genuinely this was the worst and least organized MCB class I have taken so far. Dr. Gillete seems very kind and willing to answer any questions or concerns, however the reality is that this class is poorly designed.

I liked Dr. Gillette's lectures and she seemed like a nice person. However, the class felt extremely disorganized and the quizzes that were given had absolutely nothing to do with lecture content which was frustrating. Fortunately there is a ton of extra credit, and the class curved at the end.

The course itself seems very interesting and Dr. Gillete is a very nice person. However, this class is insanely difficult due to bad lectures and terrible grading system. There is no set grading and half of our grades aren't even uploaded, which leaves you guessing what your grade is all semester. Pick a different class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: No clear grading criteria. Lecture slides are full of images and barely text or explanations. Usually you have to teach yourself when you get a bad teacher, but you can't even do that much! NO CLUE what youre supposed to know. Took intg. neuro with Rhanor and Martha Gillette and it's like no other in the sense that you cant learn even if you wanted
Good professor. Shes a little goofy but she did what she needed to do and I would take her classes again.
She is a phenomenal person and such an insightful professor. Shes so much fun and her classes are easy if you show up and do what you're supposed to!

Professor Giorgio is a great teacher but she also deeply cares about her students. She truly wants to see everyone do well and learn. You learn a lot but if you ever need help she is always happy to give you what you might need to succeed and learn.
cares about her students

One of my favorite professors ever. Took her American Family section and really enjoyed most of the shows/ movies. Weekly quizzes on Wednesday but they're very easy as long as you watch the shows and go to lectures. Also offers a lot of extra credit and overall cares about her students.
so so so nice. so so so easy. I did not even watch the movies and got an A because I paid attention in lecture.
Great class with great professor. Very easy assignments and really don't have to go to class that much to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: dr giorgio for cmn375 the american family and/or the past and future is such a great professor and keeps the class fun! your homework is watching TV and movies with a short article for the week. There are only weekly quizzes that are easy and 2 exams that are open note. Def. an easy class but it is fun and interesting and would recommend!

This is for CMN 375. Dr. G is the only prof that I liked so much that I took her course twice (you can take 375 twice because content switches). Easy quizzes once a week, open note. Lectures and content are super engaging and your homework is literally watching movies and TV shows. If you're a nerd, you'll love her. TA is great too!

for 375! dr giorgio is great, she is caring and makes the class easy! Tests & weekly quizzes are only assignments and are open note. She prefers handwritten notes but talks very fast during lectures but the lectures are posted after class. Attendance is not mandatory but they do participation and weekly quizzes so its def. recommended to go!

(For CMN375 but there was no option for it) Great teacher overall. Only complaint is that she has a tendency to get political during some of the lectures. She basically told us who to vote for during the next election and it gave me bad vibes. The one quiz per week is easy and the midterm was not bad at all.
I love Professor Giorgio. I am taking 432 right now and she is so kind and considerate and so knowledgable about Gender Comm. Expect a lot of reading. The tests are fairly easy and open note.

She's a lovely professor, very much understanding. Just follow all directions on assignments, and you'll be good to go. Don't wait till last minute for help on assignments, because she's willing to help. The class is very manageable and not hard as long as you stay on top of it.
Dr. Giorgio was super sweet! I came to love her class. Def take her if you can. Yes, you'll have to write a few papers but the assignments were all super interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Absolutely inspiring woman and professor. She cares deeply about social justice and giving her students educational experiences that allow them to think about their own life in ways unfamiliar to them before. Assignments are meaningful. Readings are interesting. Class is overall amazing.
She was Amazing! Loved her personality, Almost Always upbeat. Willing to work with you. Very understanding, and Pretty 'lax
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Giorgio is by far one of the best professors I have had and not to mention she makes the class very enjoyable. She is really understanding of student's needs, this class is SOOOOO EASY! Just follow the examples she provides and you are guaranteed above a 95. She seems intimidating at first but is not. Super helpful, a little quirky, easy grader
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She is a very intelligent and kind woman. Truly cares about her students and their well being including mental health. Giorgio is always willing to meet after class to help you and actually goes out of her way to make sure students are receiving the help they need. She is by far the best professor I've had at UIUC.

Grace is the best professor i've had as a transfer student! ridiculously easy class she assigns readings but shes so lenient shes doesn't expect you to remember and kind of lets you off. Late on an assignment? she so understanding and will allow a late turn in and she so hot, her mannerism is what makes that tiny lady so interesting and appealing.
I LOVE HEERRR! Easy as long as you do what you have to do. She is very helpful. Best teacher I've had so far!
she's great

Dr. Giorgio is great. Lots of group work in her class, but most of it is enjoyable. This is not a blow off class, but it is not as difficult as others because she is very engaging and the course material is interesting as well. Overall, I highly recommend her classes.
You will love her. She is awesome.

I'm taking her now and I would not recommend her. She treats everyone in the class like high school students and brings her personal political bias too much into the class. Easy grader, but with so few comments on papers you feel like she doesn't care.

Material tedious at times, lots of hammering on topics, but very interesting stuff. Prime for involved class discussions, and some very thought-provoking readings outside of the textbook. Movies galore, too.  FANTASTICALLY COOL final project.

Good Class! The tests require you to actually learn the material (instead of just memorizing) but if you have been keeping up with the readings and going to class you will be fine.  Grace is great and the material is really interesting. Plus, I loved the project for the final.
I'd do her
great class ....shes really cool
No Comments
I like her!  Very nice, approachable, and willing to work with you.  Easy grader.  Fun content, at least in 220.  She can be a bit vague though.
Grace is a total easy teacher just do all your work and you can easily get an A

He talks himself in circles and not all of it is quality. He basically refuses to clarify himself and evades questions on test / paper material. He doesn't give good feedback. He's obviously very passionate but never clear.
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Wood is one of my favorite professors that I have had. This class (History of Geology), though writing heavy as it's an advanced comp. credit class, is very manageable because of how he spreads out the papers/writings. Though not a geology prof., his interest in the topic makes this class easy to follow along with and enjoyable to take.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Wood is amazing! You can tell how much he cares for what he does and his students. He managed to get me excited about materials that I did not think I would enjoy as much as I did. As well, he gave detailed feedback on each assignment I had. I truly loved having class with Professor Wood, and will take another of his classes if I can!

Amazing, high-energy lecturer - your attention will never slip in class. Great at leading discussions and keeping conversations flowing. Allows a lot of freedom when writing papers and is super helpful when you have a question. Theres a lot of reading (its an English class) but its not overwhelming. I definitely recommend his class! :)
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof Wood is awesome! The class I had him for was super low key (doesn't even have a curriculum yet), and he was chill too. He's super lenient on things and is really interesting to listen to, since even if you don't care about the subject his passion for it will draw you in. Super nice guy and nice teacher, would definitely recommend.

Start off by saying i am extremely passionate about the environment and i took a pseudo environmental course with him. He was a great professor and is understanding and caring if you display you are actually putting the work in. That being said, the "work" was really not that much. The class is challenging, but by no means hard.

Course was entitled "Green Romanticism"; considered the effects of contemporary climate events on British Romanticism and its trends. Homework was a rare occurrence. Papers were well explained. The midterm was fairly graded. Participation is huge. Overall, it was a pretty interesting class and the professor was great.
Great Professor (funny)! Really tries to get you engaged in the material

While he was very enthusiastic about the subject matter, he is very unclear in teaching. Class consisted of reviewing the hw and having him attempt to get us to see his perspective with little direction. He is unclear on expectations and is easily frustrated when his mysterious expectations aren't met. Not a hard class but he is a poor professor.

Extremely knowledgeable and intelligent guy. His anecdotes on his experiences were amazing. I do however, think this course is too new to excel in. I found myself thinking the material was sometimes pulling at straws... which in turn made it extremely difficult to write papers with an accurate analysis on the subject matter.

Prof Wood is an enthusiastic, bright professor and a great guy, but 210 is not his best class. He assigned us to read Barchester Towers (800 pp) in a SURVEY class. For that book I read Sparknotes and went to the lecture and I did fantastic. Go to lecture and bring your text--it'll help you know what passages will be on exams.

Took the Jane Austen class with Prof Wood. Class was excellent, full of energy and exciting. He keeps the class engaged. Grading was fair. Must keep up with the readings. 2 papers. Take a class with Wood if you can!

gillen wood loves art. he loves talking about art. consequently his words have no value or meaning. if you want to listen to a professor who is interested in your perspective, then you'd better be some kind of art venerating hippie because this guy just wants to be into anything his feelings tell him to be.

Lectures started strong but deteriorated throughout the semester.  Semester fatigue or laziness?  Both the final and midterm were difficult for a required English big lecture course.  Exams did not really fit the lectures.  Good prof, but I think many of the other comments are inflated.

Everyone says Wood is the best professor, but I was disappointed. I wasn't captivated,enthused, or suddenly hit with a realization as to why I am an English major. Nonetheless, his class is alright. Don't dread it, but don't get pumped, either.

Everyone says Wood is the best professor ever, but I was disappointed. I wasn't captivated, enthused, or suddenly hit with a huge realization as to why I am an English major. Nonetheless, his class is alright. Don't dread it, but don't get pumped.
Captivating.

Wonderful professor. You can tell that he genuinely loves what he teaches, and that enthusiasm is infectious. Insightful commentary on the various pieces of literature interspersed with humor and wit. I'd definitely love to take another class with him.
The Best teacher I've ever had!!!! He made realize why I am an English major.  His lectures as well as his teaching style are interesting, amazing, and captivating
A great teacher.  His lectures were so interesting that he keeps your attention 95% of the time... and I took it in the summer.  Definitely a great great teacher, rare in these days.
Brilliant. Lectures are engaging and peppered with witty banter and giggle-inducing observations. Definitely try to get this guy.

Absolutely Brilliant. His knowledge of Romantic poets will have you reading Wordsworth and Keats outside of class. His lectures are entertaining, eloquent, and engaging. The fun Australian accent is also a plus. Brilliant man - read "The Shock of the Real" if you can find it at the library.
Awesome professor. Very nice, animated and funny in lecture, and gives interesting, clear interpretations of the readings. Wish I could have him again!

Prof. Wood is the best professor I've had--he is incredibly adorable, sweet, brilliant, and funny. He's been the only professor so far that has made me comfortable enough to speak in class regularly. Romantic poetry is already so lovely, but when he reads it, it's simply amazing. I am heartbroken he's not teaching next semester!
"cool British accent"?? He's an Aussie, as in, from AUSTRALIA.....

I have him for the class on Jane Austen and he is amazing. He acts out scenes from the book and really gets the class involved. You can tell he is really passionate about literature and his enthusiam makes the 50min fly by. He makes Austen seem absolutly brilliant and his british accent makes you believe him

Great teacher, really tries (and usually succeeds) in trying to make students understand the material.  Papers are very difficult, and they are your entire grade.  Overall, the classi s interesting, but it gets boring to discuss poetry 3 days a week.
He's a very animated lecturer. I was never bored by him. I don't want to personally say if he is difficult or not, because my TA sucked. His tests were not overly difficult.

What a great professor!  Lecture is actually fun to go to; he keeps you interested in the material by using music and art. The exams really tested the ability to interpret not memorize.  There were weekly response papers and 1 term paper without strict guidelines, which allowed for creativity.  This was definitely one of my favorite classes here.
He has a cool british accent and he really explains his point of veiw as he analzyes literature. He provides unique intepretations and really wants people to challenge them if they disagree.

I love his lectures! He is so animated and into it, you really can't be bored by him. I also like how he incorporated music and art into what we learning. It made it easier to understand the concepts of time periods we were discussing.
Very interesting lectures!
he's so passionate about poetry!  Also, you could listen to his voice for days...he makes everything sound so beautiful.  Definetly an inspirational professor.
he's an awesome teacher and makes the class interesting.  you can't help but pay attention and enjoy yourself while you're in his class.

There's no question about it, Professor Wood is awesome.  He has a wonderful ability to read literature aloud (especially poetry), and he takes that little extra leap to make his class actually entertaining.  This is the second class of his that I've had, and I would highly recommend him to anyone.
most interdisciplinary course i've taken so far.  he showed us how the music and paintings of the time were following the same path as the literature.  very interesting lectures.

His lectures are funny! I actually went to almost all of them. He's a trained Shakespearean actor so he actors out a lot of scene and poems. He really is fun. He definitely does have an obsession with John Keats though so be prepared to love Keats as well

He has a lot of expectations, but isn't very clear on instructions. Weekly readings/videos, a 8 page final paper, weekly quizzes, in-person short answer midterm. It's just so much for a course worth 3 credits, but it isn't very hard to pass so long as you show up. He's very harsh on what he wants in the course, and don't even think about using AI.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Very fun class. Content is varied and covers everything from K-pop to samurai film and yaoi manga. THe professor is fun and easy-going and the workload is light. There are easy review quizzes every week, a short paper and a final project. Highly recommend.

The course itself is very interesting but the professor could be more engaging. If you're specifically interested in Asian pop cultures like k-drama, anime or idols then that's a free final project topic for you. The course isn't very demanding and there are no exams but the discussion sessions are drier than popeye's biscuits.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Persiani's lectures are nothing special. He is pretty strict about attendance since he uses iClickers. Grading is done all by teaching assistants so you almost never interact with him. Class for the most part is easy but the professor could be a bit better.

Persiani is the strictest professor I've had at UIUC. Minor deviations from grading criteria, like discussing multiple points instead of one, can cost you half the assignment's points. Assignment details often come through TAs, with Canvas rubrics missing key criteria. This makes essays easy to fail. Avoid his classes anyway!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Persiani is the strictest professor I've had at UIUC. Minor deviations from grading criteria, like discussing multiple points instead of one, can cost you half the assignment's points.  Assignment details often come through TAs, with Canvas rubrics missing key criteria. This makes essays easy to fail. Avoid his classes anyway!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The most important part of Persiani's classes is to make sure you participate in class discussions and therefore be prepared for them by completing the readings. The actual assignments are not difficult and are actually fun sometimes, but also require that you have read the material so you actually know what you are doing.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures were boring, but the content of the course was interesting. Easy to get an A so I highly recommend taking the class for gen eds. I didn't really email him or have any one-on-one conversations with him because the TAs were the ones grading our assignments.

This class was relatively easy and the content was very interesting. As a lecturer, though, he's not very engaging and can get boring sometimes. Other than that, the assignments are doable and the discussions are easy points!

The class was interesting, but we touch on a lot of things like racism, sexism, identity, & sexuality, and I think the prof wasn't sensitive & professional enough while discussing these topics. He also didn't provide a trigger warning for one of the films we had to watch in class (it was a samurai movie) where a woman got raped on screen.

The class itself was extremely disorganized and he was very adamant on doing iclicker questions as pop quizzes on the readings and wasn't very helpful either. Students would email him questions and he wouldn't answer which was very frustrating. The course content was interesting but he made it boring and his lectures were not engaging at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Darren is a very nice guy and an excellent teacher, his notes online for each unit are extensive and top notch, reading them is the key to doing well in the class.
