By far, the worst teacher I have ever had. In class, all she does is prove the theorems in he book. I learned absolutely nothing. There were on average 20 kids in the class per day. No one liked her. I actually taught myself Calc 3 by reading the book. She was completely useless.

She is a very nice lady, but it is very hard to understand her sometimes. Her lectures are all over the place. Luckily my TA was pretty good. I kinda had to teach myself the material from the textbook. The tests were ok, the final was hard, but there is a curve.
Difficult to understand at times. I realized too late in the semester that it's better to just skip lecture and have the t.a. explain it all during discussion...
Do yourself a favor and get the other professor...trust me!
I had her in a big lecture before and I didnt find all lectures too clear. However in a small class setting this lady was awesome. She was EXTREMELY helpful. Go to office hours :)
Not easy to follow in class. Luckily I had a good TA. But the material was easy enough to learn from the book.

she seems like a nice lady, but doesn't make any sense. it's like she's copying theorms from the book and you don't really understand how to do book problems. you have to read the chapters and figure out what's going on yourself- which is not fun.

Denka...She's a funny lady, but I could never follow her work. Luckily, I had taken Calc in high school. Most of the stuff she lectured about had to be re-taught by the T.A. I guess her class wasn't too bad. The weekly quizzes and the 4 exams were pretty straight-forward.
She is very funny if you listen carefully.  I enjoyed her rambling.  Made the class more interesting.  I would take another class with her.

She did ramble on about some things, overall her class wasn't too difficult if you kept up. We had weekly quizes trhat were pretty easy. Her lectures did tend to get a little boring, but overall I liked her and owuld take another class with her at the professor.

Rather easy professor, exams never had anything extremely difficult. Not a good lecturer though, rambles on about things that are unimportant, and says “you will learn more about this in (insert class)” too often.  Accent isn’t too bad.
Rambles

I took this course Mathematica. Denka didn't know how to use the software. So she opted to lecture once a week. I learned better when she did opposed to on the computer. She's funny and tests were super easy.
No Comments
No Comments
The most amazing professor I have ever had!!
Best teacher ever. Makes even the difficult concepts, crystal clear. Wonderful sense of humor.

He's the best professor ever.... One cannot ask for a better professor. I'll never forget how great a teacher he was my entire 4 years of college. Thank you Viraj, and have a great time at Holy Cross!
He is the BEST professor I have ever met! He even helped me for my MP during Saturday. So much fun in CS232. We are TEAM KUMAR.
Best lecturer I've had at UIUC. I'd probably take any class he taught even if the material didn't interest me.

He is one of the best teacher I have ever met, when I went to ask about the honor project today since three other students were there and I have no time to ask, he provided extra office hour tomorrow, which is Saturday~!!I was so gratitude for his kind and made my decision to try hard although I do not like CS.
Prof. Kumar is underpaid for his teaching efforts and ability.  'Nuff said.
Very good teacher. He highlights the important aspects of what you should know and what you should get out of the class, which is helpful for tests.

Best professor at the university!  He attends every discussion section, just in case the TA sucks.  He learns EVERY student's name, and will make sure you understand everything perfectly, in the most friendly way possible.  He's pretty much always available to help, and grades generously.  He's fair, helpful and friendly, just an overall great guy!

I took CS 232 with Viraj last semester (SP '10), and it was fantastic.  Viraj made computer architecture very exciting, and he spent countless hours outside of class helping students.  Now, I'm in CS373 with a different prof, and Viraj holds office hours for our CS373 class before our exams! He has has office hrs for a class he's not teaching!
I would SO do Viraj.  Simply out of respect. Also, He's an awesome professor. So yea, take his courses.

I sent him an email at 2:30am and got back a reply by 3:00am. He usually stays in the lab for 3-4 hours helping students. His classes are really helpful and he remembers everyone's names. Take a class with him if you can. Best CS teacher on campus according to me.

What can I say, he is like the most helpful and best teacher in CS at this university. There are a lot of great professors, but none work so hard to help you learn. The 373 concepts are terribly difficult, I am so thankful he was my teacher.
He is the person  that once you miss his class, you will feel gilty cuz his lectures are so so so helpful.. and he is willing to answer all the questions and to help solve all the problems...

AWESOME teacher.  If you can, take a class with him.  He is always willing to take time out to make an appointment with him.  He's also REALLY good at learning names even in a huge lecture.  He keeps the bland topics really interesting.

Kumar is a pretty good Prof. He lectures very well and he takes the time to help students and answer their questions with their MPs. He's always available if you need him. Also he takes the time to learn the name of students. He's really smart and a great guy too. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!

There's not much I can say here that hasn't been said here already. Viraj is one of the best professors I've had at U of I, and what's even rarer is that everyone in class agrees on that. He cares about every student, is funny, and is an outstanding lecturer. He attends every discussion sections, and will let you know the exact bug in your MP!
He made this class awesome... Take his classes if you get the chance
Good instructor. Very helpful in all aspects. Favorite CS professor so far.
Amazing guy! Tries to learn all the students name and establishes a professor-student relationship that I haven't seen at all. He makes everything about the class easy, and fun to learn.

Very good lecturer. Does his best to be interesting and interactive with the class. Discrete math was a tricky subject in general, but he is always willing to help you out in his office hours. He tried to memorize everyones name / face which was kinda creepy at first but hes a nice guy

Undoubtedly one of the best professors at the university. Absolutely excellent at explaining concepts. Extremely helpful, nice, and he really does care about students. He also seems incredibly normal for a computer scientist, and he has a good sense of humor. You really couldn't ask for more from a professor.
he is awesome..
He is a great professor.  He tried his best to make the lectures no so boring.  But I still fall asleep sometimes.

Without a doubt the best professor I have ever had. Knows everything and is willing to help. If I could take another course with him I would do it instantly. Loves to teach, and somehow made assembly code sound interesting?! Viraj rules!

Professor Kumar was one of the greatest professors I have ever had. He knows the material like it's the back of his hand and he is always willing to help his students out. If he is available, absolutely take a course with him.

Kumar is a very good professor for, in my opinion, a very dry subject. He was always very prepared and effective in presenting material during lecture and was also very helpful to students outside of class, especially when it came to the MPs. With Kumar, this class was not bad at all!
Best professor I've had at UIUC hands down. Cares a lot about his students and teaching. Would take another class with him if I could.
Nice guy, explains concepts well. However he puts me to sleep every day.

Great. One of the best professor that I have had so far at UIUC. His office hours are extremely helpful. Also fun teacher even the material that he is covering is pretty heavy.. Knows all names of student.

Agree, best professor I've had so far. Unlike most professors, he actually cares and takes interest in his students, knows almost everybody's name, and explains things very clearly. Very easy to talk to.
Viraj is awesome. He will help with any class, even if he isn't teaching it this semester. Very helpful, makes class fun, knows your name, and fair.
Viraj is absolutely the best lecturer I've had at UIUC. He is animated during lectures, explains concepts very well, goes at a good pace, and is very helpful both in and out of lecture.
Very humor but very mean too. You are not his student but his employees...

He's the most tough professor in Accounting Dept. All his students were treated like his employee, which you can definitely feel when you're sitting in the course. No idea why other comments don't say anything about his bad writing, and speak too fast in this course. If you want get a good score from his class, prepare to study really hard.

Prof Kustanovich definitely has a "unique sense of humor." I find this highly entertaining. Sure, the class is challenging and Kustanovich makes you work hard for an A. His famous words are "always study accounting" after all. But, his adept level of knowledge is unmatched, he cares about your learning & growth. Know the Goodwill equation btw!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Kustanovich is one of those teachers that really knows what he is doing in regards to his role as an educator. He understands how to pass down knowledge and all though his tactics might seem scary or demanding at first, you will be more than happy at the end of the semester with the content you learned. His tests are very fair.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Some people in these reviews are saying he just has a complicated sense of humor, but honestly, hes just mean. Do yourself a favor and do whatever you can in your power to not take class with this guy. He will cold call and grill you for not knowing the answer.
He knows everything about accoutning and teaches in a really interesting style. He loves to answer accoutning questions and cares a lot about whether you truly understand accounting.

You will like Michael once you get used to his unique "mean style". (Knowledgeable but mean. Approachable but mean. Funny but mean) You may miss him and his "study accounting" emails when you're done with this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: Nice teacher, very knowledgeable. This is the accounting class that I learnt the most from. I can tell the exam will be very difficult even though I hadn't taken one yet. He writes a lot in the class with a terrible handwriting, but you will get used to it. Every class is so loaded and no slides, so it will be hard to catch up if you skip class
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: One of the best professors in COB in my opinion. He actually cares about the students and whether or not they learn from his class. He could come off as cold and tough at first, but he is actually pretty funny in class if you can joke around with him. For his tests, just study the notes and you'll be fine. Everything on the tests are from the notes
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Michael is the kind of professor that you will miss after taking the course. He cares whether students are learning, and is very clear what he is talking about. Participate as much as you can and you would find he is not intimidating at all. Take good notes, review and easy A.  Wish every professor at COB could be as clear as he is.

Awesome professor. At first I was pretty worried the class would be impossible, and he seemed very intimidating. But I really enjoyed having him and took away a lot from the class. He does a great job of making sure students understand the accounting behind a JE and the effects of it. He is also really funny if you understand his jokes.

Great professor. He seems very intimidating at first, but you will later be happy that he is this way - you can actually pay attention during class with it quiet and without discractions,  His class is extremely organized and well ran. Test/final are difficult but if you really study the material they are easy - no surprises on them.

Very structured and straightforward class, but hard to understand/memorize all 150+ pages of material from the notes.  Really wish he would have given more examples because the test questions had several differences from the examples and it made it very hard to study.  Harsh towards certain students and comes off as extremely cold and rigid.

Michael is very smart, and will explain topics in multiple ways if you do not understand something. His classes consist mostly of note-taking, which at first was cumbersome, but proved to be a great way to really understand his lectures. He was one of the best teachers I've had on campus.

By far the most knowledgeable accounting professor I have ever come across in the COB. He makes sure every student in the class is up-to-date with material and is extremely helpful when it comes to asking questions. The midterm and final are ridiculously challenging (average  D),but like every other Accy class you end up with a B+.

I would not take this class again. He was rarely clear on assignments and never made us aware of activities that were due and proceeded to get upset when we did not do them. His directions were confusing and is rarely accommodating to people's needs. Be ready to read and make sure to get the textbook. It helped a lot when you could not understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very slow in responding to student questions in the Q&A forum we were instructed to use. If his professor responded, it was usually after the deadline for the assignment or project. Due dates listed in weekly overview did not match the closing dates and times for weekly quizzes. Very little direction for confusing instructions on assignments.

Very nice guy and very very good lecture slides and notes able to be taken. Understanding but won't baby students. He is caring and very intelligent and helped me learn every country in the world with ease. Textbook needed for weekly responses PDF or hard copy are fine.

I had an extremely hard time understanding him. I got better throughout the semester but for the first few classes I was completely lost because I didn't know what he was saying. He does a good job explaining his slides in lecture. He posted all of the slides after class, but going to lecture helps. I spent a lot of time studying for this class.

I would retake this class in an instant. I took it hoping to deepen my understanding of world geography, which I did (can now place every country on the map), but learned all about global politics and hegemony as well. It was an incredible course. Kwame is dynamic, knowledgeable, accessible, and a strong presenter. Best class I've taken.

Professor pretty much just read off slides and talked quickly. Made very little effort to make the class interactive or captivating. When our TA didn't give us feedback on a project until the day  before it was due, Dr. Kwast did nothing.

This is a hard class with the level of detail that you need to know. Kwast was good at explaining in detail but he talks really fast and the pace of the class goes fast. I recommend getting the online book from a friend - it's well written and helps clear things up that you may have missed in lecture.
Kwast gives you practice exams that are extremely similar to the real thing. He is clear about what you need to know. Lectures are a bit long, but he tries to keep interest.
Professor Kwast expected the most out of his students compared to the other professors for the class, but I also learned the most from him.
good explainer, teaches barefoot (hah!), interesting lectures, funny guy
Dr. Kwakye is awesome! I loved her class and wish every professor was like her! I learned a lot in her class and had fun. She  is very helpful and cool. This was one of the best classes I took!!!!!
AFRO 103 was an easy class and extremely informational. Also, there was no final!

This class is super interesting and Chamara is very nice and helpful. The articles are online and you barely read them so don't spend the $60 on the course packet. She made this class one of my favorites. Grade is made up of one paper(super easy) and a couple of online quizzes. Interesting class and easy A.

Chamara is the TA to take if you're taking EPS 202. She is unbelievably helpful when it comes to tests... Trust me... She also speaks to students as adults and os not afraid to swear in class; it really lightens the mood of an otherwise boring class. She is on her students' side when it comes to just about everything. Great TA.

Professor Kim always goes way off and explains the physics and chemistry behind these simple topics. This only adds confusion to the course when it is only supposed to be an introductory-level course. At the last lecture, Professor Kim even said how the content of the class is "too simple for him that he doesn't know what to talk about."

genuinely upsets me that my tuition is paying this man's salary. he treats the class like a joke and reads off slides while simultaneously adding nothing except confusion. in his head i bet he is a great teacher but in reality he is a waste of time. please retire.

He is a very helpful professor, his analogies make understanding the concepts qualitatively easy. Always wants the best for students and says that he will give you a better grade as long as you improve through the class.
Material is interesting but extremely difficult. Class average for final exam is 60%. There is a curve on the final grade.

He makes complicated device physics simpler by creating analogies that are funny, which makes it easier to remember. The tests are extremely hard and the test scores are very low across all professors. Also, CompE majors like myself ended to do worse than EE majors, and unlike other ECE courses.

He has taught this class for over a decade and is still passionate to get students interested in semiconductors. Very neat chalkboard writing. This class is tedious, but so long as you take initiative to understand the concepts, you're far above average. It's easy to overlook the work required and end up frustrated by midterms and hate the class.
He is quite arrogant and never allows students to point out where he gets wrong.
hehe he is a very helpful professor. I think he is one of the nicest I have encountered on campus.
He is funny but not a good lecturer. He got confused by himself sometimes.

Professor Williams is one of the best professors I have ever had. He gives easy homework and fairly easy papers. He holds conferences for the papers, allowing questions about the paper, which is extremely helpful. Make sure to participate and this class is an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Mr Williams is awesome. i had him for Rhet 105 and compared to my idiot english teacher sr yr of h.s., Williams is great. he is really understanding and is open about his love towards zombie movies!

Young, likable and approachable. He always seems enthusiastic about the material. The discussion-based nature of the class allows for a more critical understanding of texts and the way the relate to broad themes. I thought medieval english would be painful but he made it enjoyable for the most part. Pay attention to what he says AND what he writes.

Avoid Williams. He reads off notes during class and rambles quite aimlessly. The lecture content is not insightful at all, and he often spells things wrong or conjures up words that do not exist. Yes, he is funny sometimes, but the class is very boring since none of the stuff he talks about is engaging. Stay away if you don't want to waste money

Williams is the man! Hes a great guy and a great teacher. He gives you plenty of leeway on what you can write about and he is an easy grader. He loves to talk, so sometimes lecture got kind of dull. Zombie themed class is fun, watch great movies for points and discuss them. Don't plan on just skipping class all the time, your allowed 6 absenses.

I should have gotten a B in this class but he ended up giving me an A-. That is how  much of a cool TA he is. Does not demand much just show up, do the easy papers and you are guaranteed at least an A-.
Very easy class. He is an easy grader.
Kyle was awesome. 105 is a joke of a class anyway but he made it enjoyable. He is obsessed with zombies but he actually made it extremely interesting-recommend highly.

I liked having Mr. Russell for RHET 105. He seemed like he knew the material well, and always gave good feedback during major assignments. He would never keep you in lecture unless you were doing something, so we were let out of lecture early frequently. Nice guy, great to talk with after class. Highly recommend!

RHET 105: Professor Russell is a very understanding teacher and does not make you do unnecessary work or stay any longer for lectures than is needed. The work for the class is what you would expect from the course. Four major papers make up the majority of your grade.
He is a good guy but the course he teaches is very hard and demanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Professor Kwiat is an amazing lecture and just around an awesome person with good fashion. He explains physics concepts very intuitively and is always willing to help people understand. The demos for his class were interesting and are very interesting application of things we learnt in class. Just around a good professor and would heavily recommend

For a class that has difficult content, I think that Kwiat did a great job of keeping everyone engaged in the class. He did cool demos and sang songs about physics. Such a sweet guy who just loves physics, and you can tell.

He is so fun and easy-going. Amazing fun useful lectures, except he's too easy-going to be controlling the chattering and banging the tables when the course's about to end. That's very annoying and since Paul does not speak at a high volume you can't hear him at the end of every lecture.

He was a good lecturer, explained things pretty well, and seemed like he really liked the content he was teaching. There is a lot of assignments to do, but it's the usual amount for the physics classes here. The tests were more difficult that the ones in 211, but if the whole class does bad enough he'll curve it so the average is around 75.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Kwiat is a great lecturer and really wants you to understand the material, but the class is so hard. do not take phys212 at uiuc
professor kwiat gives really good lectures and does cool demos. this was a very difficult course for me, so his explanations during lectures helped a lot

He's a really good professor, and he can be goofy sometimes which is fun. He's also really knowledgeable about physics topics far beyond the scope of the course, so he can answer pretty much anything you throw at him.

Pretty hard class but the lectures were great, almost all of the class is designed rigorously for you to follow it's due dates so staying on top of all the prelecture content and homework questions is important if you want to do well in quizzes and exams.

Kwiat is an amazing professor who clearly cares very deeply and is enthusiastic about his subj. Offers special extra lectures on relativity stuff as well. Gives great demos too. Workload on heavy side but is worth it. 
Marked attendance mandatory b/c you need IClicker. Don't buy IClicker from school directly. Get secondhand from past students.

Dr. Kwiat is the best lecturer EVER!! I have ADHD and have a horrible time paying attention during lectures but I can actually focus when he's teaching and I even get excited about coming to lecture. He's also such a genuine and nice person, if you come up to him after class and ask questions you can tell he really cares.
Awesome professor, hard class but he was awesome :)
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Physics 212 is taught extremely well here. It can be very difficult to grasp concepts at times, but it is structured very well and Kwiat gave great lectures. It can be a lot of time at times to get all of the work done (prelectures, hw, labs, etc...) but it is def doable.
Not too hard of a class. He's knowledgable and the demos he shows in class are quite fun. He's a little goofy and sometimes will explain something wrong before catching himself, but overall is solid.

Dr. Kwiat is overall a great professor. While the class itself is quite challenging, he tries to explain the concepts in an understandable way. I value his expertise in physics and would take another class with him.
This man's hot
I love this guy

Class was definitely tough, and lectures aren't great. That isn't his fault - just the physics dept sucks at teaching these intro physics classes in general. But he is super passionate and had some very funny moments, besides that the demos were cool as well

Very knowledgeable about Physics and is able to apply what we learn in class to a whole variety of real life situations.  His lectures are also very packed with students.  Just beware of him cold-calling on random people especially if wearing eccentric clothing.
All around great guy

Phys 212 was a super hard class, but professor Kwiat was an excellent lecturer that made me care deeply about the class and get an A. He has very cool demos and seems to care about how well students do in the class.

Professor Kwiat is my favorite professor. He is funny and caring and makes lectures engaging. Participation in lectures gets you candy. He also has an arm when he throws the candy 50 feet at students. He is the GOAT.

Professor Kwiat is a very solid choice for PHYS214. He is not only well-versed in the material through his research, but also manages to simplify it down enough to someone learning quantum for the first time. Highly recommend!

Professor Kwiat is a very nice person and he answers your questions after class and explains them very well. However, he is good at explaining things well in class, partly possibly due to the poor structure and fast pace of the class. His lecture notes are pretty useful.
His exams are some of the most insane exams I've ever taken. I was getting around a 50% average on all the practice finals... ended up getting a 28% on the actual final (only curved to a 38).
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: so hard. don't take it if u can.

Professor Kwiat is pretty good at explaining things and does cool demos. Exams in the class can be rough, and they move at a really fast pace being half a semester. Overall pretty decent, sometimes can be a little confusing though.
He explains course material clearly and thus makes the tough course relatively easier.

This is a very fast paced course, and between lectures, labs, and homework, it can be difficult to keep up. Reviewing the lecture notes after class and seeing what you might have missed out in lecture will definitely go a long way to helping someone get a good grade in the class.

Do the homework and prelectures and everything else and you'll have a pretty good buffer for the midterm and final. STUDY YOUR ASS OFF FOR THE EXAMS THEY COUNT FOR A LOT. Kwiat is a awesome though, he gives candy for participation.

He's an amazing lecturer and really cares about teaching Phys 213 and 214. While some lectures are a little dry, its mainly because of the content, not because of him. He does a lot of demos which are really nice.
Amazing professor. Quite possibly the best one I've had at UIUC. He really knows his stuff AND is incredible at teaching. 1010 would take another class with him
stylish bowtie and suspenders

He was a very nice man but I did not think he was very good at teaching. He's brilliant but lecture was so confusing and he went so quickly. Questions were not answered as thoroughly during lecture but his office hours were good. An incredibly hard class but he tried to make it understandable, it just was not as helpful.
Easy to understand and good at explaining things. Lectures contained lots of experimental work that I didn't care about, making the class a bit less rigorous than I expected.

Just your average professor. Goes over the material incredibly fast. Students think he's an exceptional professor, but I'm forced to think otherwise. He's very talented, though. He answers questions well and awards candy if you answer a question correctly during class.

Great demonstrations in class but the problems are difficult to get started. He's a fun lecturer but the material can by difficult to grasp. This class will be especially hard for those that tested out of E&M.
Fun demonstrations in class but the material is tough. Exams aren't much easier than the homework.
Demonstrations in class are fun and the lectures can be very entertaining even if you don't know anything about quantum physics. The class is also really hard. Each problem is a challenge.
This is one of the tougher classes on campus. Each problem feel unique, making the material difficult to learn.
Very easy class, Easily got an A+.
kwiat is overrated. People only like him b.Ecause he wears a bow tie a.Nd suspenders but he. Isn't a very good professor. S

He's a great guy and I sort of fell in love with him. He obviously knows the material and is quite enthusiastic about it. But sadly, he doesn't teach very well. Although I found his teaching to be average, I would still recommend him. Quantum is sort of mind boggling sometimes. The Yale OCW videos on Quantum Physics saved my grade in the course.
Wonderful prof. he knows his material well, and he is extremely helpful.
What an awesome guy! Lectures have a lot of cool demos and are worth going to.

Kwiat is totally kooky but it makes an otherwise boring class (in my opinion) somewhat enjoyable. He lectures pretty fast but somehow the fact that he always wears suspenders and a bow tie makes me absorb the material better. I would highly recommend him.
He is such a foxxxxx!

He is perhaps the best physics professor on this campus. He both knows the material AND knows how to teach. This is super rare in the physics department. If you have to do physics here and he is one of the professors for your class, take his section.

Excellent lecturer. He's very nerdy and enthusiastic about physics. Can be spotted swing dancing and ice skating outside of class. Homework and labs aren't bad. I had issues with the exams but it wasn't a deal breaker.
Kwiat is the MAN! He is amazing. and that's that.

Everyone likes Kwiat, except for me. This guy is too smart for what he is teaching. He goes way too fast, he flashes his little science experiments, which btw don't do a thing for helping you do well on the difficult exams, and in general goes over your head. Not only that, but he is arrogant when people ask him questions. Get someone more normal.

I had Kwiat for 213 and 214. Although he is a good professor and very enthusiastic some of the material was over my head. I know a lot of people got As on the exams but I averaged about a C-. Homework and labs definitly bump up you grade however.
He's very enthusiastic about teaching. Exams are fair and lectures are interesting. He also holds review sessions for the midterms and final.
Good professor. Attend lectures as the notes need an explanation to make sense. Very smart and a funny guy.
I hated the class because I had no interest in it but Professor Kwiat was very good.  He was very clear in lecture, always replied to emails, and was helpful too.  His lectures were fun to go to too.

Although he's extremely enthusiastic, I feel his teaching abilities are a little overexaggerated. OK professor, however 212 exams were extremely difficult and hardly resembled the practice exams (even in difficulty).  Cool demos in class, but may talk a little quick and write messily on the board.
awesome

He is a good speaker/lecturer, and obviously loves teaching, but (particularly in 213) sometimes seemed to not really know what he was talking about, and often didn't go over the basic points enough, making the advanced stuff harder.  He taught 214 better than 213, in general.

He loves what he does and transfers that enthusiasm to his students, even in a large lecture setting.  Plenty of useful demonstrations in class.  Most of the material covered in the lecture is read straight off of the course notes, so if you miss a lecture, it is easy to catch up.
Kwiat rocked my socks off. Very entertaining and effective. Inspired me to attend some lectures.

Great professor, makes class interesting, one of those professors that wear a red bow tie to class. A very memorable professor. He went to MIT and he's young too, so he's current with all the physics stuff. A little inncentric.
Physics 112 is a really really hard class, but Professor Kwiat is a good teacher in a tough subject. Study a lot. Plus you gotta love his bow-ties. The swing dancing professor!
Although the ratings seem low, it is because the class is hard, not the professor.  Kwiat is a great person, but does seem to be a bit condescending at times.
Good lecturer and cool demos, so go to class!
Great lecturer and very friendly professor. Made physics lecture worth going to.
Very good explanations of pretty complicated problems.  Very helpful in class and has plenty of out of class problem sessions to help prepare for exams and such.
Kind of reminds me of Bill Nye. Decent explanations on hard material, quite friendly, and shows crazy video clips while we take a break.
nice bow tie!
No Comments

He is very quirky and likes for you to participate. Students have to do 4 papers which arent too bad because he lets you do rough draft first and comments on it. Gives opportunities for corrections. Its important to read or else you cant participate
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Gundling is a solid RHET 105 teacher. We have 4 papers through the semester, and he allows us to edit each others papers before turning it in to him. He first gives us a grade for the rough draft, and after we edit, he increases that grade. As long as you participate in class and put effort into your essays, you will get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Kyle's assignment organization is unclear. Expect to work on one paper all throughout the semester, continuing to revise and edit. Extremely rare and quirky. No phones allowed his reasons will not persuade you.
This man is THE BEST LECTURER AND PROFESSOR IN THE WORLD! I LIKE HIM SO MUCH!

You may think the reviews for Kyritsis are too good to be true. They're not. He's a fantastic professor for whom I can give nothing but the highest praise. His lectures are clear and interesting to even the most disinterested of students and his booming voice will keep you alert even at 8am. Seriously, don't miss a chance to take his class.
Best professor I've had yet. Did not think i'd like thermo, but he made it interesting and was really good at explaining

I was dreading Thermodynamics before taking his class. It was my favorite class this semester. He explains clearly, is endlessly patient, has a great sense of humor, learns everyone's names, and he's super Greek. One of the most effective professor's I've seen. Definitely worth the 8:00 AMs.

I just left his last lecture. I find (well, found) thermodynamics very tedious and boring in previous classes. But it was impossible not to love his class. Lectures were profound and he memorized nearly all of 200 names just cuz he likes us. He's super greek and a lot of fun to learn from. Definitely take his section even at 8am!
Very good prof.. His exams in ME410 were pretty easy...open book exams....Lots of HWs..he is extremely helpful

This is one of the best professors I've ever met. He always explains everything very clearly and can answer any questions effectively. You end up doing more work than other sections, but in the end you will definitely know the material. Attendance not mandatory, but there is a quiz once about every two weeks.
Best professor I've had at U of I. Very helpful and caring for all of his students. You need to put in the work to get a good grade, but the class is set up to help you succeed.

Highly recommended. I went out of my way to take a second class with him. He made a difficult and math-heavy subject understandable. Office hours were very helpful and sometimes necessary to complete homework. Only bad thing is he talks REALLY loud. Ultimately a small price to pay for one of the best engineering profs on campus.
Best prof ever!

I would go out of my way to take another class with Kyritsis. Lectures are interesting and engaging, and office hours are amazingly helpful. I learned more in this class that I had any other class at college

one of the best professor teaching ME at u of i. exams are hard, but there is a curve and if you study, you can certainly get 100 from his exams. his lectures are very helpful and humorous from time to time

Kyritsis is every bit as amazing as he was for Thermo.  The subject matter however was far more difficult this time around.  Office hours were needed very much.  However, Kyritsis made everything clear, and his policy of open-note was good for understanding rather than memorization.  TAKE HIS CLASS IF POSSIBLE.
The best professor ever, anywhere. Everything about the way he teaches is perfect. I wish I could always have him as a professor

Absolutely the best professor at the University. Completely fair with homeworks and tests. A class that had close to 150 students, I wouldn't be surprised if 90% of the class didn't miss a single lecture.

Absolutely the best professor I've had.  Exams are very fair and the Homework actually teaches you what you need to know.  His lectures are crystal clear and his notes are near-perfect.  Going to his office hours makes a world of difference and will all but guarantee you an A in the class.
Good dude
best prof i have had...everything people say in these reviews is true

By FAR the best professor that I have ever had at this university.  If there were  a ranking level in teaching, he would be top tier.  His exams are extremely fair, and he helps whenever you ask.  Go to his office hours, as they are extremely helpful.  DO WHATEVER YOU CAN TO HAVE THIS MAN AS A PROF!

Dimitri cares for all of his students. His course is extremely fair and he will do everything in his power to help you to understand his material. GO TO OFFICE HOURS!!! Dimitri is simply a fantastic professor. DO ALL IN YOUR POWER TO TAKE HIS COURSE!!
Fantastic
the best professor I've ever had  at UIUC.
I wuv this class!!!  he's like a giant frog that rocks at teaching thermodynamics
Great, great lecture, great office hours, hw is worth your time

Great professor, awesome greek accent makes him extremely fun. Get's entire class involved. GO TO OFFICE HOURS! He does homework problems and it is extremely helpful. Will remember your name and use it.

He is the best professor I've ever had.  Clear, interesting lectures delivered with passion about the subject.  He will spend hours at his office hours to make sure everyone understands.  Far and away the best ME professor.
No Comments
Best ****ing professor ever. Seriously, the best. He kicks more ass than Chuck Norris and Bill Brasky put together. I'm not even ****ing joking.
Writes challenging but fair tests. Very good lecturer.
No Comments

basically the clearest and most straightforward professor there is.  he goes over the material step by step and you always feel like you are in the game.  perhaps the best professor at the university!

This was def one of my most difficult courses but it is crucial. In every single social work class after this, I have utilized the coursework, concepts and notes taken for this course. The required textbooks are referenced continuously as you move on in the program. This course is fundamental to understanding your role as a future social worker.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is very insightful and truly cares about her students.

Very condescending, discouraging, and often made racist and elitist remarks that went unchecked. She overloaded us with 500+ readings, gave contradictory directions, and created a hostile, unsafe learning environment. Completely unfit to teach future social workers. Hazing dressed up as “rigor”. Get ready to do phd level reading/assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Tara made me not want to be a social work major. If I had not taken this course at the same time that I was in other Social Work classes I would have transferred out of the college. She is incredibly rude, unclear, and should not be working with students.

She loves to talk about how she wants her students to not feel stressed but she does the opposite. She locks our grades all semester so we don't stress over them but not seeing my grades made it hard to figure out where I needed to improve in the class. She also grades in a confusing way and I could never seem to figure out what she expected.

3 long papers, the first two are 6-8 pages each, and the last one is 8-12 pages long. Extremely picky grader. Is overall disorganized and you do not know your final grade until the end of the course. You are uncertain where you stand. Also, she is very heavy on participation.

Dr. Tel was sort of a difficult person to communicate with. During class, she would encourage students to speak with her for any additional support. However, when I would ask a question, it became "a personal problem." Overall, it was a decent course but lacked good communication.

Dr. Tel is a decent professor, but she's not very organized and can often be all over the place during class which makes it difficult to succeed. She also has a tendency to play favorites so if you participate a lot in the discussions then you're more likely to do well because she likes those kind of students.
She takes the time to try to get to know her students and genuinely cares and is passionate about what she is teaching.
She is amazing. If you are looking to get into social work she is the perfect intro.
Great professor. Love her and she definitely is always there for students. Big end of the year project but other than that easy class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Tara really cares about her students understanding the material over simply memorizing it. Most classes were discussion based and I felt like I heard a lot of interesting stories from fellow students. Not too difficult, but not a blow off either.
She is the best professor I had and she gets the class to be interactive rather than sitting all the time. She lectures in a way that is active but yet informative.
Good lecturer; Cares a lot about class understanding
mean to students and makes regular inappropriate comments to woman students in the class

Dr. Labella is nice and cares about his students but he's not a good professor. His verbal communication is extremely unclear and he does not keep up with grading (I received feedback on my essay outline and draft a week after the final assignment was due) He also told the class specific people's essay grades and that I had accommodations.

He was quite mean and would pick on students and criticize them in front of the class. He also gave me an A on the first essay, and then changed that grade to a B a few days later. Due dates and guidelines were unclear and constantly changing. We were also very far behind. During the last week of the semester, I had two essays to turn in.

reviews.comment:
won't give below a C, but hard to get an A
very disorganized and made the class a lot harder than it should've been
ran out of time to grade our final projects
called me out in front of the class. Joked about how, out of all of my tablemates who skipped class, I needed the most help with my writing...he did this twice 
My final grade was good tho

awful. not good at elaborating on his critiques of your papers, it is like he thinks the students in this level 100 class are level 400 students who should already know everything. very unorganized and constantly switches his due dates; Canvas deadlines do not match what he says at all. made this class way more difficult than it needed to be.
Replied disrespectfully when I asked questions about grading and policy.

so unorganized. never tells you when homework is due, because we were weeks behind other they classes so the canvas didn't match up. he sucks. just doesn't answer questions, difficult to understand, terrible feedback. tells us to not be redundant but all of his comments are. DONT TAKE THIS CLASS
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Mr. Labella's  class taught me the wonders of Filipino literature. He asked us to read a good amount of novels and shorter works but the reading load was reasonable. He's a smart and illuminating teacher. He's also a nice person and very helpful in office hours.

He is pretentious and demands respect in the worst ways. Made me uncomfortable in class although he is a nice guy and willing to help, I wish I hadn't ever signed up for his class. Take this class but with a different professor.
I learned more about poetry in this class than in all the English classes I've ever taken.
He was very confusing in class, very unorganized and mean.
Reading poetry is not easy but Mr. Labella is a very good teacher. His exercises show you how to study meter and metaphors.

Took his modern poetry class and I found his selections to be pretty boring. As a teacher, he is pretentious and intentionally obtuse which I found frustrating. A very nice guy though and more than willing to help students out.

Will genuinely take 15 minutes to go through an example problem only for a student to point out an error she made and she has to correct it. Sometimes she even makes errors on the solutions she posts. Lecture feels soooo long because she talks so slow. Honestly feels like its her first day teaching, TA's were more helpful and smarter than she was.

I really like Ms. P. I think she's a great lecturer who genuinely tries to care for a class of 300+ students. Math isn't my forte, so I found this class to be a bit challenging, but she will always answer a question within minutes of asking it! She's sweet and at times can get me to chuckle! Make sure you put in your best effort from the beginning!

I found this class to be quite easy, but I have taken this class before I really liked her lectures and how she explained things. Additionally, I thought her exams were very easy and the study guides were very helpful. I would recommend her!
She is a very strict grader, and lectures don't always correlate to the tests.

Tbh I did stop attending most of the lectures like halfway through the semester simply because it was at 8am and I was not about that, but I liked her lectures. I thought how she explained things made plenty of sense to me. Lecture attendance not mandatory but discussion is. I don't love an mcq for a final, bc I hate scantrons but it is what it is.

I don't really understand most reviews about Ms. P. I think she's a great teacher if you are willing to put in the work (study, take time on your homework, and go to lectures). The course was easy in my opinion and the tests were easy as well. Only warning would be check your homework over because they are strict graders for that.
I enjoyed having her as a teacher. Despite having 8 am lecture her attuife always kept me awake and conveyed the material well.

I really enjoyed her as a professor and lecturer! Her lectures were very thorough and she explained concepts very well. The homework and exam grading is kind of strict so just make sure to show all of your work for full credit.

personally, i really liked her lectures for math 115. they were easy to follow and I was able to focus well in class. sometimes class feels like it goes on and on but that's with most lectures at any school. she makes an effort to be accessible outside of class- does not have office hours but has student support hours with math 115 TAs.
Lectures were clear

The first few lectures were useful, but around halfway through the first semester, she consistently made mistakes throughout her teaching, to the point where multiple students realized we would be better off self-teaching. Her grading is the worst of it, feedback was filler and not applicable towards many steps. Also multiple-choice finals in MATH.

Very straightforward lectures, however lecture example problems are easier compared to the homework. Homework has to be done in very specific ways, so tough grading on that. Exams very similar to in class reviews. Attendance is not mandatory for lectures but is for discussion. Discussion worksheets are also more complicated than lecture examples.

The moment I stepped in class, Professor Placzek had such good energy and was always accessible after class and in campus wire for all sorts of questions. While she can be a bit picky for the homework, the workload is very manageable, the exams are similar to the review so make sure you do them and the office hours TA's are lifesaving.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I have been out of touch with any math courses since my junior year of high school. I needed to take a math course that would help me get back on track with my peers in college, and this course did exactly that. Her teaching style contains medium-paced lectures and exams that are exactly like the homework, lecture notes, and discussion worksheets.

I love her. I didn't think the class was hard, and she answers questions during lecture and online. As long as you do the homework and go to lectures, you'll be fine. The exams weren't really difficult.

Doesn't take attendance but doesn't post lecture slides or record lectures so you kinda have to show up. Very specific on what she wants to see on homework like certain steps to get to an answer. If you don't do it how she wants it then you'll get points taken off. The homework is different from what she teaches in lecture.

Terrible teacher. She can't be bothered to help or support students unless she really has to. Seems like she's great at math but really bad at teaching. She is also not kind or compassionate either. I would not take a class with her again.

Her Calc 2 exams were very fair, as long as you worked on the practice exams, you would see the effort you put in through your grades. Lectures were easy to follow, and she was very open to answering any questions regarding the material during lecture. Sometimes her lectures roll over to the next lecture, but that doesn't detract her lectures.
Overall a good professor, however didn't teach things related to the test and talked too slow to where you zone out and wake up in the next lecture.
Super kind and really cares about her students, posts the notes from lecture online and takes questions after class. Gives test outlines that are super helpful.
She is seriously one of the best professors I've had so far. She is very approachable and will answer any question you might have. I love her!!
Goes into lots of depth on the topics and wants the students to do well, warned us when the test would be harder and we might do worse. Awesome person.
I LOVE MS P

My high school calculus experience was horrible. Placzek was incredible at explaining everything to the point where I never left a lecture feeling confused. She is very approachable and comes to office hours to help students. She is 0 nonsense when it comes to grading, even if you have a valid excuse. Overall though, I wish I had her for all calc.

I would not recommended her for anything. In every homework problem she wants everything to be correct. In the tests, she wants you to show the correct work for your answer even if your answer is right she will take points away if the work is wrong.
She cooked me man.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Her lectures are pretty good but only consist of easy problems. Online hw every week and written hw every other week. The written hw is graded so unfairly. Points are taken off if you don't show every step! Attend the discussions because it's easy points.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She teaches well however she grades way too strictly, and she oversimplifies her lecture which then makes you confused about the homework she assigns every week because when she is done explaining the simple things, she forgets to explain the harder material. One homework assignment will take you over 3.5 hours, so schedule your homework.

Background information: I took AP calc in my junior year, received a 2, and didn't touch math for my entire senior year. I knew my level, so refreshing for my freshman year in college is really important. She is so great. She is not the kind of professor who assumes everyone in the class is a genius and skips a lot of steps, she is patient.
her lectures are pretty good. Make sure to read the textbook

Really fun class. Go to discussions! Each discussion is 0.5% of your grade. Don't forget to do the homework, has multiple attempts. The midterms and finals are just like the questions in the lecture. The final is worth 25%, but as long as you know how to solve the examples in the lecture notes you'll be fine.

Had her fall21 and literally never saw her. Notes were recording of another teacher just reading off slides (no additional explanations or writing made). Not very good at explaining things. Homework was fine (cengage). Tests were not the worst, but not that good either. Overall not that great a teacher and really was not involved in the class.

I didn't really pay attention much in class because her lectures were a little boring and the weekly homework was really hard. Overall though the class was super easy and if you study the review worksheet really well you are guaranteed an A+ on the exam. Super easy exam and she responds quickly to questions.

If you're planning on taking Math 220 or 221, I'd look for a different professor for the sake of your grades. The lectures are too fast, especially if you have never taken a calculus class in the past, and this class takes up WAY TOO MUCH outside of class time just to study for exams that are way harder than what was practiced during discussion.
too much hw but funny i guess

I expected this class to ruin me, but was pleasantly surprised. 5% extra credit is offered for all HW (15%) if turned in 2 days early. You need to do well on midterms (48%) and the final (25%), but if you review discussion worksheets and attend the review sessions it's doable. I found her to be a good lecturer who would engage with students well.

I found this class to have a workload that was very reasonable. Homework could easily be completed over 48 hours before the due date in order to obtain 5% extra credit. The exams also had much easier problems than the homework. As long as the concepts are understood, the exams were very reasonable.

The material is not easy, as there are lots of things to memorize. HOWEVER, if you go to the lectures, use the lecture notes, and READ the book thoroughly, everything makes sense! You just have to devote your time. Every math class becomes easier when you fully understand the concepts. Placzek was great.

Ms Placzek knows calc for sure. But structure of the class is terrible. Disorganized. Commonly has lecture notes unfinished.  Exams are curveballs and strict (Avg 12 Q test.). You get 2 wrong , B-. No outside help that is worthwhile. No study guide or tangible prep for exams. Appeared to focus on weeding engineering hopefuls than optimal learning.

Always runs late in finishing lectures but still tests on the material she didn't finish teaching. not accommodating. Her responses are unhelpful and dismissive. The class is very unorganized. No class packet so students must print her thrown together, typo-filled lecture notes three times a week. She makes calc more difficult than it already is.

Tests are generally unfair and solemnly match up to lecture examples. She is very cryptic in communicating with students which can lead to useless studying to no avail. Even if you feel confident in solving hard problems, exams always throw curveballs. When asked countless times for a practice test she gives a half-ass excuse for not having one.

Calc has been a bit of a bumpy ride, but Ms. Placzek has made it bearable. I expected this degree of difficulty more or less coming into the semester, so that may explain why I'm not sweating buckets (awfuly close though). Lectures are highly compressed. Overall, fairly standard Calc course.

Ms. Placzek is obviously knowledgeable about calculus, but is not able to teach it. There was never a lecture that she finished and we were still tested on examples that she didn't do. Exams are way harder than examples/ worksheets. I learned everything outside of class or in discussion. Taking calc 1 with her made me question continuing math here

She sucks, her lectures are horrible and the exams are extremely difficult. I used YouTube to learn criteria half of the time, and the discussions weren't much help either. You think you know a topic and then the exam comes and it's insanely hard.

By far my least favorite math instructor. Majority of the time, she never finishes lectures and the problems on the exams are much more difficult than the ones shown in lecture/discussion. The only reason why I was able to maintain a B in this class was because of the work I put in outside of class.

She is an awful professor and never finishes a full lecture. There are always several examples left blank on notes because she doesn't know how to pace herself teaching which sucks when you try to go back and complete homework. She is also rude and not accommodating even when you have a medical excuse. Do not recommend.

Math 221 was awful. It was almost like the course content was being created as we went. Our exams were each 8 percent of our grade and every 2 weeks and they were all or nothing. Even if you prepared for hours for the exam, you could still get an F. Students assembled and expressed an exam drop policy and there was 0 compromise. DO NOT TAKE!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The examlets were short to the point that if you missed one question overall you were screwed. They were also all based off of short covid-era videos recorded by another professor. Not much availability either, as we were told to go find a tutor if help was needed. Overall, the experience was shockingly bad even after having took H.S. calc prior.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very inflexible and non-present. She was professor of my section, yet I never even saw her once. I was taught by my TA and lecture videos were made by a different professor. She doesn't care about extenuating circumstances unless the university makes her care. Exams are much much harder than homework. Awful introduction into university math.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Lectures were fairly easy and she explained things well

Under the tag options I saw the word "caring" and laughed a little. I was behind a lot due to being sick and in the ER. The first time I asked for extensions she granted them, but only because of my DRES letter, and on the second, when I was worried about failing the class, she recommended I talk to my advisor about my options and did nothing else.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She is the perfect math teacher. All of her lectures are clear and concise. Put in the work and you'll

reviews.comment: Took MATH234 with Placzek. Homework was painful and long. You know what is expected of you. Exams were manageable, but beware- REVIEW. YOUR. WORK. The final exam shot me in the foot. Office hours were available just about daily.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The exams throughout the semester were pretty straightforward and like the practice exams. The final exam at the end of the semester is BRUTAL. 3 hours for 40 questions is not enough time. DO NOT make small mistakes because there is NO leeway. During online classes and online exams, a professor should be amenable & reasonable. Placzek is neither!!!

This class is supposedly the "easier" calc, but I struggled. Partly due to my own lack of participation, and partly because she made it more difficult than it needed to me. Fast pace. Uses Pearson MyLab for homework/quizzes/exams which is not the best system. Homework was excruciating and took way too much time for how little it was worth.
Absolutely terrible. A genuinely awful human being. Fails on technicalities and accused the whole class of cheating for asking questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Not an awful professor, but is not lenient it all. I had covid and she wouldn't let me reschedule a quiz ://

As an online class, the lecture videos were informative but the examples provided were much easier than the ones on the homework or exam. Office and tutoring hours are available almost every day of the week so there's no need to be confused on anything. The exams are fairly easy and similar to homework or practice worksheets.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr Leggett is not an engaging lecturer and seems to not care about teaching. Her grading is also very harsh, but if you cram her slides getting a good grade is very much possible.

When I went to this class, I had to recover the next day from the monotonous, slow lecturing. The study guides did help with the exams, and sometimes the homework did reflect exam material. The grading was very slow and very unhelpful. This class made me hate biology.

Lectures were boring, almost was like she herself was learning the content for the first time. TA was a lot better. Grading was extremely late (HW1 out way after exam1), had mistakes and took off points on hw for excluding stuff that was not at all referenced by prompt. Exams were fair, but were not given access to our MCQ performance on midterms.

The class was not run very well and assignments would often take weeks to be graded. The prof often has her back turned to the class and doesn't speak well over a large crowd. The content is pretty interesting and not too difficult, but the way it's taught isn't very effective. I learned more from the TA's than I did from her.

hw was occasionally nothing like lectures, things were explained poorly. only one TA actually does stuff, pretty much runs the class herself. prof and other TA are never available. grading was inconsistent and sometimes nonsensical (depends on the TA). lectures were very unengaging and the prof seems very unsure of herself.

Professor Lee is the kindest professor I have met at Calvin so far. She is also more willing to listen to new ideas than most professors I've had. She deeply cares for her students and wants to build relationships.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: BEST PROF EVER!! Sabrina is soooo lovely and very good at explaining. Her classes are very interesting and she clearly cares about the topics/is very knowledgeable. I would 100000% recommend taking this class with her.

Sabrina is a caring, respectful, and enthusiastic instructor. The material can be challenging but she genuinely wants her students to succeed. She makes herself very accessible so take advantage of her office hours!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Sabrina was a great person and I liked her, but I'm not very great at English.  I thought the class was really tough.  Lots of writing, and she's a tough grader.  Doesn't like to give A's.  However, she's easy to catch outside of class, so make sure you have her proofread your stuff.  Also, she grades based on participation in class.

She is the sweetest ever and extremely chill. The class is heavy on the essay grades, but you have a lot of time and she is a good grader. If you have to take RHET 105, I would 100% take it with her. She is very lenient with deadlines.
She is a very nice professor with a lot of patience. There are far less work than some other professors.

Very nice professor. Lots of time given in class to complete assignments. Easy class if you have an average ability to write. Easy grader and gives great feedback and room to edit and redo assignements.

The course requires quite a few papers to be written; however, the professor is very lenient on deadlines (you can ask for extensions and it will be granted) and is a pretty fair to easy grader. She is super kind and understanding and will give you lots of great feedback to improve essays. If you miss a few classes, nothing bad will happen.
Ms. Lindsey is a wonderful professor. She gives  students clear feedback on their academic writing skills and makes recommendations to strengthen future papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Mary Lindsey was just a phenomenal professor. I am so glad that I took her class. I feel as though I have grown as a writer and a researcher. If you have the opportunity to have Mary as your professor, take it!

Mary was a good professor. She was a pretty easy grader and gave you pretty good feedback. You can skip class sometimes but I would recommend going. The content she gives is pretty boring. All RHET 105 teachers do different material. Overall I did enjoy her.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: She is a very nice professor, and compared to what I have heard about other RHET 105 classes the work load was pretty light. She also gives great feedback on projects and is pretty good with extensions so I definitely recommend choosing a class with her. As long as you submit everything you should pass.

Prof Lindsey is an amazing person. If you don't like writing, the class is going to be a bit dry since you have to write a good amount of papers, but she gives great feedback and is willing to work with you if you need help. You don't need to buy any textbooks for the course. Definitely take RHET105 with her if you're looking to get the easy A

this class is so hard for me to take, ever!!! there are plenty of papers to write that I do these works days and nights but still get a b in that round. Although the professor is so nice, but it is too hard !!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Class was mostly discussion based. There were a couple of essays, a semester long project instead of a final, one exam, and one performance of a play with a group. Overall, she loves what she teaches and the class isn't that hard!

Patient, nice, approachable, and helpful! Mary was an awesome prof and was always willing to help her students. She is willing to flex due dates and makes class interesting. She's laid back and creates a positive environment. No exams, all essays and group projects.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: What a patient, helpful, and nice teacher! Lots of small assignments only grade for completion and only big essays require some effort. Super easy A I would say. Also, you have extra credit opportunities. Highly recommended to take this class.

The assignments in this course were all graded generously and Mary gave good feedbacks to your writing. She was also very helpful with other things like finding resources. Overall, this class was pretty easy as long as you put some efforts into your papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Best rhet teacher out there!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Took this class as a requirement for freshmen, and while there was a lot of writing involved, (which will be true for any RHET 105 class you take no matter the professor), Mary was the sweetest professor. She grades super easy. She'll do so much to help you get a good grade too. It's an easy A as long as you keep up with the work.

I took her class, because of the rest of the positive posts and for a four credit class, she made it worth it. I got an A+, but you do have to show effort and be passionate about your assignments and she does give extensions if you need them and helpful in e-mails. Goes out of her way to help us.
She's very sweet, great literature professor, and an easy grader

Mary Lindsey is a great instructor. She's helpful and nice, and isn't a crazy tough grader. I had her for Shakespeare and while it was a ton of reading, as long as you read the Sparknotes and keep up, you'll do great! There was minimal homework and most of the classes were just discussions. I would definitely take another class with her!
mary is super nice and very easy going. her class isn't hard and as long as you don't miss too many you'll be fine. She's very helpful and lenient on every thing. Very easy Advanced Comp

She's great. Interesting, doesn't grade difficulty, gives you very fair assignments. Enjoyable class, and enjoyable grade. You'll learn and you'll get a good grade, independently. A great teacher and knows her Shakespeare.

great lady. she is extremely helpful and genuinely cares about her students. the class is not super easy, but if you work hard and communicate with her you will do well. all you do is write. don't need to buy the online text book even tho she says you do. take the class, great teacher!
She is such a nice and helpful professor! Take her class and you will not regret it lol

Very helpful, approachable, and kind. Was nervous about the class material but she was very clear on what she expected and led extremely helpful discussions. If you pay attention in class, you will do well. You must go to class though. Overall am really glad I had her as my teacher for this class!
A good, intelligent and helpful instructor.

She was always willing to help, and had reasonable expectations! She was always willing to work with the students. Attendance is pretty mandatory. You can probably miss 1-3 classes total! She is a fair grader, and she taught the "media" class, which was easy to write papers for!
EASY

Definitely a great class. She will gladly take the time out to help any student in need, and wants her students to do well. Simple yet interesting writing assignments. Lenient, yet concise on what she expects. Great class, had a lot of fun.
She is a very nice teacher. Class material is not tough at all. Just read a bucnh of plays and write responses to them. Overall, teacher is really helpful and nice and class isn't difficult at all.

THIS REVIEW IS MEANT FOR HIS 206 CLASS: EARLY MODERN PHIL (it's not yet been put on this site). An intense amount of material is covered here for a 200 level. Also, it's a requirement that you sacrifice time on two weekends for group presentations.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures are very interesting but a little hard to follow. However, grading is very fair and rewards deep (not broad) understanding, which means you don't necessarily have to understand all the lectures to get an A. You can learn a lot if you want to, or you can also get a good score with relatively low effort.
highly recommend

Fantastic professor, very knowledgeable and good at explaining the topics at hand. There was definitely a lot of reading, but you honestly don't need to do all of it to understand what's going on. Wasn't that many assignments, the largest one was a group project. 

Even though attendance wasn't mandatory, going to his class was 100% worth it.

John is brilliant. I've never seen a professor quite as excited to answer a students question and connect it to the course content. I mean this: if Livengood is teaching a course it's worth taking just to experience him as a professor. There's nothing quite like it.

Prof. Livengood is really great at explaining the topic and sets clear expectations about the course. He always asks for questions and you can tell he really does want people to understand and think critically. PHIL103 might be a little harder if you're more a humanities person, but he knows this and explains really thoroughly. Really great prof.
Super passionate and always does his best to keep lectures interesting. Probably one of the best professors I've had.
He cares about his students so much and is so passionate about the material he teaches. Such a pleasant human. Loved learning from him.
By far one of the best professors I've had. Made the class incredibly enjoyable. He is insanely smart, a delight to talk to, and loves nothing more than to talk and teach philosophy. 10/10 recommend.

You cannot possibly learn enough from Professor Livengood. He is willing and excited to talk just about anything and he makes it enjoyable to do so. He poses interesting questions and really makes you engaged in a way which very few can. He has almost single-handedly changed how I think and is the most influential figure in my college career.

The course itself is not hard at all structure-wise; there isn't much writing to do and the tests are the regular difficulty. Prof Livengood can explain the material very well and would pause the class for five min to answer questions. From him, you can see a teacher who genuinely cares about his class. 10/10

If you're looking for a class to take because the professor is amazing, this is the one!! He explains very well and creates a passion for philosophy in his students. Highly recommend! Requires some effort, but it is worth it.

If you intend on taking and learning a 'tougher' level of philosophy such as PHIL 426, I strongly recommend Professor Livengood; he is a very supportive and passionate professor that makes himself largely available in order to ensure the student is learning well. I was very fond on how he gives students a large amount of autonomy in writing papers.
Good instructor. Pretty easy course but not so boring. Best Gened for engineering student.

Professor Livengood is one of the best professors I have ever had at UIUC. His passion for helping students is immense and he will literally spend hours with you if you need the help. For me personally the class was not simple but Livengood made it understandable by walking me through it.

Excellent, excellent teacher. Intelligent, calm, helpful. Highly recommended. He challenges you and is crystal clear and organized. His textbook was overdue (exam came mostly from lecture slides... which were also overdue); he is still a one-of-a-kind, true TEACHER. So rare. Absolute 5.0. Class was thought-provoking.

Great professor, class was alright. He is terrible about putting things online but one of the most helpful teachers I have ever had at UIUC. I'd recommend this class if you want something that will make you think, but I don't believe it's an easy A.
Just keep in mind the class is taught by TAs, however the TAs are very helpful and want you to succeed

The tests were pretty hard compared to other psych classes i've taken at Illinois. Her lectures are fine but she basically just reads off the slides which are on canvas so you don't always need to go to class. She excuses up to 3 weeks of absences no questions asked which is nice. The material was really interesting which was nice.

Take this class you can study every single item provided to you, memorize the entire study guide, look over every piece of material on this test and she will add the things that are mentioned once on the tests. I do not understand teachers that seemingly want their students to do bad and make their studying processes some type of scavenger hunt.
This class is taught by TA's and my TA was an easy grader. He explained the content very well and the content itself was extremely easy. I would even say this class is easier than AP Psych.

This class is taught only by TAs. Attendance is mandatory, paying attention is not necessary as long you stay on top of the posted lecture slides. Weekly 10 question quiz, super easy. The weekly assigned readings are not necessary. The lowest exam gets dropped and there is not a cumulative final. Mrs. Travis just oversees the course but is sweet.

i hated this class not because it was hard or anything, but the structure was kind of annoying to me. felt too much like a high school class for my liking. it literally mirrors AP Psych or any equivalent class almost exactly in terms of content.

Seems like a sweet person, just not the best professor. On several occasions, she would skip lectures because she ran out of time, but would still include it in tests. Class average for exams were around 70% which says a lot. Lectures would be very boring and sometimes would contradict herself. TA was not helpful either.

Completely dependent on TA. Easy to get a good grade if you pay attention, get iClicker points, and do all the assignments like research participation. One exam gets dropped (and they aren't too tough). I didn't do a single reading of textbook and I was fine, but do whatever your TA says.

decent class. quality very dependent on the ta for your section, you probably won't see Dr. Travis at all. graded on participation (iclicker), 3 small writing assignments, weekly quizzes, 3 midterms (1 drop), and research participation. i found paying close attention in class is more important than the readings. generally pretty simple content.
An enriching course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment:
PROS: class opens a door for research in the psychology department, subject matter is interesting and lecture slides are clear and accessible, study guides are helpful, simple class
CONS: class experience is completely on what TA you have, you do not see Dr. Travis at all
A lot depends on your TA. Overall, not too bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I like the way the class was structured - only 35% of your grade was from exams.
