I love this TA! She really helped me understand the material and made coming to class fun. Highly recommended!

What an amazing professor. Took this as a GE. There were Iclickers for attendance randomly and you need to have 15 of those completed to get attendance points. Everyone was just on their laptops but I couldn't help but be so intrigued at times with what he was talking about. If you are a music major, definitely take Dr. Smith! He is amazing.

Extremely nice professor and lectures are informative and easy to understand. Material is kind of boring at times but for the most part pretty interesting. Tests are very easy and work is light. Class is such a breeze and counts as 2 gen Ed's. 100% recommend

Great lecturer. Lots of opportunities for extra credit. Exams and quizzes are online asynchronous. Writing assignments are graded leniently. Make sure to get at least 12 of the in-class QR codes for participation.
love him hes great

This class was a very interesting class especially for a 3 hr lecture on Fridays. Professor Smith did not assign much homework which did mean you had to show up, but attendance was a large portion of the grade. He was accepting of late work for the few assignments that were signed and had fun activities through the semester

In-person lectures were engaging and has interesting material. Discussions were all online and weekly short writing prompts were quick and simple. Professor was very kind and cared about his students. He answered everyone's questions during lecture and also provided video explanations of big assignments on canvas. Would take again!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Amazing professor! Introduced me to interesting topics in music that I wasn't aware of before. There were discussion posts, but they were fun (and easy) since you could write about any songs you want for some. Super easy to get an A: just do the assignments (which are graded very fairly) and pay attention in class.
Great Professor. Very open minded and I loved that he would call society out during lecture. He would even call himself out on the things he does that are questionable. Love to see it.

I took Intro to World Music with him, and Dr. Smith was very knowledgeable about the subject material and had a very clear and sensible way of teaching lectures. The class was very well organized and well structured; everything was laid out logically. Great with communication, and lots of opportunities for extra credit were available.

Chelsey was nice but the class and grading made the class miserable.The essays and tests were graded very strictly, the study guide took forever to work through. There were not many grades so I found myself working the hardest in this class, even thought it was a gen ed. Don't take it.

For a gen ed class, the professor made this class too difficult in my opinion. You can only miss one discussion the whole semester, and attendance is worth 25 percent of your grade. Study guides for exams include around 75 terms, and exams have 2 essay questions that are graded strictly.

For her first semester teaching, this class went well. Readings are manageable (50ish pages a week) and workload is light and easy, just attend lectures and discussions and you'll get an A no problem. She tells you what info is in the textbook and not in lecture so missed info is not a big deal. Overall easy class and Smith is a very nice person

this class was a semi easy gen ed, as long as you do the readings it is easy. the lectures are easy to understand and professor smith is super kind. def a lot of readings to do, but if you don't just do them all in one night its easy. only a few assignments with 2 exams, and 2 mini essays, so make sure to get all participation points.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you think this class is an easy gen ed to take, it isn't. You have 60 pages of reading per week that you have to take discussion quizzes on. And the lecture slides barely cover the ID terms and focus questions, instead opting to cover random information that I never saw on the midterm. It's awful.

Prof Smith is amazing! Her lectures are so engaging and she converses with the class. She's very personable and kind. There is iClicker almost every class but they are easy as long as you pay attention. Her assignments have clear instructions and usually don't take long. The exams are straightforward and she posts a study guide the week before.

Absolutely loved Prof. Smith. Her lectures are engaging and entertaining, with iClicker questions each lecture and easy weekly assignments. There are four exams total, including a cumulative final. If you study the study guide, getting an A is very doable. The textbook isn't necessary.

Smith is a great professor just wouldn't recommend taking her classes unless it's something you're passionate or interested in learning about. A lot of theory and model learning. Not very many assignments and they are graded very heavily
she is so fun to listen to in lecture and interactive. lots of fun to sit in front of the lecture hall -- she will call on you and have a full conversation with students about topics :)

Attendance was mandatory because we did Iclicker questions. If you went to class and studied for the exams they were super easy. Professor Smith was super nice and I found the lectures pretty engaging.
She's so engaging and fun! Would highly recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: The class isn't bad if you do the weekly readings before class and pay attention in lecture. The only hard parts were the iclicker questions because they count towards your grade as well as attendance. The exams are common sense.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class was online (during COVID) and had two required Zoom calls a week: one for lecture at 9am and one for discussion at either 9 or 10am. I do not recommend taking any class at 9am. The reading was required and the group projects in breakout rooms were not good because no one wanted to be there.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very nice but course policies are unforgiving.

I was personally in the discussion which was taught by the TA not professor Smist. However, her online lecture videos are pretty digestible and easy to understand. I am giving her a lower rating since I did not interact with her that much. But overall the course is pretty easy, the only parts you have to extra focus on are the leadership stories!
shes alright tbh very though on the leadership stories and grading but the worst part was just the class but not much to do about that, Overall just be aware she is very critical about assingments
Does a great job presenting leadership concepts and theories but struggles with application. Very biased in class and wears her emotions on her sleeve.

Smist is kind, has a diverse and deep understanding of leadership, and genuinely cares about her students. The more effort you put in the more you'll get out of it. Her business and admin background make her particularly skilled at understand org leadership. Just a wonderful human.

Literally the easiest class that you will ever take. The assignments are always extremely clear with the instructions, and they are easy to complete. As long as you turn in the assignments on time you will get an A on the class. There are no exams, only open-note quizzes. Super easy class that actually taught me a ton. Highly recommend for anyone.

Smist taught my online lectures for lead260 and it is clear how passionate she is about what she teaches! I enjoyed what I learned from her and found it pretty easy to follow along with her lectures. The class overall is not extremely difficult.

Dr Smist is amazing like LEAD140 and LEAD260. She has a very clear rubric for every assignment, which are diverse formats. All those activities, writings and discussions are helpful for understanding and applying materials we learn in the modules. Her own lectures further helps us as well. Manage time wisely, especially on the final paper!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I took it in Summer 2020. Professor Smist is very passionate on leadership teaching, and she gives lots of opportunities for activities to develop leadership skills. Extra credits are given to improve our grades. I don't know it in regular semesters, but in summer such a course is really helpful. Such a helpful and friendly professor.

I took it in Spring 2020. Professor Smist is very passionate on leadership teaching, and she gives lots of opportunities for activities to develop leadership skills. Extra credits are given to improve our grades. Despite heavy work, you will definitely learn a lot on this course. Such a helpful and friendly professor.
Fin300 itself was one of the most difficult courses I ever took but Mark Smith made it more digestible. He was always open for office hours which was helpful, and was very nice and caring.

Literally don't even know where to start... his lectures are all over the place, he rambles for like 30 minutes on the news every class, gives 4 minute quizzes that drop ur grade so much for no reason and like half the material on his tests are stuff he either doesnt mention or barely talks about.

For 321, Smith is very knowledgeable and brings in a lot of knowledge about the financial news to his students which is great, provides plenty of homework, smartbooks, and practice problems to help prepare for his exams. We do cover a lot of material so be prepared but if you study consistently each week and don't fall behind you will be fine

He is nice but not really that helpful and his teaching style is difficult. However, his exams and quizzes are multiple choice while other Fin 300 classes exams are written. Fin 300 is a really difficult class with so many different concepts and formulas thrown at you so prepare to grind.

1. Smith, 2. Marcinkowski, 3. Peters. If you want to get an A in FIN 300, that is the list of priority of teachers to take the class with.The class is hard itself but you will get an A if you read the textbook, go to class, and prepare for the exams by going over the test review guides that he gives you. He will not try to hide anything from you.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Good class, if you ever get the opportunity to have this guy for FIN300, jump at it. I think they moved him over to fin321 cause his section of 300 was the only one where students knew what was going on. Just use the materials he gives you to study and you'll do well on the exams, he doesn't try and hide anything.

It's obvious that Mark cares a lot more than the average professor. While there is A LOT of content that they cram into this course, it's still important to go to class. Weekly quizzes are actually easy, but the 3 exams are grueling. He gives a lot of study resources and questions, but lectures don't really cover everything, so get ready to read.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This professor just using mcgraw-hill to teach us and the only things he does is reading the slide that provided by mcgraw-hill and teach us using calculator in short amount of time. The method for midterm is very strict and complicated. I think he spend a lot of time to check whether the student cheating or not instead of teaching this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Hate him, hate this class. Only thing youll learn is how to use that calculator under time pressure. Honestly should stop teaching.
Great teacher! Brings up good real world examples. Class is difficult, but he makes it manageable. Definitely one of my favorite teachers I've had.

Smith is a caring teacher and wants you to succeed, it's not his fault the class is hard. I wish he focused more on GRT questions, because it felt like a different class. To pass GRT you NEED the docs from CourseHero it will help you pass I promise. His exam review was mediocre, some things help some didn't. The Second exam had a lot of duration!

Smith is a great guy and professor. He is easily the best option for FIN300. FIN300 is one of the toughest classes you will ever take, and Smith makes it a bit easier. Smith does a good job of tying real world events to class material. Exams are hard, projects graded hard, and quizzes every week. Also, FIN300 HW is proctored every week it sucks...
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Great professor for a tough course.  Beware of the final.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Prof. Smith was the best professor I've had at U of I. He takes the time to get to know his students and really wants everyone to do well. Fin 300 is a lot of work no matter who you take it with but he does a great job explaining  the material so you are well prepared for the homework and exams. Would highly recommend.

Yeah. He was a terrible professor that often made the class uncomfortable.  He could not teach problems at all. Often he would speak very quickly as if to get through the material without any consideration for whether students were actually learning. Essentially, he was just a talking head. Would ramble frequently.

Professor Smith is a great professor who truly cares about his students and gives great lectures. His exams are pretty straightforward as they're based on the homework, pop quizzes, and problems he does in class. Just be aware Fin 300 requires a lot of work and is by no means an easy class but that is the same way no matter what professor you take.
Great professor. Very good at explaining. Cares about students. Straightforward exams and quizzes.

I took FIN 300 twice, and Professor Smith made this dreaded class WAY better. I actually enjoyed going to class. The pop quizzes are fair. He never quizzes you on "new" material, always something he has gone over in class. The midterm was fair, and based off the the materials he gave us to study. He definitely wants his students to succeed!

Great professor. Pop quizzes, but they are fairly regular and easy if you pay attention at all. Very straightforward and fair exam, nothing showed up that I wouldn't have predicted. Projects kind of suck, but that's the same across all sections.
Best Finance Professor ever!!

This difficult class is team taught so every teacher has the same projects&hw, but prof. smith is definitely the best. He will take time out of his day to help if needed. I had him during his first year and he still has some things to improve on, but you will not find another teacher that cares so much about each individual student on this campus.
His lecture is really great! But his test is too hard.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Informed and entertaining lecturer.
Best explanation ever seen
The homeworks were essential to understanding the material, but were graded with ease. The proffesor was very helpful and willing to explain things.

This guy is awesome He is enthusiastic with what he is doing and willing to help during office hour. The homework is not easy, but the exam is not difficult if you understand the materials he covers. The only drawback is his clarification during lecturesyou may read the book before come to lecture.
Elegant proofs, clear explanations, fair grades. Not for a fainted head.
This professor is the hottest of the hottest. I had him as a professor in a set theory class, but just couldn't take my eyes off him.

Doesn't care about his students & doesn't assign regular homework (bored to grade), occasional random hws expected back in less than a week, completely inconsiderate to students' other classes. Your grade doesn't reflect how much you really know or worked for in the class, but is random.the diff between A & B can be 1 exam question!Poor notes only.
This guy was amazing. He won't give the answers, but will lead you to them - he even says that on day one. Wildly funny. I wish all my teachers were as good as him!!!
Probably the best TA at the U of I. Quite hilarious and even more knowledgeable.

Nice fun guy, but absolutely no help whatsoever. You can ask very specific clarification question and he will waste you work time not giving you information. Thinks the lecture slides assigned by the professor are useless and will click through them then send you off to do the lab with no instructions. Uses the same jokes every class. Easy grading
Amazing teacher!

professor Ben is a very nice person. you'll receive a personal email to encourage you if you're good or have big increase on the exam. He and his TA provide office hour each week. As long as you read the textbook and ppt it's not hard to get a good score compare to other chemistry classes. Class is not well organize which is need to be improved
The lecture makes no sense. The exam overwhelmed me even though I stayed up in the library for the whole night and none of the concept was tested in the terrible final exam.

He seems like a nice guy, and he is definitely very knowledgeable about the subject. However, I found that the material in lecture did not translate very well to the exam or the homework problems. On top of that, the lectures were pretty tough to understand in general. There was just not enough explanation for the lecture content on the slides

Worst professor I've had in my time at UIUC. Lectures make no sense, very little homework so it's hard to know how to apply the content and impossible to know what's important for an exam. He throws so much information at you with no explanation and his lectures don't provide any application of the information. This guy made me hate my major.

Easy grader. If you're a decent writer, he'll be a breeze for you. Had 4 main essays and a final. Lectures suck because he basically reads you powerpoints and from the book, but other than that not much outside work.
He is an amazing Rhet 105 instructor! A brilliant man! I highly recommend him. He grades fairly and his assignments aren't too difficult.
He is a very easy grader and is helpful when you ask him questions one on one, i would recommend getting him for RHET 105.. he gives you a long time to compete papers.
Readings every night, but nothing too bad. He is really nice and as long as you participate every once and a while you should do fine.

Very soft spoken & not too gung-ho about his topic, but it's an easy class (just lots of reading). They're interesting books though; not textbooks, but historical fiction. He's easy to get along with & communicates well. No fun digressions or stories though; he's very focused & keeps students that way too. Quiz prep is nothing you can't sparknote.

This class is pretty easy. There are no tests or quizzes. Just simple short papers from time to time. The only thing is you need to at least sparknotes.com the readings so you can say something in class and get your participation points.

He is a good teacher for the class material that is being covered. The class I had him for I failed previously because I could not understand the professor so atleast he gives clear and decisive information. Is helpful if you are adamant for getting help. Overall not the great professor but I would suggest him for MATH 210 anyday
just make sure you don't skip lecture. he isn't the best but definitely not the worst.
He's okay. Not as attractive as everyone says - he's kind of a bro. He's nothing special, but for a math teacher he's fine. I have no serious complaints.

horrible, horrible, horrible. get the picture. ya the girls were gaga over him, but he still couldnt teach. he would write on the board and repeat everything he wrote..... looking at the board. he shouldnt be allowed to teach anymore.

An absolutely awful class if you've never taken calculus before.  He is an awful lecturer, basically just reading to himself.  The TA's weren't helpful at all.  I struggled through this class my entire semester.

jason was....funny, especially his hi de lo de stuff (or whatever that was), but he writes down every single word and it annoyed the hell out of me. as a grad student, he wasn't THAT bad, but he was a cutie, so that helps a little bit! lol
Not a very confident lecturer, talks into the board excessively, doesn't give enough examples, and the TA's grade the tests ridiculously. This class sucked.

Not GREAT, but he'll do. Talks to the board instead of the students. The majority of the notes come from other professors and notes can be found on the Math web site under other sections. Make sure you pay attention and correct HIM during lecture, otherwise you'll have the wrong info in your notes and won't understand why your answer is wrong.
HOTT!!!
he is a hottie!!! sometimes you get lost because he is too wordy but he is sooo HOT!
No Comments

Professor Snodgrass is so passionate about his subject and about his class which makes coming to class everyday so great. His labs are challenging, but he gives you a lot of time to do them, and he gives extra credit opportunities.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Eric is great. I was missing some class and hes been great about excepting late work and meeting me privately to go over material. His lectures, though not mandatory, are a great time because hes so passionate about it , is very funny, and devotes time to going over upcoming weather. If you have any interest in atmos science take 1 of his classes!
best professor I have ever had! His class is full of passion and humour! I hope I can take all his classes!

A very passionate and nice professor. His lectures have memorable personal stories and cool weather disaster videos. It is easy provided you put in some effort. If you get the chance take 120 with Snodgrass.

Snodgrass is one of the best lecturers I've had. He includes funny stories and videos to keep students engaged in topics that otherwise could be very dry. This semester tests were in person rather than online, but the content was manageable and he curved appropriately. Easy A if you show up to class, take notes, and complete homework / extra credit

Exams (3) weren't too bad if you review lecture notes (no final). You have weekly labs that are kind of hard, but he's always helpful & answers/hints can be found on compass. Lots of e.c. He is such a cool guy & is really passionate about what he does. His lectures are awesome, funny, & interesting. Would take his class again.

Professor Snodgrass is one of the most inspiring professors I've had since college. He is super professional, helpful and most importantly extremely passionate about what he does. I'm taking his class to fulfill my gen eds, and I didn't know anything about ATMS before this class, but his lectures are very fun and interesting!

Professor Snodgrass is great and the lectures are amazing. You should definitely come to lecture because there are mandatory i-Clicker points. Only one semi-easy assignment per week and the extra credit reading quiz answers are not hard. Give it even a half effort and you'll do very well

I took this class just for the fun of it and it's easily the best class I've taken at UIUC. I was always hyped to go to lecture and truly sad when I had to miss it. Snodgrass is so engaging and has some really funny jokes to go along with his lecture. The class is a must take.

Snodgrass is great! Lectures were really engaging and the assignments were very fair. Take the time to do the extra credit, because it will make up for some tough exam questions or the small mistakes you might make on the math homeworks.   Incredible guy - definitely recommend taking the class.

Snodgrass is amazing. I am sad that I am no longer in his class, but I still feel the urge to send him any weather pictures I have when I get the chance. His lectures are absolutely hilarious and so interesting. ATMS120 is super easy. 30% of the grade is guaranteed just by showing up, only 10 short HW assignments, easy online tests, and lots of EC

Prof snodgrass knows a crazy amount about the atmosphere and life in general. A lot of people choose this for a blow-off class because of the level of difficulty. But, if you pay attention you will truly learn a lot of very applicable information.

Extremely easy class. Can't imagine a scenario where any non science major would not take this as one of their 2 science gen ends. Snodgrass is funny, an engaging lecturer and you're basically guaranteed an A so long as you try at all.

Great professor and the class is very easy if you go to lecture. He makes you want to learn because of how interesting all of his lectures are. Tells great stories and is super funny. 10/10 would recommend to anyone
This was the second ATMS class I took, and Snodgrass was great. His lectures are engaging and I actually retained a lot of the material.

Made information relevant to  class material. Please show up to class, it pays off! Gives extra credit and also allows students to take exams at home. Used videos and images. Made lecture enjoyable yet applicable. Learned more than weather but also tips to survive. Would definitely take again!
Favorite professor in the world

I graduated from uiuc in 2015, and took atms 120 my sophomore year. by far the best and most memorable class I ever took, and I still use my knowledge to this day. Thank you to Professor Snodgrass for giving your students an awesome class to look forward to - I couldn't say that about really any of my other classes. Thank you!

Definitely not as easy at ATMS 120, but still a really good class. If you put in the work, you can literally guarantee an A+. You are allowed to post solutions to the daily homework on the class discussion board, and the tests are very fair. Snodgrass is one of those rare professors who doesn't take pride in failing students.

He is a great professor! He knows this is a GenEd course and because of that gives a lot of help to students. Lectures are interesting and he uses tons of funny videos and pictures. All of the tests were online and there was tons of extra credit. If you have questions he is always willing to help. Definitely would recommend this class to everyone!

GREAT professor.  This man is highly passionate and has numerous anecdotes about the material.  He makes the class go by so quickly.  Easiest GenEd you will ever take.  All exams were online even though the class met in person.  ERIC SNODGRASS IS A WONDERFUL PROFESSOR AND HUMAN BEING.  I would take this class multiple times if I had the time.

This class was one of my favorites at UIUC. I decided to take it after a tree almost fell on my car during a microburst. This class will teach you weather safety and is very interesting and engaging to boot. Prof Snodgrass is clearly passionate about the subject matter and tells memorable and often hilarious anecdotes. Class was always packed!
ERIC SNODGRASS IS THE CUTEST THING ON EARTH. YOU WILL NOT REGRET TAKING THIS COURSE

He's very thoughtful and an amazing professor. Snodgrass so far been one of the best teachers I've had at this school and I actually learned a lot. It's hard to get a seat in this class so grab it if you get a chance! I-clicker questions, but it's okie if you get it wrong, it's just for attendance points! Tests are easy if you pay attention!
The most enthusiastic professor I have ever had. Tells memorable stories. Teaches interesting topics. And engages the class well. Great guy, great class, highly recommend.

This is one of the best classes I have taken at UIUC. The course material is pretty interesting. There are 3 exams, but all the stuff you need to know are on the lectures. The class is very straightforward. I really appreciate that because there are classes where the exams are super tough. Overall, I would take this class again and would recommend!

The perfect gen ed class for non-STEM majors (fulfills both sciences and QR1). Class is mandatory due to iClickers. Tests are all online and the final is optional. You should buy the textbook if  you want to do the work.  For people with an actual interest in the material, Snodgrass is very passionate about his field.
Love this guy!!!
Well why don't we have more teachers like this on campus? He so dreamy and persuasive he was meant for teaching, the day he leaves will be a sad one. Really fun class, GPA Booster.
He is such a nice teacher! If you go to class and finish all the weekly problems, you should get an A. There are 3 exams but pretty easy, he even made the final exam optional!
Very passionate professor. Lectures are interesting. Highly recommended.
Eric is overall great! ATMS 120 is easy a'f and is fun to go to.
Regardless of your major, try to take ATMS 120 before you graduate. It's a class you will always remember.
Awesome guy, great class, useful information
Great teacher, great class!
Amazing professor. Really useful information that is helpful in real life. Take this class!!!!!!

Easy class with good information. Try and take it with people you know. It'll be a lot easier that way! Weekly challenge problems (math because it covers a Quant II) and exams he encourages you to take with others. Book is optional but DONT GET IT. I used it once and realized I didn't have to for the rest of the class. Attendance 25% of grade.
This is my absolute favorite class I have taken at UIUC and he is my favorite teacher I have had at UIUC.

Amazing teacher! Such a smart man, who can easily explain science to people who aren't science orientated at all. I learned so much in this class and am really thankful that I took it. I wish I could take more classes with him!

Great Professor! Took his online class  and his lectures are actually enjoyable, easy to understand, and informative. He is quick to respond to questions and helps you understand challenge problem assignments so you actually learn the material. Text books were only NEEDED for extra credit reading quizzes. I would recommend him to anybody!

Best teacher I have ever had! He was interesting, funny and knew what he was talking about. I liked coming to class. He shows a lot of videos but they are all super interesting and relevant. Tests are super easy and he encourages you to work with others.
Amazing. He just really wants us all to pass. And I actually did learn a lot! I missed some assignments so my grade suffered but really, if you do the work you'll get an A.

Super friendly. Lectures were lively and interesting, with anecdotes interspersed between lecture content. He really enjoys teaching and loves atmospheric sciences. All assignments/exams/notes are online and he encourages you to collaborate. Textbook rarely used, so don't buy. Bring your laptop to class to fill in his PowerPoint notes.

The most amazing professor I have had for my undergrad career! Seriously, if you don't love this class by the end then you must not have gone to his lectures. Severe and hazardous weather with some occasional life advice thrown in! Take this class, do it, right now!
Awesome professor.
Snodgrass is lit-rally the best professor I have had at U of I. I would recommend him to anyone for any class he teaches. This class was fun, very informative, and he makes you want to go to lecture.
Amazing professor. If you can, take his class.

He is by far the best professor on the face of the Earth! He is also so enthusiastic and willing to help. He has an amazing way of teaching, which makes even hard topics seem easy. There are 2 non cumulative midterms and 1 final. He doesn't try to trick you at all. Class was easy and very fair, plus you actually find yourself learning quite a bit.

He is an excellent instructor. If you think it is impossible for someone to be this nice, think again. He has a true passion for severe weather. As for the course work if you don't do so well on one assignment, you have plenty of opportunities to make it up with mini extra credit assignments given twice every week. It is a very fun class.

I've never had a prof that was more excited about teaching and the material than he was. I love going to class, and even though I'm a very spacey person, he'd never lose my attention. Take this course if you can.

Awesome class! You will learn a lot. Plenty of extra credit and easy! Also easy to contact him if you're having trouble with the material! He really cares for his students and loves his job, which makes his class enjoyable! It's not an easy A because you actually have to work for it. But it's not impossible! Final grade A

Great guy.  If your unsure about what you want to do in life, and your interested in math and physics, take this course.  Or if you just want an easy A while actually learning material and not wasting money on a pointless course just for an A, take this course.  It is interesting, applicable, and fun at times.
Snodgrass is a great lecturer and awesome guy. Super helpful material. Not hard to get an A if you do the work.
Awesome teacher! He's funny and his lectures are interesting. Easy A! Highly recommend!

Professor Snodgrass is very helpful. He was always available. Since this was a summer class it went kind of fast but there were 3 tests and 20, 10 questions quizzes. The material isn't easy or hard. But at the end he raised everyone's grade by 2%. I'd recommend him to everyone he's very nice.
Super easy class and really helpful and amazing teacher! Was actually very interesting class also and  learned a lot.
HE IS AMAZING! HE IS VERY PASSIONATE ABOUT HIS JOB AND HE HAS FUN RELAYING THE INFORMATION TO YOU.
He is definitely the best professor. He is very very knowledged, and love to tell interesting stories. Will never regret taking his class

Easy professor. Although there were a lot of work, such as weekly challenge problem, Active learning exercise every class, and online homework, however, the exam is online also, so you can always do it with open notes. Also there was like 5% extra credit points, which was helpful. Professor said majority of the student in this class got an A.
I highly recommend this course! The instructor is outstanding and even if you don't have an interest in the content, he makes it interesting.
He's the bomb!! Never thought I could be so interested in the weather.
FANTASTIC!! This class was amazing and Professor Snodgrass is great! He gives a lot of extra credit and makes it very easy to do well and understand. I recommend this class for everyone!

I've had Eric for ATMS 120 and 201 now. He is also my advisor. I can say this man is truly passionate about the material. He is great at explaining everything and makes sure you understand it. The classes are extremely easy, just do the work and review the material. He is also great to talk to as well and have a conversation with. Take his classes!
Do I need to repeat what everyone else has said? Snodgrass is awesome, and I've actually learned a lot. Answer a question correctly in class and get an ATMS keychain. I WILL CHERISH MINE FOREVER

I wasn't at the right math level to be taking this class so I struggled a bit; also didn't study much which is a horrible habit I'm working on. Goes into more depth than ATMS 120 and is still interesting! Makes me love my major. Eric is the most helpful and encouraging professor I've ever had! Do not be afraid to ask for help!! You won't regret it.

He knows what he's talking about, and it's easy to tell he loves his field. He excites students through his excitement about his passion - I think all teachers should teach this way. Also, class was very funny and easy - definitely take this, no matter what major. Extremely helpful and interesting weather information.
Cares about his students. Extremely funny. During office hours, guides you until you solve weekly challenges (same with TAs). A Quant II you should definitely take.

Eric Snodgrass is hands down one of the greatest teachers I have ever had. Did my James Scholar project with him and he was completely willing to meet me for office hours whenever I was free. Take this class! It's easy, fun, and Eric Snodgrass is great!
Fantastic teacher. Very helpful if you ask. Teaches clearly and very understanding of students.
Everything has already been said here. He is fantastic, his class is as easy as it gets, he is funny, and he is a good person. Highly recommended.

Snodgrass is the best professor ever!! He is so down to earth and his classes are very exciting! I went to class each day for fun, yes you heard me for fun! He excites his students with the knowledge he provides. Every student should take his class at UofI to experience what a real, passionate and caring professor is like! Snodgrass you the man!

The best class on campus. Eric does a phenomenal job explaining the material. His lectures are a blast, as he has many great pictures, videos, and stories. A class every U of I student should take hands down.

favorite professor at u of i, hands down. he really loves what he's teaching and makes it super interesting. also, the class counts towards the quant II and physical science gen ed requirements. attendance is mandatory for the daily practice problems that you turn in, but honestly you'll just want to go because he's such a great teacher.

Amazing. Dont graduate without taking ATMS 120 or 210. The material would be pretty hard with any other teacher, but Eric makes it simple and even fun. I never thought I would look forward to an 80 minute class, but this guy is a pretty bomb teacher.
THE BEST. Period.
Awesome!

This guy is seriously one of the greatest people on the planet. He puts so much effort into this class and will take the time to help you with a concept until you get it. This was by far my most favorite class I've ever taken, EVER. The man is hilarious and class is rarely boring. He makes me wish I could be friends with him outside of class...

He's like the cooler older brother I never had.  We were studying Hurricanes, so he played Cyclone by Baby Bash in class.  The material is actually pretty interesting too, since it can be applied to every day life.  It's pretty easy to get an A+.  If you are lucky enough to snag a seat in his class, enjoy it!  Snodgrass runs U of I, end of story.
Awesome guy and really good at teaching the material. I wish he taught all of my classes.

Eric Snograss is the best professor I have ever had. He actually cares about his students succeeding rather than some percentage of how many can get A's, B's, etc. I was excited to go to this class. The only class I have been excited to attend. And I'm an accounting major.

Eric Snodgrass is such a great teacher-- he always shows youtube videos and makes learning about Severe Weather fun! He is so funny, and not too sore on the eyes either. Seriously, hottest teacher on campus. Great class, would definitely recommend!

Best professor you will ever have. Funny, adorable, and ridiculously intelligent. I loved this class so much and wish I could take it again. It's easy to get honors credit also, and I would recommend this to EVERYBODY. Take it!!

Professor Snodgrass is excellent. The class is very linear; go to class, do in-class assignment (professor gives you the answers), do online extra-credit, take exam. Rinse and repeat for a relatively easy "A".

Class is super interesting and fun, and Snodgrass is hysterical. My only regret is not winning an "I love meteorology" keychain.

BEST CLASS EVER!! Attendance isn't mandatory but you do workbooks pages randomly which gives you major points. Take this class even if you don't need it as a gen ed! Also I strongly urge James Scholars to take it the project is awesome and easy

I took 120 and 201 with him. He is simply the best professor ever. He never tests you on anything he didn't teach. This one of the best classes and one of the best professors ever! This class is fun,easy, and interesting. Eric is a great guy. TAKE THIS CLASS!! You will not regret it at all.

The. Best. Never thought I would look forward to going to class but Snodgrass makes it happen. He's the best. Take ATMS 120. Easy A, interesting topics, satisfies GenEd Physical Science.
Easily one of the best teachers i have had on campus.
AWESOME PROFESSOR!!!  Very Interesting and has a great teaching style.  One of the best professors at U of I!

BEST BEST PROFESSOR EVER!!! His class is interesting! He put a lot of effort on preparing his course and make it attractive. He is EXTREMELY HELPFUL and KIND. He is always willing to help!! LIKE HIM!!!

seriously best professor of my life! his stories are always funny and interesting. You will learn so much, and actually retain it because he teaches in such an entertaining way. I always looked forward to his class. He really knows how to motivate and keep a college students attention.

BEST PROFESSOR EVER!!!!!!!!!! class with interesting topics. you actually learn a lot of information. TAKE THIS CLASS DEFINITELY
BY FAR the BEST teacher I've EVERRRRRR had. I would do anything to take another class with him. I'll miss  esoddy16 =(

BEST PROFESSOR EVER!! get a buddy and do all the online hw's and quizzes together. also, DO NOT BUY THE TEXTBOOK! its a waste of $$ just get the workbook copies from a friend. do all the extra credits :) easy A no question.

Gotta love this guy. Somebody give him a raise please. As the James Bond of meteorology, Eric teaches with tons of YouTube videos and loves storm pictures and the Office. Great professor. Very easy class. He is a lot of fun, and really enjoys both teaching and weather. He loves to bring up funny stories in class, and still manages to teach something. My advice, take any class of his and don't look back, you'll enjoy it!
Snodgrass is a great professor, he loves his work, the topics he teaches are so interesting, he reiterates what he says with fun//interesting videos & slides.. plus he's so hot & has mad swag.

Snoddy is the BEST!  He cares so much about the material and he really wants his students to do well.  You will actually look forward to coming to class with him!  He is one of the most enthusiastic teachers I've ever seen and he is so nice.

I took this class trying to fill up hours and boost my GPA, which it did, but I also learned a whole lot too.  Just go to class and take notes and you'll do fine on the homework and exams and get an easy A. I actually looked forward to going to class and can genuinely say that I learned something new every time I went. Snodgrass is the greatest.

He is what all professors should be. Really down to earth and funny. Very passionate about the material. If you go to the lectures (which you wont mind going to) and look over the material before a test you will get an A. Gives around 10% of extra credit. I would take any class he teaches
He is a nice guy and teaches the material well.  He is just kinda annoying to listen to .  Maybe its just the way he talks.

Great teacher! His atmos 201 class is a step above atms 100 or atms 120, however its still very straight forward and relatively easy. He's very enthusiastic about teaching and probably one of the greatest teachers on campus. I would highly recommend any class taught by him

Snodgrass is great. He is so nice and good to look at ;) He makes the boring stuff okay and the fun stuff even better. Shows interesting clips and offer tons of extra credit! Tests are fine if you do the homework and review lecture. TAKE THIS CLASS!
He is THE coolest teacher I have ever had. I had no interest in weather prior to this class, but now I love it! Best class of the semester.

I LOVE this class, he's so cool, down to earth, funny, and young. This is my favorite class to go to because he is so passionate in teacher.  Not only that, but he is good at it. I'm an English major and I LOVED this class. Snodgrass is hilarious, energetic, and is able to motivate the class to engage in the material. Without a doubt one of the best teachers on this campus.

Very attractive and sweet. His expectations and requirements are made clear from the beginning. He played clips of the Office and lots of videos. I did the crossword during every lecture and came out with B. ATMS 100 with his isn't bad either.

Eric is probably the greatest thing that has happened to General Education and Atmospheric Sciences at the University of Illinois.  His dedication to teaching about the weather makes any student, interested or not, understand the material very easily.  A definite professor to have before graduating at the UIUC...

Snodgrass is as good of a professor you will ever have. Take his class! I have never seen a professor go to such lengths to help his students and he finds ways to always make the class interesting. Go to class, do the assignments, and study for the exams and you should get an A pretty easily.

Eric is a fantastic teacher! He really loves teaching and has great videos. When class gets boring, he knows it and will show videos to perk the class up. If you do your homework and read the discussion on compass about it you can get 100% on all of the homework. He is great about answering homework questions online
best teacher ever. i love eric snodgrass more than life.

Whether it is the great stories of his atmospheric career or the way he gives men pointers on keeping commitments to their wives, Snodgross is the man! I laugh everyday at this ma's humor and enjoy every class. He explains topics extremely well and loves weather. His exams are to the point and do not try to trick you.

Snodgrass is a high-energy professor who really enjoys teaching, which makes his class easier to sit through. if only all professors were like Eric Snodgrass.....
He makes classes very interesting. Not bad to look at, for a professor.
awesome teacher!  Would recommend class to anyone.  Guaranteed if you have a soul and pay attention

I took Professor Snodgrass' Atmos 120 course in Spring 2007. This was a very intriguing course and fairly easy if you kept on top of things. I highly recommend him as a professor. Just keep your cell phone off in his class though.
I love this man

Class is a breeze. You have to go to lectures because you get points for doing in class excercises (graded for completion only). Homework is a bit challenging but you get plenty of hints and help to do it. Exams aren't too bad either. Plenty of extra credit. Guaranteed A if you do the minimum.
Eric Snodrass is the best teacher ever!!!!!

Professor Snodgrass is BY FAR my favorite professor on this campus. He is extremely helpful and you can tell he really wants you to do well in his class. He is very passionate about his subject, and his enthusiasm definitely rubs off on his students. If you attend lectures and do the homework, you will be fine on exams. An excellent professor!

Professor Snograss is my favorite teacher on campus. He is very helpful and understanding. He is one of those teachers that will personally help you if you need help in the class. I would suggest taking this class, snodgrass makes it very exciting and fun.

Snodgrass is a really great teacher. I'm not interested in weather but he makes thunderstorm formation sound interesting. Mmmm... :)
Really awesome professor.

This course wasn't as easy as I had anticipated. It requires a fair amount of reading as well as work. The material is pretty compact and the exams require a good amount of studying. However, Snodgrass is a very good instructor and tries to make his class exciting. His lectures can sometimes get a little boring; most of the time he makes class fun.

Prof. Snodgrass made ATMS 120 one of those classes you actually enjoy going to. He is very excited to teach, which is sometimes unusual to see out of professors. He had to rush through some material, but made things that were normally above my head understandable. Homework and quizzes were pretty easy as long as you do the reading Buy the book.
Snodgrass is the best Professor that I yet. He keep you interested in the material. He seemed to be very interested in the material. The test as long as you went to class the tests were pretty easy.

Great professor, but talks extremely quickly through material.  Very interested in material and wants students to do well.  Offers a lot of extra help.  Difficult exams, but will help you if you are struggling
The class is easy and interesting, especially with Snodgrass teaching it. He's super funny, smart, interesting, and cute. Too bad he's married haha. I'm going to miss him.
Snoddy is a very effective teacher as well as a very funny, likable guy.  He is very approachable and his notes are clear.  He's also a hottie.

Very fun and very interesting class.  Snodgrass is captivating and very enthusiastic about his subject.  You'll forget about the time.  Be sure to always go to lecture, because your attendance will add points to your grade, and you'll need his notes for the exams.
Excellent professor, very enthusiastic.  TAKE THIS CLASS!

About 45% of your grade is based on easy assignments.  Eric was super enthusiastic and tried to make lecture fun, even though I still managed to sleep through half of it.  Don't blow off exams, but overall it's an easy A if you pay attention and take notes w/ the powerpoints.  And I agree, he's definitely a cutie.

Professor Eric was a great teacher. He was so enthusiastic about this subject and as a result, I also really liked learning about this subject that I did not have much interest or knowledge in before.  He also really wants to have students do well.  He gives so many office hours and offered chances for students to raise their grades in a fair way.

Professor Snodgrass is a little cutie. He is seriously the nicest guy and best teacher. He explains everything very clearly and has a lot of enthusiasm teaching everything. All of his notes are online, but he gives you points for coming to class which are quite helpful because they do add up and help your grade in the end.

Really good professor! Class was not mandatory, but points were given for in class worksheets (easy though). He is very energetic and enjoys teaching, which makes the class even better. He is a really nice guy and very helpful.

Eric is soo funny, loves to show Youtube videos even if they are goofy weather videos.  Very sincere, very helpful in anyway he can be.  Grading is pretty nice, he gives some extra credit and makes life seem pretty relaxing!! I definitely recommend him! He's fun and I'm going to miss that class!!

He's hot, funny and very excited about weather. There is a bit of challenge problems, online quizzes and ALE's, but the discussion boards are a great help. Though he speeds through lecture slides, the class is very laid back. All in all Snodgrass doesn't care about how much he challenges you, he just wants you to be as excited about the subject as

You should be able to get an A in here if you are at class (lots of attendance points are available) and do a little studying. Not much reading is involved (10-20 pages per week).
He is very enthusiastic about what he is teaching and genuinely wants his students to be enthusiastic about it too. Very easy if you go to class, pay attention, and study for tests.
Great Great Great professor. Enthusiastic, and makes long lectures seem short. Really nice guy too.
He makes things so easy
Eric's a pretty cool teacher and he explains things well.  It's a good Gen Ed to take.
Great class, very easy and the information is fun.  Eric is able to present it in a very fun and interesting way and you can tell he loves teaching the class.  Easy A.
homework can be challanging so go to his office hours often. overall the class wasn't too hard if u showed up. just study the stuff and you'll get an A
Class was an easy A and all assignments are grades were very clear and easy to follow. Did not eat up a lot of my time outside of class.

Dr. Solomon has genuinely dedicated his life to his studies and it shows.Throughout his lectures he adds movie clips and personal testimony to spice things up. Good class and good lecturer but if you don't have any background knowledge on greek myth this class can be pretty intimidating. Generally though it wasn't that bad but I am not a social studies person.

reviews.comment: I mean this guy is the best. Theres nothing else to it.

I enjoyed Dr. Solomon's lectures greatly when I did go. He made the class and subject much more entertaining and interesting to someone who wasn't all that interested in the subject. The discussion book is very clear on what is tested on exams which is mostly matching/mcq with key terms. I managed to learn all the material the day before each exam.

He is a very fun and interesting lecturer, often times throwing in movie clips that relate to the subject at hand. The tests are fairly easy multiple choice and mostly simple memorization questions. He gives you a long list of words to memorize and if you know those, you are set for the test. You will have ~2 open ended questions to answer a week.

Very engaging and funny professor with interesting lectures that I looked forward to going to every week. Very easy class as long as you show up to lecture and take decent notes. Everything you need for tests is in his workbook and the questions are super straightforward.

Besides having to purchase a textbook, this class was a great gen ed. Super easy and pretty engaging lectures for such a big lecture hall. Lots of movies, music, etc. played during lecture to keep it engaging. Pre-lecture readings are short and the most work you'll have to do for this class is essay prep. Objective exams are SUPER easy-no tricks.
awesome teacher, easy class for a gen ed credit, 10/10 def recommend

Professor Solomon makes this class an engaging and straightforward experience. With his enthusiasm, clear expectations, and helpful TAs, it's an easy A. Unstuckstudy was a great supplementary tool for exam prep.
Professor Solomon makes lectures enjoyable. Assignments and tests are easy to do well on if you put in the effort. Would recommend for the gen ed requirement.

Amazing professor!! I loved his CLCV 115 class. If you are someone who has even a slight interest in this course and needs it for the credit please take it!! Just beware of the readings if you are someone who doesn't like that kind of assignments.

Prof. Solomon's lectures are really engaging and provide students with the easiest and most straightforward way to get an A in the class. You just have to show up to lectures and take the pop quizzes, which he gives you the answer mostly, and read and write small amounts during the TA sessions. He is the best and this class is the best.

Prof Solomon himself is an amazing lecturer and professor. He cares a lot about the subject he teaches and cares about his students and makes sure they are doing well and everyone gets a good grade. I love him.
He's GOATed. Highly recommend. The class is easy and interesting.

Professor Solomon wasn't too interesting of a professor, but the class was very straightforward and easy. Kinda annoying that he makes you buy a couple of expensive workbooks that he writes himself, but at least the homework and tests are all online and easy. The lectures are pretty knowledge packed, but honestly you don't need to listen to them.

Absolute �� professor. He actually realizes that most people take this as an elective and that people take it because it sounds interesting, and it is. He makes it fun and interesting and is forgiving about unfortunate circumstances. Possibly best professor at UIUC.

Please save yourself the trouble and don't take this class if you don't work well in lecture halls of 500+ students, I def made that mistake. 115 gives more chances to raise your grade bc of the discussion class and I so wish I could've taken it. Tests are ALL memorization; don't expect Solomon to email you back or help you out with your grade.

reviews.comment: Solomon was a great professor. He was super engaging and entertaining. He laid out course expectations clearly in the required workbook and made it easy to succeed. I would highly recommend taking a class taught by him if you have the chance!

Solomon gives amazing and hilarious lectures. There are pop quizzes that account for attendance, but sometimes he literally tells you the answers. This class is definitely not an easy A because you have to put minimal amount of work in, but once you do it's like a piece of cake. Exams are based on memorization; Quizlet is your best friend.

I took this class thinking it would be interesting and it was but Soloman gives A LOT of busy work. You buy a workbook where you have homework assignments you have to type out and print to turn in. It was definitely not as easy as a gen ed as I hoped it would be. The tests are all memorization but you can easily look up quizletts for them.

A nice course overall, no final exam, sample test questions can be found online. The lecture is not really helpful, just make you sleepy, but you don't want to skip the class because he takes attendance. An A is desirable if you work hard before midterm.

reviews.comment: He is a great guy. By the time I'm writing this review, I haven't finished the class yet but the way he is made me do this review. Easy class, do the quizzes and you'll be fine. He's not a tough grader. He accepts late work only if you present your excuses! I'll chose him as my instructor for any class any day!

It's very obvious that he's been doing this for a while. His lectures are so cool and in-depth; I've been learning mythology since grade school, and he taught me so much in this class that I'd never even heard about. Go to the lectures. He doesn't post them online, and they're interesting besides that.

This class was a cake walk. Please take it if you get the chance, all of the tests are on quizlet and super easy to study for. I never paid attention in lecture and got an A. definitely worth the $100 for the textbooks. If you can, ask a friend who took the class before to give you their homework.

Great lecturer. There's a lot of reading (like too much) for a gen ed, but it's pretty interesting. You don't have to read it all anyway--he tells you exactly what you need to know for the exams. Great class.
